|   <small>├─ Sales Retail Returns</small> | `Dr` | REVENUE | <small>Customer returns reducing total revenue</small> |
|   <small>├─ Wholesale Sales</small> | `Cr` | REVENUE | <small>Revenue from bulk medicine sales to other retailers or pharmacies</small> |
|   <small>├─ Wholesale sales discount</small> | `Dr` | REVENUE | <small>Wholesale discount reducing total revenue</small> |
|   <small>└─ Wholesale sales returns</small> | `Dr` | REVENUE | <small>Wholesale returns reducing total revenue</small> |
| **Service Income** | `Cr` | REVENUE | Income from services such as delivery and consultation |
|   <small>├─ Service Income</small> | `Cr` | REVENUE | <small>Income from services such as delivery and consultation</small> |
|   <small>└─ Service Income Discount</small> | `Dr` | REVENUE | <small>Discount given on services</small> |
| Stock Adjustment Gain | `Cr` | REVENUE | Income arising from stock adjustments where physical stock exceeds book stock |

![MediFlux Pharmacy Revenue and Sales Ledgers](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/6ad91eb8-40a5-4069-8bee-450f4a719602-revenue.png)
*Caption: Expanded view of nested sales revenue, other income, and service income accounts in MediFlux.*

> **Note:** Discount and return accounts carry a `Dr` balance because they are **contra-revenue** accounts. They reduce your total revenue rather than add to it.

---

### Expenses

Expense accounts track every cost of running the pharmacy.

| Account | Normal Balance | Type | Tracks |
|---------|----------------|------|--------|
| **Expenses** | `Dr` | EXPENSE | All business expenses required to operate the pharmacy |
| **Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)** | `Dr` | EXPENSE | Direct cost of medicines and goods sold, including purchases |
|   <small>├─ Direct Labor</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Wages for staff directly involved in sales operations</small> |
|   <small>├─ Freight & Transportation (Purchases)</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Transport expenses for purchasing medicines</small> |
|   <small>├─ Purchase Cost of Medicines</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Cost of buying medicines for resale</small> |
|   <small>├─ Purchase Cost of Non-Drug Inventory</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Cost of purchasing non-pharmaceutical inventory for resale</small> |
|   <small>└─ Purchase discount</small> | `Cr` | EXPENSE | <small>Records discounts and price reductions received from suppliers</small> |
| **Indirect Expenses** | `Dr` | EXPENSE | Expenses not directly attributable to specific products or sales |
|   <small>├─ Advertising and Marketing</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Expenses for pharmacy promotion, online ads, banners</small> |
|   <small>├─ Bank Charges</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Bank fees, transaction charges, and account maintenance</small> |
|   <small>├─ Customer Adjustment Expense</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Expense recognized from customer account adjustments</small> |
|   <small>├─ Depreciation Expense</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Monthly depreciation of furniture, equipment, computers</small> |
|   <small>├─ GST Credit Reversal Expense</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Expense recognized when previously claimed GST input is reversed</small> |
|   <small>├─ Insurance Expense</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Business insurance and employee insurance costs</small> |
|   <small>├─ Interest Expense</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Interest paid on loans, overdrafts, and credit card balances</small> |
|   <small>├─ Office Supplies</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Stationery, printer paper, and general office consumables</small> |
|   <small>├─ Professional Fees</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>CA fees, legal charges, consultant charges</small> |
|   <small>├─ Rent Expense</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Monthly rent for the pharmacy premises</small> |
|   <small>├─ Repairs and Maintenance</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Repair and maintenance of pharmacy equipment and premises</small> |
|   <small>├─ Round Off Loss</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Loss arising due to rounding off invoice totals</small> |
|   <small>├─ Salaries and Wages</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Salaries for pharmacists, staff, helpers, and wages</small> |
|   <small>├─ Supplier Adjustment Expense</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Expense recognized from supplier account adjustments</small> |
|   <small>├─ Taxes and Licenses</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>License renewal fees and non-recoverable taxes</small> |
|   <small>├─ Travel and Conveyance</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Fuel costs, delivery-related travel, and staff travel allowance</small> |
|   <small>├─ Utilities Expense</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Electricity, water, internet, and phone expenses</small> |
|   <small>└─ Waive off & Bad Debts</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Expense recognized for customer receivable amounts that are uncollectible</small> |
| **Other Expenses** | `Dr` | EXPENSE | Expenses that do not fall under standard operating categories |
|   <small>└─ Stock Loss & Adjustments</small> | `Dr` | EXPENSE | <small>Records losses and adjustments in medicine inventory due to damage, expiry, or theft</small> |

![MediFlux Pharmacy Expenses and COGS Ledgers](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/b90657dc-ad07-442a-8130-151204e39702-expenses.png)
*Caption: Expanded view of nested cost of goods sold, indirect expenses, and other operating costs in MediFlux.*

> **Note:** `Purchase discount` carries a `Cr` balance because it is a **contra-expense**. It reduces your total cost of purchases rather than adding to it.

---

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

> **[Warning: Creating duplicate accounts for the same purpose]** Before adding a custom ledger, search the existing list. If you create **Shop Rent** when **Rent Expense** already exists, your payments split across two ledgers and you will never see your true rent total in reports.

> **[Warning: Posting manual entries to auto-computed accounts]** **Current Year Earnings (Calculated)** is updated automatically by MediFlux. If you post a manual journal entry to it, your Profit & Loss will be permanently incorrect and cannot be fixed without reversing the entry.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions


  ### Can I add my own custom ledger?

Yes. Click **+ Edit** on the Ledgers page, then use the **Add New Accounts** section at the top of the Setup Chart of Accounts screen. You can create custom parent groups or child accounts as needed.
  ### Why does Current Year Earnings show (Calculated)?

This account is auto-computed by MediFlux. It aggregates all revenue and expense transactions for the current accounting period. You cannot post manual journal entries to it.
  ### What is the difference between Current Assets and Non-Current Assets?

**Current Assets** are expected to be converted to cash or used up within one year—cash, inventory, receivables, and prepaid expenses. **Non-Current Assets** are long-term holdings like equipment, furniture, vehicles, and property.
  ### Why do some accounts have a Cr normal balance?

In double-entry accounting, liability, equity, and revenue accounts normally carry credit balances. Asset and expense accounts normally carry debit balances. Contra accounts (like Purchase discount or Accumulated Depreciation) carry the opposite balance of their parent category to reduce the net amount.
  ### Can I rename or delete a ledger?

You can rename custom ledgers you created. System default ledgers cannot be renamed or deleted. To remove a custom ledger, uncheck it in the Setup Chart of Accounts and click **Update**.


---

## Next Steps


  * [Add a Journal Entry](/docs/accounting/add-journal-entry) - Learn how to manually record transactions that hit multiple ledgers.
  * [Ledger Reports](/docs/accounting/ledger) - View detailed transaction history and balances for any individual ledger.
  * [Trial Balance](/docs/accounting/trial-balance) - See a summary of all ledger balances to verify your books are in balance.
  * [Accounting Fundamentals](/docs/accounting/accounting-basics) - Review the basics of debits, credits, and financial statements.

docs/accounting/overview.title: Accounting
docs/accounting/overview.description: Manage pharmacy accounting in MediFlux. Track journal entries, ledgers, GST compliance, bank reconciliation, and financial reports easily.
docs/accounting/overview.body:
# Accounting

MediFlux **Accounting** helps you track every rupee that flows through your **pharmacy**. From daily journal entries to GST returns, from bank reconciliations to profit and loss statements, the module gives you a complete view of your financial health.

## What You Can Do

- View a financial **Dashboard** with key metrics and summaries.
- Manage **Accounts**, **Journals**, and **Ledgers** for detailed bookkeeping.
- Generate statutory reports such as **Trial Balance**, **Balance Sheet**, and **P&L Statement**.
- Reconcile **Bank Accounts** and track deposits, withdrawals, and transfers.
- Handle **ITC Reversals** for GST input credit adjustments.

> **[Note]** The Accounting module is disabled by default. You must enable it from **Settings** before you can access any accounting features.

## Enable the Accounting Module

Before you can use any accounting features, you need to turn on the module from your store settings.

1. **Open Settings**

   Go to **Settings** from the top navigation bar and select the **Modules** tab.

2. **Enable Accounting**

   Find the **Accounting Module** card and click **Enable**. The module becomes active immediately.

![MediFlux Enable Pharmacy Accounting Module](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/0e834c50-d64e-46ad-996c-f1e8b50bb8a8-enable-accounting.png)
*Caption: The Accounting Module appears in the Modules list with an Enable button for pharmacy bookkeeping in MediFlux.*

Once enabled, the **Accounting** section appears in the left sidebar with all its sub-menu items.

## Set Up Chart of Accounts

> **[Note]** **New to accounting?** We recommend reading [Accounting Basics](/docs/accounting/accounting-basics) first.
> It explains how accounts and account groups work, so the Chart of Accounts setup will be easier to understand.

The first time you open the Accounting section, MediFlux prompts you to initialize your Chart of Accounts. This step creates the default account heads required for double-entry bookkeeping.

1. **Open Accounting**

   Click **Accounting** in the left sidebar. The **Setup Chart of Accounts** screen opens.

2. **Review default accounts**

   MediFlux pre-selects essential account groups such as **Cash & Bank**, **Accounts Receivable**, and **Accounts Payable**. You can also add custom accounts like **Owner Capital** under **Add New Accounts**.

3. **Initialize**

   Click the **Initialize** button to create the accounts.

![MediFlux Setup Pharmacy Chart of Accounts](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/260e09df-5349-490f-b3d6-22dc6f504c9a-initialize-accounting.png)
*Caption: Review pre-selected account groups and add custom accounts before initializing pharmacy accounting in MediFlux.*

## Set Up System Balances

> **[Note]** This setup uses concepts such as assets, liabilities, tax credits, owner capital, and retained earnings. Read [Accounting Basics](/docs/accounting/accounting-basics) to understand what these terms mean and how they affect your books.

After initialization, a dialog opens to capture your opening balances. MediFlux automatically pulls values from your existing inventory and supplier data, so you only need to fill in a few fields.

1. **Review Assets**

   The **Assets** section shows pre-filled values:
       - **Drug Inventory value**: pulled from your current stock
       - **Non Drug Inventory value**: pulled from non-drug stock
       - **Accounts receivable**: outstanding customer dues

       Enter your **Cash in Hand** amount. This is the only physical cash field you need to fill manually.

2. **Add Bank Accounts**

   Click **+ Add bank** to register your bank accounts. For each account you must provide:
       - **Account Name**
       - **Account Number**
       - **Bank Name**
       - **IFSC Code**
       - **Branch**
       - **Account Type**: choose from `Savings`, `Current`, `FD`, or `Recurring Deposit`

       Check **Set as default bank account** if this account should be used as the default for transactions.

3. **Review Liabilities**

   The **Liabilities** section shows:
       - **Accounts payable**: outstanding supplier dues
       - **GST Output CGST**, **GST Output SGST**, **GST Output IGST**: tax liabilities

4. **Review Tax Credits**

   The **Tax Credits** section displays **GST Input CGST**, **GST Input SGST**, and **GST Input IGST** values that you can claim back.

5. **Add Owner Capital**

   Under **Owners & Partners**, click **Add owner** and enter the amount invested by each owner or partner. MediFlux creates a capital account for each owner automatically.

6. **Review Retained Earnings**

   **Retained earnings** is calculated automatically to balance your books. It represents profits or losses carried forward from previous years. You do not need to edit this value.

7. **Save and Continue**

   Click **Save & Continue** to complete the setup.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Accounting System Balances (Assets)](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/548a7386-7228-456c-ad2a-29aec68e7ffc-assests.png)
*Caption: Assets section with auto-filled inventory values and manual Cash in Hand entry for pharmacy accounting in MediFlux.*

### Add Owners and Partners

![MediFlux Pharmacy Owners and Partners Capital Entry](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/acc0c15b-5a9c-4eca-95a6-10f42fed2a38-owners-acc.png)
*Caption: Owner capital entry and automatically calculated retained earnings in MediFlux accounting.*

> **[Warning: Do not skip the opening balance setup]** If you skip or rush through the opening balance setup, your Trial Balance and Balance Sheet will not reconcile with your actual business position. Always verify the auto-filled inventory and GST values against your physical records.

## Navigating the Accounting Section

After setup, the Accounting sidebar gives you access to every financial tool in MediFlux.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Accounting Sidebar Menu](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/23d46373-852c-42d6-b23c-0e110ad6ae06-accounting-navigation.png)
*Caption: Full Accounting menu with Daybook, Journal Entry, Dashboard, Accounts, Journals, Ledger, Trial Balance, Balance Sheet, Bank Accounts, P&L Statement, and ITC Reversals.*

| Menu Item | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| **Daybook** | View all daily transactions in chronological order. |
| **Add Journal Entry** | Create manual journal entries for adjustments and transfers. |
| **Dashboard** | See financial KPIs, summaries, and trends at a glance. |
| **Accounts** | Browse and manage your Chart of Accounts. |
| **Journals** | View and filter all journal entries by date, account, or type. |
| **Ledger** | Drill down into individual account ledgers with running balances. |
| **Trial Balance** | Verify that total debits equal total credits. |
| **Balance Sheet** | View assets, liabilities, and equity at a point in time. |
| **Bank Accounts** | Manage bank accounts, balances, and reconcile statements. |
| **P&L Statement** | Track revenue, expenses, and net profit over a period. |
| **ITC Reversals** | Record and track GST input tax credit reversals. |

## Common Mistakes

> **[Warning: Entering the wrong Cash in Hand amount]** Count your physical cash carefully before typing the amount. An error here permanently affects your cash ledger and makes every future cash report incorrect.

> **[Warning: Skipping or rushing the opening balance setup]** If you skip verification of auto-filled inventory, GST, and payable values, your Trial Balance and Balance Sheet will not match your actual business position. Always cross-check the numbers against your physical records before clicking **Save & Continue**.

## FAQs


  ### Can I enable Accounting later if I have already made sales and purchases?

Yes. MediFlux will pull existing inventory values and outstanding balances automatically when you run the setup. However, you should still verify every auto-filled field against your physical records.
  ### What happens if I do not enter owner capital?

The missing capital will be absorbed into **Retained Earnings**, which may inflate or deflate your equity section. Enter accurate owner capital to keep your Balance Sheet correct.
  ### Can I add more bank accounts after setup?

Yes. Go to **Bank Accounts** from the Accounting sidebar and click **Add Bank Account** at any time.
  ### Why is Retained Earnings calculated automatically?

Retained Earnings is the balancing figure that makes Assets equal Liabilities plus Equity. It captures historical profits or losses that are not attributed to current owner capital.
  ### Do I need to set up Accounting to use GST reports?

Basic GST reports in MediFlux work without the Accounting module. However, advanced compliance features such as **ITC Reversals**, **Trial Balance**, and **Balance Sheet** require Accounting to be enabled and initialized.


## Next Steps


  * [Daybook](/docs/accounting/daybook) - View and understand your daily transaction log.
  * [Add Journal Entry](/docs/accounting/add-journal-entry) - Create manual journal entries for adjustments and transfers.
  * [Dashboard](/docs/accounting/dashboard) - Explore financial KPIs and summary cards.
  * Accounts - Manage your Chart of Accounts and account heads.

docs/accounting/profitandloss-statements.title: Profit & Loss
docs/accounting/profitandloss-statements.description: View revenue, expenses, and net profit for a selected period.
docs/accounting/profitandloss-statements.body:
# Profit & Loss

The **Profit & Loss Statement** (also called the Income Statement) shows how much money your pharmacy earned and spent during a specific period. It starts with total income, subtracts all expenses, and arrives at your net profit or loss. Unlike the Balance Sheet which is a snapshot, the P&L covers a period of time: a month, a quarter, or a full year.

Navigate here from the sidebar: **Accounting → Profit & Loss**.

> **[Note]** The screenshot below is from a mature store with active sales and purchases. A newly initialized store will show mostly zero values until transactions are recorded.

![Profit & Loss Statement](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/f1c6fc4c-0634-4017-b028-6d2f197fdb40-PL-overview.png)
*Caption: Income and Expenses panels with summary cards.*

---

## Filter and export

At the top of the page you control the period and can export the report.

| Control | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| **Search ledgers...** | Search for a specific income or expense account by name |
| **Date range** | Select the period for the report. Defaults to the current month. Click to open a calendar picker with quick options |
| **FY 2026-27** | Select the financial year. The date range automatically adjusts |
| **Export** | Download the P&L as **PDF Document** or **Excel Sheet** |

![ Filter and export options](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/2d5f0601-35a0-4638-b25d-16dbb09ef039-filter-searchbar-PL.png)
*Caption: Search and filter with custom dates or export in pdf or excel formats.*

---
## Top summary cards

Four cards at the top give you the headline numbers.

| Card | What it shows |
|------|---------------|
| **Total Income** | Sum of all revenue and other income lines in the selected period. Shows the count of income lines below |
| **Total Expenses** | Sum of all expense lines in the selected period. Shows the count of expense lines below |
| **Net Profit** | `Total Income − Total Expenses`. Green if positive (profit), red if negative (loss) |
| **Profit Margin** | `(Net Profit / Net Sales) × 100`. Shows how much profit you keep from every rupee of sales |

![Top summary cards](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/63a576d4-3a6b-409c-9876-8732409428e3-top-summarycards.png)
*Caption: Total Income, Total Expenses, Net Profit, and Profit Margin.*
---

## Income panel

The left panel lists every account that contributes to your income, grouped into categories.

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Ledger** | Account name. Parent groups can be expanded to reveal child accounts |
| **Amount** | The total for that account or group in the selected period |

### Revenue from Operations

This is your core business income from selling medicines and services.

| Account | Amount |
|---------|--------|
| **Revenue from Operations** | `₹18,980.11` |
| Retail Sales | `₹12,559.10` |
| Wholesale Sales | `₹9,411.51` |
| Returns & Discounts | `-₹2,990.50` |

> **[Note]** **Returns & Discounts** is a **contra-revenue** account with a negative amount. It reduces your total revenue because it represents sales that were returned or discounted.

### Other Income

Non-sales income such as bank interest, round-off gains, or supplier adjustments.

| Account | Amount |
|---------|--------|
| **Other Income** | `₹4.41` |
| Round Off Gain | `₹4.41` |

![Income panel](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/465be24a-b131-4c25-8f9e-d2f9f9910ef8-other-income-PL.png)
*Caption: Revenue from retail and wholesale sales, minus returns and discounts.*

**Total Income** is the sum of all income categories. In the example above, the total is `₹63,304.98`.

---

## Expenses panel

The right panel lists every cost of running the pharmacy, organized by category.

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Ledger** | Account name. Parent groups can be expanded to reveal child accounts |
| **Amount** | The total for that account or group in the selected period |

### Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)

Direct costs tied to the products you sold.

| Account | Amount |
|---------|--------|
| **Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)** | `₹20,501.06` |
| Opening Stock | `₹6,000.00` |
| Closing Stock | `₹10,74,432.37` |
| Change in Inventory | `-₹10,68,432.37` |

> **[Note]** **Closing Stock** and **Change in Inventory** work together. Closing Stock is the value of inventory at period end. Change in Inventory is the adjustment that converts your purchases into the actual cost of goods sold. A negative change in inventory means your stock level increased during the period, which reduces your COGS.

### Operating Expenses

Day-to-day costs of running the pharmacy.

| Account | Amount |
|---------|--------|
| **Employee Benefits Expense** | `–` |
| Salaries & Wages | `–` |
| Direct Labor | `–` |
| **Depreciation & Amortization Expense** | `–` |
| Depreciation | `–` |
| **Finance Cost** | `–` |
| Interest Expense | `–` |
| **Other Expenses** | `₹29,675.76` |

> **[Note]** Accounts showing `–` have no activity in the selected period. They will show amounts once transactions are posted to those ledgers.

### Partner Remuneration

Payments to business partners for their services.

| Account | Amount |
|---------|--------|
| **Partner Remuneration** | `₹10,000.00` |
| Partner Remuneration - Mehreen | `₹10,000.00` |

### Exceptional Items

One-off or unusual expenses that are not part of normal operations.

| Account | Amount |
|---------|--------|
| **Exceptional Items** | `₹200.00` |
| Exceptional Items | `₹200.00` |

![Expenses panel](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/7a23a49e-4075-4586-8048-c4d8850e93dd-expenses-PL.png)
*Caption: Cost of goods sold, operating costs, partner remuneration, and exceptional items.*

**Total Expenses** is the sum of all expense categories. In the example above, the total is `₹39,675.76`.

---
## Bottom summary cards

Below the two panels, four cards give you deeper insight into profitability.

| Card | Formula | What it tells you |
|------|---------|-------------------|
| **Net Profit** | `Revenue − Expenses` | The bottom line. What remains after all costs are deducted from all income |
| **Gross Profit** | `Income − COGS` | Profit after direct product costs. Shows how much you make before operating expenses |
| **Before Remu** | `Profit before remuneration` | Profit before partner salaries or drawings are deducted. Useful for partnerships |
| **PBT** | `Profit before tax` | Profit before income tax. This is the figure tax calculations are based on |

![Bottom summary cards](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/4c12f285-bff7-433e-a634-976d08c6f5bb-bottom-summarycards.png)
*Caption: Net Profit, Gross Profit, Before Remu, and PBT.*

In the example above:

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Net Profit** | `₹23,641.09` |
| **Gross Profit** | `₹42,803.92` |
| **Before Remu** | `₹33,641.09` |
| **PBT** | `₹23,641.09` |

> **[Note]** **Before Remu** is higher than **Net Profit** because partner remuneration (`₹10,000.00`) was deducted after the Before Remu stage. In this example, PBT equals Net Profit because no income tax has been recorded yet.

---

## How to read the Profit & Loss Statement

The P&L flows from top to bottom like a waterfall:

1. **Start with Income** – everything the business earned  
2. **Subtract COGS** – the direct cost of what was sold  
3. **Arrive at Gross Profit** – your margin on products  
4. **Subtract Operating Expenses** – rent, salaries, utilities, marketing  
5. **Subtract Partner Remuneration** – payments to partners  
6. **Arrive at PBT** – profit before tax  
7. **Subtract Tax** – income tax on profits  
8. **Arrive at Net Profit** – the final bottom line  

If **Net Profit** is positive, the business made money. If negative, it operated at a loss.

---

## Common mistakes

> **[Warning: Ignoring Returns & Discounts]** **Returns & Discounts** is a contra-revenue account. It reduces your total revenue but is easy to overlook. Always check this line. Net Sales = Gross Sales − Returns − Discounts. Ignoring it will make your income and profit margin look higher than they really are.

> **[Warning: Treating Closing Stock as an expense]** Closing Stock is an **asset**, not a cost. It reduces your COGS. Higher closing stock means lower COGS and higher gross profit. Treating it as an expense will understate your profitability.

---

## Frequently asked questions


  ### What is the difference between P&L and Balance Sheet?

The **Profit & Loss Statement** shows performance over a **period** of time – how much was earned and spent. The **Balance Sheet** shows position at a **point** in time – what the business owns and owes. The P&L explains how the equity on the Balance Sheet changed during the period.
  ### Why is my Profit Margin over 100%?

A profit margin over 100% usually means your **Net Sales** figure is very low compared to net profit. This can happen if you have large **Other Income** (like supplier adjustments or interest) that is not part of core sales, or if your COGS is negative due to large inventory increases. Focus on **Gross Profit** margin for a clearer picture of core business performance.
  ### What does Change in Inventory mean?

**Change in Inventory** is the adjustment that converts your opening stock and purchases into the actual cost of goods sold. If your inventory increased during the period, this figure is negative (reducing COGS). If inventory decreased, it is positive (increasing COGS). It ensures your P&L only reflects the cost of items actually sold, not everything purchased.
  ### Why do some accounts show a dash (–)?

A dash means there was no activity in that account during the selected period. The account exists in your Chart of Accounts but no transactions were posted to it. Once you record transactions, amounts will appear.
  ### Can I export the P&L for my accountant?

Yes. Click **Export** and choose **Excel Sheet** for a spreadsheet your accountant can work with, or **PDF Document** for a formatted report suitable for filing or presentation.


---

## Next steps


  * [Balance Sheet](/docs/accounting/balance-sheet) - View your assets, liabilities, and equity at a point in time.
  * [Trial Balance](/docs/accounting/trial-balance) - Verify that all ledger debits and credits are in balance.
  * [General Ledger](/docs/accounting/ledger) - Drill down into any income or expense account to see its transaction history.
  * [Ledgers](/docs/accounting/ledger.md) - Browse and manage your complete Chart of Accounts.

docs/accounting/trial-balance.title: Trial Balance
docs/accounting/trial-balance.description: Full view with opening balance, period activity, and closing balance for all ledger accounts.
docs/accounting/trial-balance.body:
# Trial Balance

A **Trial Balance** lists every ledger account in your Chart of Accounts along with its opening balance, total debits, total credits, and closing balance for a given period. It is the checkpoint that tells you whether your books are mathematically correct. If total debits equal total credits, your double-entry bookkeeping is in balance.

In MediFlux, the Trial Balance is generated automatically from all posted journal entries. You do not need to calculate anything manually.

Navigate here from the sidebar: **Accounting → Trial Balance**.

![Trial Balance page showing all account categories with debit and credit totals](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/0edfad56-3f63-47f1-9375-334dbe49b2b5-trial-balance.png)
*Caption: All ledger accounts with opening, activity, and closing balances.*

---

## Filter and export

Use the controls at the top of the page to control what appears in the report.

| Control | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| **Search ledgers...** | Search for a specific account by name |
| **Date range** | Select the period for the report. Defaults to the current month. Click to open a calendar picker with quick options |
| **FY 2026-27** | Select the financial year. The date range automatically adjusts |

![Date picker showing calendar with quick filter options](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/77f9f962-6da5-48be-8813-2ced0ec0fedc-TB-Filterepanel.png)
*Caption: Search by account name or Filter by dates etc.*
## Export the Trial Balance

Click **Export** in the top-right corner to download the report.

| Option | What you get |
|--------|--------------|
| **PDF Document** | A formatted report suitable for sharing or printing |
| **Excel Sheet** | A spreadsheet you can open and analyse further |

The export respects the current date range and any search filter you have applied.

![Export dropdown showing PDF Document and Excel Sheet options](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/5ecbde31-432a-4607-a9d3-fcf7305b4c58-TB-EXPORT.png)
*Caption: Download the trial balance as PDF or Excel.*

---

## Category filter cards

Below the search and date filters, six cards act as quick filters for each account category. Click any card to show only the accounts that belong to that group.

| Card | What it filters |
|------|-----------------|
| **Current Asset** | All current asset accounts |
| **Non-Current Asset** | All non-current asset accounts |
| **Current Liability** | All current liability accounts |
| **Equity** | All equity accounts |
| **Revenue** | All revenue accounts |
| **Expense** | All expense accounts |

### Each card also shows:
- Total debit amount
- Total credit amount
- Number of ledgers in that category

Click the same card again to clear the filter and return to the full list.

![Category filter cards on Trial Balance](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/be69dfe5-8879-4306-8b67-36793b55bf86-filterCards-tb.png)
*Caption: Click a card (for example Non-Current Asset) to filter the table to only that category.*

> **[Note]** In the example above, the **Non-Current Asset** card is selected, so the table shows only Fixed Assets and Property/Building.
---

## Total Debits and Total Credits

Two large cards sit below the category cards:

| Card | What it shows |
|------|---------------|
| **Total Debits** | The sum of all debit columns across every account in the selected period |
| **Total Credits** | The sum of all credit columns across every account in the selected period |

These two numbers must be **exactly equal**. If they match, the trial balance tallies. If they do not match, there is a bookkeeping error that must be resolved.

---

## Accounts table

The main table lists every parent account group. Click the arrow next to any parent to expand it and see its child accounts.

| Column | What it means |
|--------|---------------|
| **Ledger** | Account name with `Dr` or `Cr` badge. Parent groups can be expanded to reveal children |
| **Type** | Color-coded category tag such as `CURRENT ASSET`, `CURRENT LIABILITY`, `EQUITY`, `REVENUE`, or `EXPENSE` |
| **Opening** | The account balance at the start of the selected period |
| **Debit** | Total amount debited to this account during the period |
| **Credit** | Total amount credited to this account during the period |
| **Closing** | The account balance at the end of the period |

### How the closing balance is calculated

| Normal balance | Formula |
|----------------|---------|
| **Debit Normal** (Assets, Expenses) | `Closing = Opening + Debit − Credit` |
| **Credit Normal** (Liabilities, Equity, Revenue) | `Closing = Opening + Credit − Debit` |

--- 

#### Example from a live store

| Account | Type | Opening | Debit | Credit | Closing | Calculation |
|---------|------|---------|-------|--------|---------|-------------|
| **Accounts Receivable** | CURRENT ASSET | `–` | `₹1,08,589.00` | `₹14,007.69` | `₹94,581.31 Dr` | `0 + 1,08,589.00 − 14,007.69` |
| **Cash & Bank** | CURRENT ASSET | `–` | `₹47,83,340.86` | `₹53,053.06` | `₹47,30,287.80 Dr` | `0 + 47,83,340.86 − 53,053.06` |
| **Accounts Payable** | CURRENT LIABILITY | `₹41,370.00 Cr` | `₹30,595.47` | `₹2,89,925.10` | `₹3,00,699.63 Cr` | `41,370 + 2,89,925.10 − 30,595.47` |
| **Equity** | EQUITY | `–` | `₹10,773.80` | `₹58,43,742.89` | `₹58,32,969.09 Cr` | `0 + 58,43,742.89 − 10,773.80` |
| **Expenses** | EXPENSE | `–` | `₹32,218.26` | `₹2,564.67` | `₹29,653.59 Dr` | `0 + 32,218.26 − 2,564.67` |
| **Revenue** | REVENUE | `–` | `₹3,035.50` | `₹66,340.48` | `₹63,304.98 Cr` | `0 + 66,340.48 − 3,035.50` |


![Expanded Trial Balance showing parent and child accounts with all columns](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/6c4b9c6a-ce2e-4763-800e-1243cdcbb72d-trial-balance-example.png)
*Caption: Parent groups with child accounts and full column breakdown.*
> **[Note]** In the example above, the **Equity** parent shows a debit of `₹10,773.80`. This comes from debit entries such as **Owner's Drawings** or **Partner Remuneration**, which reduce the total equity balance.

---

## Why the trial balance must tally

Every transaction affects at least two accounts, and the total debits always equal the total credits in every journal entry. When you add up all debits and all credits across every account for the period, the two sides must still be equal.

| Principle | Explanation |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Every transaction is balanced** | A sale debits Cash or Accounts Receivable and credits Revenue. A purchase debits Inventory and credits Cash or Accounts Payable. The two sides always match |
| **Contra accounts preserve the balance** | When a sale is returned, Revenue is debited and Cash or Accounts Receivable is credited. Both sides still match |
| **The total row proves correctness** | If `Total Debits = Total Credits`, every journal entry was posted correctly |

### What if the totals do not match?

| Error | What to check |
|-------|---------------|
| **Missing journal entry** | A transaction was recorded in one account but not the other |
| **Wrong amount posted** | The debit and credit sides of a journal entry were entered with different amounts |
| **Entry posted twice** | The same journal entry was posted twice |
| **Account not initialized** | A ledger was used in a transaction but was not properly set up in the Chart of Accounts |

> **[Note]** MediFlux prevents most of these errors at the source. When you create a journal entry, the system requires that total debits equal total credits before the entry can be saved.

---

## Newly initialized stores

If you have just enabled the Accounting module, your Trial Balance will look simple. Most accounts will show zero opening balances, and only a few accounts will have activity from the initial setup.

![Trial Balance for a newly initialized store showing minimal activity](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/fb21c132-5c7c-4e90-8879-7647c2a8eec8-new-accounting-tb.png)
*Caption: Only initialization entries are present. Total Debits equal Total Credits.*

In a typical new store:
- **Current Asset** shows activity from **Inventory** and **Tax Assets**
- **Current Liability** shows activity from **Accounts Payable**
- **Equity** shows the balancing figure
- **Total Debits** and **Total Credits** are equal

As you record sales, purchases, and journal entries, these numbers will grow and more categories will appear.

---

## Common mistakes

> **[Warning: Panicking when a category shows both debit and credit]** A category like **Current Asset** showing both green (debit) and red (credit) does not mean your books are wrong. Contra-assets such as **Purchase Return** and **Accumulated Depreciation** naturally carry credit balances. Expand the parent group to see which accounts are causing it.

> **[Warning: Comparing Trial Balance directly to your bank statement]** The Trial Balance includes non-cash accounts like **Accounts Receivable** and **Accounts Payable**. It is not a cash report. To reconcile your bank balance, open the **Cash & Bank** ledger or use the **Balance Sheet**.

---

## Frequently asked questions


  ### What is the difference between Trial Balance and Balance Sheet?

The **Trial Balance** lists every ledger account with its activity and balance. It is an internal tool used to verify that debits equal credits. The **Balance Sheet** is a financial statement that groups accounts into Assets, Liabilities, and Equity to show the financial position of the business at a point in time.
  ### Why does the Current Asset card show a credit amount?

This happens because of **contra-asset** accounts like **Purchase Return** or **Accumulated Depreciation**, which carry credit balances. These credits reduce the net value of your assets.
  ### Can I export the Trial Balance?

Yes. Click **Export** and choose either **PDF Document** for a formatted report or **Excel Sheet** for further analysis.
  ### What period should I select?

Most businesses run the Trial Balance monthly. You can also run it for a quarter, half-year, or full financial year by adjusting the date range or selecting a different fiscal year.
  ### Does a balanced Trial Balance mean there are no errors?

A balanced Trial Balance confirms that total debits equal total credits. It does not catch errors of omission (a transaction was completely forgotten) or errors of principle (a transaction was posted to the wrong type of account).


---

## Next steps


  * [General Ledger](/docs/accounting/ledger) - Drill down into any account to see its full transaction history.
  * [Balance Sheet](/docs/accounting/balance-sheet) - View your assets, liabilities, and equity in a formal financial statement.
  * [Profit and Loss Statement](/docs/accounting/profitandloss-statements.md) - See your revenue, expenses, and net profit for the period.
  * [Ledgers](/docs/accounting/ledger.md) - Browse and manage your complete Chart of Accounts.

docs/clinics/appointments.title: Appointments
docs/clinics/appointments.description: Manage patient appointments, share a public booking link, and track appointment status and payments.
docs/clinics/appointments.body:
# Appointments

The **Appointments** page is where every patient appointment booked with your clinic's doctors is tracked, whether added manually by you or booked by a patient through your public booking link.

---

## Searching And Filtering Appointments
The search bar lets you search by **patient name, phone, or email**.

Click **Filters** to open the **Filters** panel:

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Doctor** | Filter by a specific doctor |
| **Schedule** | Filter by a specific schedule |
| **Status** | Filter by appointment status |
| **Appointment Date Range** | This Week, This Month, Today, or a custom From/To range |
| **Follow-up Date Range** | This Week, This Month, Today, or a custom From/To range |
| **Sort By** | Sort by Appointment Date, in ascending or descending order |

Click **Apply Filters** to apply, or **Reset** to clear all filters.

You can also control how many appointments are shown per page, and use the refresh icon to reload the list.

![Search bar and Filters](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/a96b4707-37ad-43e3-ab6d-1a2e4d1e3088-appointment-searchbar.png)
*Caption: Search appointments by patient details and apply multiple filters*

---

## Public Booking Link
Below the search bar, MediFlux gives you a **Public Booking Link**, a link you can share with patients so they can book appointments themselves, without you needing to add them manually.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Copy** | Copies the booking link |
| **Open Link** | Opens the booking link in a new tab |
| **Show QR Code** | Displays a scannable QR code version of the link, which can also be downloaded |

![Public Booking Link](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/34af717a-9f79-403e-92a9-7141ce24d64e-booking-link.png)
*Caption: Copy, open, or generate a QR code for your public booking link*
---
![QR Code view](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/a66f0517-36d9-4d05-b061-2616c58b3ea6-booking-QR.png)
*Caption: Scannable QR code that patients can use to book appointments*

---

## Adding An Appointment
Click **+ Add Appointment** to open a 4-step form:

![Add Appointment button](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/74001ccb-0a2f-4617-90b8-c517945cc99f-create-appointment-form.png)
*Caption: Button to start creating a new appointment*

1. **Schedule**

   Search by doctor name or speciality, or use **Filter by Days** to narrow doctors down by their available days. Only doctors with a matching schedule are shown, along with their available days and consultation fee.

2. **Date**

   Select an appointment date from the calendar. Only dates matching the selected doctor's available days can be chosen.

3. **Time**

   Select an available time slot for the chosen date. Each slot shows its start and end time.

4. **Details**

   | Field | Description |
       | --- | --- |
       | **Patient** | Search for an existing patient by name or phone (minimum 3 characters), required |
       | **Appointment Type** | e.g., Consultation |
       | **Symptoms** | Enter each symptom on a new line |
       | **Chief Complaint** | Describe the main reason for the visit |
       | **Notes** | Any additional notes |
       | **Consultation Fee** | Pulled from the selected schedule |
       | **Discount** | Discount applied, if any |
       | **Final Amount** | Calculated after discount |
       | **Paid Amount** | Amount paid at the time of booking |
       | **Payment Method** | e.g., Cash |

Click **Create Appointment** to save, or **Cancel** to discard.

![Add Appointment form](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/74001ccb-0a2f-4617-90b8-c517945cc99f-create-appointment-form.png)
*Caption: 4-step form for creating a new appointment with schedule, date, time, and patient details*
---
## Appointment Cards
Once created, each appointment appears as a card with:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Patient name and phone** | The patient the appointment is for |
| **Doctor** | The doctor the appointment is with |
| **Date and Time** | When the appointment is scheduled |
| **Status** | Scheduled, Confirmed, or Cancelled |
| **Payment status** | Shows if payment is Partially Paid, along with the remaining amount, and an **Add Payment** button |
| **Appointment Type** | e.g., Routine Checkup |

![Appointment card](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/da7f006e-d682-4ab8-8b2c-1f64f87a7ce9-appointment-cards.png)
*Caption: Appointment card showing patient details, doctor, time, status, and payment information*

### Updating Appointment Status
Click the status dropdown on any appointment card to change it between **Scheduled**, **Confirmed**, and **Cancelled**.

---

## FAQs


  ### Can patients book appointments themselves?

Yes, share your **Public Booking Link** (or its QR code) with patients, and they can book an appointment directly without you needing to add it manually.
  ### What happens if I mark an appointment as Cancelled?

The appointment's status changes to Cancelled and it's no longer treated as an active booking, though it remains on record.
  ### Can I record a partial payment for an appointment?

Yes, the appointment card shows a **Partially Paid** status with the remaining amount, and you can click **Add Payment** to record further payments.


---

## Common Mistake To Avoid
> **[Warning: Always check availability before booking]** Adding an appointment without checking the doctor's actual availability first can lead to double-bookings. Always go through the Schedule → Date → Time steps rather than assuming a slot is free.

---

## After The Appointment

  * [Pending Bookings](/docs/clinics/pending-bookings) - Confirm or reject new appointment requests.
  * [Prescriptions](/docs/clinics/prescriptions) - View prescriptions written during this appointment.
  * [Doctors](/docs/clinics/doctors) - View the doctor who handled this appointment.
  * [Schedules](/docs/clinics/schedules) - Adjust availability if appointments are overbooked.

docs/clinics/doctor-dashboard.title: Doctor Dashboard
docs/clinics/doctor-dashboard.description: A quick look at what a doctor can see and do once their account is created, including prescriptions, schedules, and appointments.
docs/clinics/doctor-dashboard.body:
# Doctor Dashboard

Once an admin creates a **user account** for a doctor from the Doctors page, the doctor gets their own login to MediFlux. Signing in takes them straight into the **Clinic** section, scoped to just their own work: their prescriptions, their schedules, and their appointments.

> **[Note]** A doctor's login only gives them access to the **Clinic** section. They won't be able to view or manage other parts of MediFlux like Sales, Inventory, or Customers.

---

## The Doctor Sidebar
Doctors see a simplified version of the Clinic sidebar, with five sections:

| Section | What it's for |
| --- | --- |
| **Dashboard** | Overview of appointments, prescriptions, and schedules |
| **My Prescriptions** | All prescriptions the doctor has issued |
| **My Signature & Stamp** | Upload a signature and stamp for prescriptions |
| **My Schedules** | View and manage availability schedules |
| **Appointments** | View and consult patient appointments |

![Doctor sidebar](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/a75c1a08-1612-4ee1-b17e-0f214ac995e5-doctor-sidebar.png)
*Caption: Simplified Clinic sidebar with Dashboard, Prescriptions, Signature and Stamp, Schedules, and Appointments*

---

## Dashboard
The Dashboard is the doctor's landing page after login. It opens with a welcome banner showing the doctor's name and speciality, followed by four stat cards:

| Card | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Today's Appointments** | Number of appointments scheduled for today |
| **This Week** | Number of appointments scheduled this week |
| **This Month** | Number of appointments scheduled this month |
| **Total Prescriptions** | Total prescriptions issued by the doctor |

![Doctor dashboard overview](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/a7442ee1-097e-4f2e-aa92-de39f077e3b9-lets_us_be.png)
*Caption: Welcome banner with stat cards for appointments and prescriptions*

Below the stat cards are three panels:

| Panel | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Today's Appointments** | A list of today's appointments, or "No appointments scheduled for today" if there are none |
| **Upcoming Appointments** | A list of future appointments, or "No upcoming appointments" if there are none |
| **Active Schedules** | The doctor's active availability schedules, showing fee and day |

Each of the Today and Upcoming Appointments panels has a **View All** link, and the Active Schedules panel has a **Manage Schedules** link.

![Active schedules and appointment panels](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/305ffa83-e633-479e-ad34-3337dc04be68-appointment-panel.png)
*Caption: Today's appointments, upcoming appointments, and active schedules panels*

### Quick Actions
At the bottom of the Dashboard, four shortcut cards let the doctor jump straight into common tasks:

| Shortcut | Takes you to |
| --- | --- |
| **New Prescription** | Start a new prescription |
| **View Appointments** | The Appointments page |
| **My Prescriptions** | The My Prescriptions page |
| **My Schedules** | The My Schedules page |

![Dashboard quick action shortcuts](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/35861ef4-291f-47cb-a455-83eb940630fc-quick-actions.png)
*Caption: Shortcut cards for New Prescription, View Appointments, My Prescriptions, and My Schedules*

---

## My Prescriptions
This page lists every prescription the doctor has issued.

The header shows the **Total** count of prescriptions, and an **Add Prescription** button to start a new one. Below that is a search bar that lets the doctor search by **patient name, medicine, or notes**.

The **Prescription History** table shows:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Patient** | Patient's name, with their phone number shown below it |
| **Date & Time** | When the prescription was issued |
| **Medicines** | Medicines prescribed, shown as tags |
| **Actions** | Quick action menu for that prescription |

![My Prescriptions page](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/69cd4f35-2fee-45ab-b379-eaf20ab76846-my-prescription.png)
*Caption: Prescription history with patient details, date, medicines, and actions*

---

## Writing A Prescription
A prescription can be started in two ways:

- Clicking **Add Prescription** on the My Prescriptions page, or **New Prescription** on the Dashboard. This opens a **Create Prescription** screen to select a patient first.
- Clicking **Consult** on an appointment from the Appointments page. This skips patient selection and opens the prescription form directly, pre-filled with that patient's details.

### Selecting A Patient
When starting from **Add Prescription** or **New Prescription**, the doctor first sees a **Create Prescription** screen to choose who the prescription is for:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Search bar** | Search existing patients by **name, phone, or address** |
| **Recent Patients** | Quick-select cards for recently seen patients, showing name, phone, and address |
| **Add New Patient** | Create a new patient record if they aren't in the system yet |

![Create Prescription, Select Patient](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/eb78f2e8-6686-4bbf-b4aa-76c1e473e661-add-new-patient.png)
*Caption: Add a new patient*

Once a patient is selected (or added), the doctor moves into the prescription form itself.

The prescription form includes:

| Section | What it captures |
| --- | --- |
| **Patient Information** | Name, Age, Gender, Phone, Date, Address (with a "Change Patient" link) |
| **Complaints** | Patient's complaints |
| **History** | Relevant medical history |
| **Diagnosis** | Diagnosis notes |
| **Investigations** | Investigations ordered |
| **Observation** | Observation notes |
| **Medications** | Medicine name, frequency, and duration |
| **Vitals** | BP, Weight, Height, Temp, Pulse, SpO2 |
| **Follow-up Date** | A date picker, plus quick options: 1 Day, 3 Days, 1 Week, 2 Weeks |
| **Remarks** | Additional notes or instructions |
| **Doctor's Signature** | Auto-filled from My Signature & Stamp, if uploaded |

![Prescription form](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/e6cd207a-6a2b-4328-a0bd-25d99b67fe22-prescription-form.png)
*Caption: Complete prescription form with patient info, complaints, diagnosis, medications, vitals, and follow-up*

Once filled in, click **Save & Print** to save the prescription, or **Cancel** to discard it.

---

## My Signature & Stamp
Doctors can upload a signature and a stamp image, which are then automatically included on every prescription they issue.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Signature** | Image of the doctor's signature |
| **Stamp** | Image of the doctor's clinic stamp |

![My Signature & Stamp page](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/d4acf08d-1800-44d9-8bc3-398b2b7dcb90-signature-stamp.png)
*Caption: Upload signature and stamp images for automatic inclusion on prescriptions*

---

## My Schedules
This page shows the doctor's own availability schedules.

The header includes an **Add Schedule** button, a search bar (search by **doctor name or speciality**), and a **Filters** button.

Each schedule card shows:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Name & Speciality** | Doctor's name and speciality |
| **Fee** | Consultation fee for the schedule |
| **Day** | Day(s) the schedule applies to |
| **Status** | Active, Draft, Inactive, or Archived |

![My Schedules page](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/f427eb23-2ccd-4b5b-b522-62cfc69e566d-my-schedule-page.png)
*Caption: Schedule cards showing name, speciality, fee, day, and status*

### Row Actions
Click the **⋮** menu on a schedule card to:

| Action | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **View** | View the schedule's full details |
| **Edit** | Opens the schedule for editing |
| **Booking Link** | Get a shareable link for booking this schedule |

![Schedule row actions menu](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/669f8bfa-6405-4c83-b13e-bb2465fe35de-row-actions.png)
*Caption: View, Edit, and Booking Link options for each schedule*

### Filtering Schedules
Clicking **Filters** opens a panel to refine the schedule list:

| Filter | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Days of Week** | Filter by one or more days (Sunday to Saturday) |
| **Time Slot** | Filter by Start Time and End Time |
| **Status** | Filter by Active, Draft, Inactive, or Archived |
| **Consultation Fee Range** | Filter by a Minimum and Maximum fee |
| **Sort By** | Sort results (e.g., Recently Added), in Ascending or Descending order |

Use **Reset** to clear all filters, or **Apply Filters** to run the search.

![Filter & Sort panel](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/51ff880a-d156-4cba-ba2b-91ef1c37e6b0-filter-button.png)
*Caption: Filter schedules by days, time slot, status, fee range, and sort order*

### Adding A Schedule
Click **+ Add Schedule** to open the **Add New Schedule** form:

![Add Schedule button](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/0ddbb687-72ac-4fa3-a619-6475a16cd22c-add-schedule.png)
*Caption: Button to open the Add New Schedule form*

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Select Doctor** | The doctor this schedule applies to, required |
| **Consultation Fee** | Fee charged for this schedule, required |
| **Schedule Type** | **Slot Based** (patients book specific time slots) or **Token Based** (patients book by date, with a max per day) |
| **Recurring Schedule** | Add one or more days this schedule repeats on |
| **Break Times** | Add break periods within the schedule |
| **Exception Dates** | Add specific dates when the doctor is unavailable, overriding the recurring schedule |
| **Booking Rules** | Configure rules around how patients can book this schedule |
| **Schedule Poster** | Optional image shown on the schedule's share link |
| **Effective From** | Date the schedule starts applying from |
| **Notes** | Additional notes about the schedule |

Once filled in, click **Create Schedule** to save it, or **Cancel** to discard it.

![Add New Schedule form](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/40816682-962a-4f9b-b2dc-70542ed4a4aa-add-schedule-form.png)
*Caption: Complete form for creating a new availability schedule with all fields*

---

## Appointments
This page lists all of the doctor's patient appointments.

The header includes a search bar (search by **patient name, phone, or email**), a **Filters** button, a per-page dropdown, and a refresh button.

![Appointments page](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/38d3adde-9e51-435a-96ae-b89b9c80a06a-appointments.png)
*Caption: Doctor's appointments list with search, filters, and refresh options*

Each appointment card shows:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Patient** | Patient's name, with phone number shown below it |
| **Doctor** | Doctor assigned to the appointment |
| **Date & Time** | Scheduled date and time |
| **Status** | e.g., Scheduled |
| **Payment Status** | e.g., Partially Paid, with the remaining amount and an **Add Payment** button |
| **Type** | Appointment type tag, e.g., Routine Checkup |
| **Consult** | Opens the prescription form for this appointment |

---

## Next Steps

 
  * [Prescriptions](/docs/clinics/prescriptions) - Learn more about issuing and managing prescriptions.
  * [Schedules](/docs/clinics/schedules) - Configure availability and booking rules for doctors.
  * [Appointments](/docs/clinics/appointments) - Manage patient appointments and booking requests.
  * [Pending Bookings](/docs/clinics/pending-bookings) - Review and approve online booking requests from patients.

docs/clinics/doctors.title: Doctors
docs/clinics/doctors.description: View and manage doctor profiles, search by qualification or speciality, and add new doctors to your clinic.
docs/clinics/doctors.body:
# Doctors

The **Doctors** page is your directory of every doctor associated with your pharmacy's clinic. It gives you a quick view of each doctor's contact details, qualifications, and specialities, with the ability to search, filter, and manage profiles from one place.

---

## Searching Doctors
The search bar lets you search by **name, phone, email, or registration number**. Just start typing and the list filters instantly.

![Doctors search bar](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/bc81105a-8c70-4875-a00f-78a2fad20e4b-searching-doctors.png)
*Caption: Search for doctors by name, phone, email, or registration number*

---

## Filtering By Qualification And Speciality
Two dropdowns next to the search bar let you narrow the list further:

| Filter | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **All Qualifications** | Filter doctors by a specific qualification |
| **All Specialities** | Filter doctors by a specific speciality |

You can type in either dropdown to search for a qualification or speciality, and select a match from the list.

![Qualifications and Specialities dropdowns](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/849c120f-9a50-4bbb-af59-bff9b9e65b34-drop-down.png)
*Caption: Filter doctors by qualification and speciality using the dropdowns*

---

## The Doctors Table
| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Name** | Doctor's name, with their registration number shown below it |
| **Phone** | Contact number |
| **Email** | Email address |
| **Qualification** | Qualifications held by the doctor, shown as tags (e.g., MBBS, MD) |
| **Speciality** | Speciality or specialities the doctor practices in |
| **Actions** | Quick action menu for that doctor row |

![Doctors table](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/adfcc8a1-3a2c-4382-8543-e802c8497b1f-doctors-table.png)
*Caption: Doctors table showing all columns and data*

---

## Sorting The Table
The **Name**, **Qualification**, and **Speciality** columns are sortable. Click the column header to toggle between ascending and descending order.

---

## Row Actions
Click the **⋮** menu on any doctor row to:

| Action | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Edit** | Opens the doctor's profile for editing |
| **Delete** | Removes the doctor from your clinic |

![Row actions menu](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/383486f9-7cc2-4bd6-b1e8-065cc1f36e30-actions.png)
*Caption: Row actions menu with Edit and Delete options*

---

## Pagination
At the bottom of the table, you can move between pages and choose how many doctors to display per page using the **Items per page** dropdown.

---

## Viewing A Doctor'S Profile
Click on any doctor's name to open their full profile, showing:

| Section | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Header** | Doctor's name, phone, email, who created the profile, and when it was last edited |
| **Doctor Information** | Registration Number, Phone, Email, and Status |
| **Qualifications** | All qualifications, shown as tags |
| **Specialities** | All specialities, shown as tags |

![Doctor detail page](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/f9067d5d-75db-479a-9fd5-61bf2856b365-doctors-detailed-page.png)
*Caption: Doctor profile page showing all sections and information*

---

## Adding A Doctor
Click **+ Add Doctor** at the top of the page to open the **Add New Doctor** form:

![Add Doctor button](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/a7079db4-8da7-4230-80a6-2a1215da4ee2-add-doctor.png)
*Caption: Add Doctor button located at the top of the page*

### The Doctors Form
| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Full Name** | Doctor's full name, required |
| **Registration Number** | The doctor's official medical registration number, required |
| **Phone Number** | Contact number, required |
| **Email Address** | Contact email, required |
| **Qualifications** | Comma-separated list of qualifications (e.g., MBBS, MD, MS) |
| **Specialities** | Comma-separated list of specialities (e.g., Cardiology, Neurology) |

Qualifications and specialities you type in are added to the list and can be searched or filtered by later using the dropdowns on this page.

![Add New Doctor form](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/9334c73a-dba7-4ea9-a681-72a505f282ba-doctors-form.png)
*Caption: Add New Doctor form with all required and optional fields*

### Creating A User Account For The Doctor
Checking **Create User Account for this Doctor** creates a login for the doctor, allowing them to access MediFlux directly under their own account.

> **[Note]** A doctor's login only gives them access to the **Clinic** section, they won't be able to view or manage other parts of MediFlux like Sales, Inventory, or Customers.

Once all required fields are filled in, click **Add Doctor** to save the profile, or **Cancel** to discard it.

---

## FAQs

  ### Can I search for a doctor by their registration number?

Yes. The search bar covers **name**, **phone**, **email**, and **registration number**, so any of these will work.
  ### Do I need to fill in Qualifications and Specialities when adding a doctor?

No. Only **Full Name**, **Registration Number**, **Phone Number**, and **Email Address** are required. **Qualifications** and **Specialities** are optional but recommended, since they let you filter and search doctors more effectively later.
  ### What happens if I delete a doctor?

The doctor is removed from your **Doctors** list. Records linked to them elsewhere, like prescriptions or appointments, may still reference their name historically.

---

## Common Mistake To Avoid
> **[Warning: Don't skip Qualifications and Specialities]** Without these, the doctor won't show up when filtering by qualification or speciality, making them harder to find and schedule later. Fill them in during setup to keep your clinic directory fully searchable.

---

## After Adding A Doctor

  * [Schedules](/docs/clinics/schedules) - Set when this doctor is available for appointments.
  * [Prescriptions](/docs/clinics/prescriptions) - View prescriptions this doctor will issue.
  * [Appointments](/docs/clinics/appointments) - See appointments booked with this doctor.
  * [Add Retail Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Bill patients after their appointment with this doctor.

docs/clinics/overview.title: Clinic Module
docs/clinics/overview.description: Manage your pharmacy clinic in MediFlux. Track doctor profiles, prescriptions, schedules, and patient appointments from one central hub.
docs/clinics/overview.body:
# Clinic Module

The **Clinic** section brings your **pharmacy clinic management** into **MediFlux**, connecting the doctors who consult at your store, the prescriptions they write, their availability, and patient appointments. If your pharmacy runs a clinic alongside its retail counter, this is where that side of the business is managed.

---

## What You Can Do In Clinic
- **Maintain a directory of doctors:** Store qualifications, specialities, registration numbers, and contact details for every doctor associated with your clinic.
- **Search and filter doctors:** Quickly find a doctor by name, phone, email, registration number, qualification, or speciality.
- **Track prescriptions:** Keep a record of prescriptions issued by your doctors.
- **Set doctor schedules:** Define when each doctor is available, so appointments only get booked into open slots.
- **Manage appointments:** Track every appointment booked with a doctor at your clinic.
- **Review pending bookings:** Confirm or reject new booking requests before they become scheduled appointments.

---

## Navigating the Clinic Section
The **Clinic** section in the left sidebar expands into five main pages:

| Page | What it's for |
| --- | --- |
| **Doctors** | Your directory of every doctor associated with the clinic: search, filter by qualification or speciality, and manage individual profiles |
| **Prescriptions** | Every prescription issued by your doctors, kept on record and linked back to the doctor who wrote it |
| **Schedules** | Set when each doctor is available, so appointments can only be booked into open time slots |
| **Appointments** | A running log of every appointment booked with a doctor at your clinic |
| **Pending Bookings** | New booking requests waiting on your confirmation before they turn into scheduled appointments |

![MediFlux Pharmacy Clinic Module Sidebar Navigation](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/ee56b7fa-3ab8-4245-9ba4-235c0fc896a1-clinic-sidebar.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux left sidebar showing Doctors, Prescriptions, Schedules, Appointments, and Pending Bookings for clinic management.*

---

## Doctors
The **Doctors** page is your complete doctor directory. View all associated doctors with their qualifications, specialities, registration numbers, and contact details. Search by name, phone, email, or registration number. Filter by qualification or speciality. Click any doctor to view their full profile, prescription history, and schedule.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Doctor Directory](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/79127e50-c5cf-4714-ae30-df0655c7f6e1-doctors-section.png)
*Caption: Complete pharmacy doctor directory with search, filters, and detailed clinical profiles in MediFlux.*

---

## Prescriptions
The **Prescriptions** page keeps a record of every prescription issued by your doctors. Each prescription is linked back to the doctor who wrote it and the patient it was for. Search by patient name, doctor, or date. View prescription details including medicines prescribed, dosage instructions, and issue date.

---

## Schedules
The **Schedules** page lets you define when each doctor is available for appointments. Set recurring weekly slots, add one-off availability, or block out leave days. Appointments can only be booked into open time slots, preventing double-booking and ensuring patients see accurate availability.

![MediFlux Doctor Schedules and Availability](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/5e08b577-8ff4-4365-9851-1533cbcf86f5-schedules-section.png)
*Caption: Set pharmacy doctor availability with recurring slots and blocked leave days in MediFlux.*

---

## Appointments
The **Appointments** page is a running log of every appointment booked with a doctor at your clinic. View upcoming and past appointments with patient details, doctor, time slot, and status. Search by patient name, doctor, or date. Filter by status: confirmed, completed, cancelled, or no-show.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Clinic Appointments Log](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/cddee89c-cacc-47d2-b2d9-ece330f58dba-appointments-section.png)
*Caption: Track all booked patient appointments with doctor details and time slots in MediFlux.*

---

## Pending Bookings
The **Pending Bookings** page shows new appointment requests waiting for your confirmation. Review each request, check patient details and preferred time slots, and choose to **Confirm** or **Reject**. Once confirmed, bookings move to the Appointments page as scheduled.

![MediFlux Pending Clinic Booking Requests](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/5b1e718e-f45f-4e67-9191-505238d75c5d-pending-bookings.png)
*Caption: Review and confirm or reject new patient appointment requests before they are scheduled in MediFlux.*

---

## Doctor Status
Every doctor profile carries a **Status**, shown as **Active** on their profile. This reflects whether the doctor is currently associated with your clinic and available to be scheduled, prescribed against, or booked for appointments.

---

## FAQs

  ### Do I need to run a clinic to use MediFlux?

No. The Clinic section is optional and only relevant if your pharmacy has doctors consulting on-site or associated with your store. If you're purely retail, you can ignore this section entirely.
  ### Can a doctor log into MediFlux themselves?

When adding a doctor, you have the option to create a user account for them, which would allow them to log in. This is configured from the Add Doctor form.
  ### What's the difference between Appointments and Pending Bookings?

Pending Bookings are new requests that haven't been confirmed yet. Once confirmed, they move to Appointments as scheduled.
  ### Can I remove a doctor from the clinic?

Yes, doctor profiles can be deleted from the Doctors page. Keep in mind this may affect historical records like prescriptions and appointments linked to that doctor.


---

## Connect Clinic To Sales

  * [Doctors](/docs/clinics/doctors) - Manage your clinic's doctor directory.
  * [Add Retail Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Bill patients after their clinic appointment.
  * [Prescriptions](/docs/clinics/prescriptions) - View prescriptions issued during appointments.
  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Check stock before prescribing during appointments.

docs/clinics/pending-bookings.title: Pending Bookings
docs/clinics/pending-bookings.description: Review and approve or reject online booking requests made through your public booking link.
docs/clinics/pending-bookings.body:
# Pending Bookings

When a patient books an appointment themselves using your **Public Booking Link**, it doesn't get added directly to your Appointments list. Instead, it lands here as a **Pending Booking**, waiting for you to review and approve or reject it.

---

## Searching Pending Bookings
The search bar lets you search by **patient name or phone**. A **1 Pending** counter at the top shows how many booking requests are awaiting action, and the refresh icon reloads the list.

![Pending Bookings page](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/a555140b-dc50-4bd0-9d9f-b0af27806b47-pending-bookings.png)
*Caption: Search pending bookings by patient name or phone with pending counter*

---

## Booking Request Cards
Each pending booking is shown as a card with:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Patient name and phone** | The patient who made the booking |
| **Doctor** | The doctor the booking is requested with |
| **Date** | Requested appointment date |
| **Time** | Requested time slot |
| **Symptoms** | Symptoms entered by the patient while booking |

![Booking request card](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/d62482e6-7ea5-4787-8469-22ef90177ea7-booking-request-card.png)
*Caption: Pending booking card showing patient details, doctor, date, time, and symptoms*

---

## Approving Or Rejecting A Booking
Each card has two actions:

| Action | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Approve** | Confirms the booking, adding it to your Appointments list |
| **Reject** | Declines the booking request |

> **[Note]** Once a booking is approved, it moves to the **Appointments** page. Bookings left pending don't get scheduled automatically, they need action from you.

---

## FAQs


  ### Where do pending bookings come from?

They're created when a patient books an appointment through your **Public Booking Link**, shared from the Appointments page.
  ### What happens if I reject a booking?

The booking request is declined and does not appear in your Appointments list.


---

## Common Mistake To Avoid
> **[Warning: Don't approve without checking availability]** Approving a booking without checking doctor availability can lead to double-bookings. Since these are patient-submitted requests, always double-check the requested date and time don't conflict with existing appointments before confirming.

---

## Booking Decided

  * [Appointments](/docs/clinics/appointments) - View approved bookings now scheduled.
  * [Schedules](/docs/clinics/schedules) - Check doctor availability before approving requests.
  * [Doctors](/docs/clinics/doctors) - View the doctor handling this booking.
  * [Add a Customer](/docs/customers/add-customer) - Register the patient for billing after their appointment.

docs/clinics/prescriptions.title: Prescriptions
docs/clinics/prescriptions.description: Create prescriptions as a doctor and dispense them directly into a sale from the pharmacy side.
docs/clinics/prescriptions.body:
# Prescriptions

The **Prescriptions** page connects the doctor’s prescribing workflow with the pharmacy’s dispensing workflow. A doctor creates a prescription. It then appears on the pharmacy side under **Clinic → Prescriptions**. The pharmacist clicks **Dispense** and is taken straight to the **Add Sale** page with the prescribed medicines already loaded.

---

## What You Can Do

- Create new prescriptions with full clinical details, medicines, frequency, duration, and vitals
- View a complete history of every prescription you have issued
- Search prescriptions by patient name, medicine, or notes
- Dispense a prescription directly into a sale with medicines pre-filled
- Keep a clear record linking the patient, doctor, and medicines prescribed

---

## Doctor Side: My Prescriptions

Navigate to **Clinic → My Prescriptions**.

This is the page a doctor uses to review past prescriptions and create new ones.

![My Prescriptions](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/43fadb2b-666a-4905-87e2-a2fd2be4be37-doctor-prescription.png)
*Caption: Prescription History table with search, total count, and Add Prescription button.*

### Page overview

| Element | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **TOTAL** / **SHOWING** | Total prescriptions and how many are currently visible |
| **Search bar** | Search by patient name, medicine, or notes |
| **+ Add Prescription** | Opens the create prescription flow |
| **Prescription History** table | List of all prescriptions you have issued |

![Page overview](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/a217162c-f6f7-412a-94a6-35f9ab99d140-searchbar-prescritpions.png)
*Caption: TOTAL, SHOWING counts, search bar, and Add Prescription button.*

### Prescription History table

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Patient** | Patient name with phone number below it |
| **Date & Time** | When the prescription was created |
| **Medicines** | Prescribed medicines shown as chips |
| **Actions** | Three-dot menu for additional actions |

![Prescription History table](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/54bb2bcd-7b93-4d97-8e2a-dfa0d3533e3e-history-prescription.png)
*Caption: Columns for Patient, Date & Time, Medicines, and Actions.*
---

## Creating A Prescription

1. **Open the create flow**

   On the **My Prescriptions** page, click **+ Add Prescription**.

2. **Select or add a patient**

   The **Create Prescription** dialog opens.

       ![Select Patient](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/d66fde4b-8392-46a3-bc82-1c297d68c80f-patient-prescription.png)
*Caption: Search an existing patient or add a new one.*

       - Search by name, phone, or address to select an existing patient.
       - Click **+ Add New Patient** if the patient is not yet in the system.
       - Recent patients appear below the search field when available.

3. **Fill the prescription form**

   After selecting the patient, the full prescription form opens.

       ![Create Prescription form](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/4e800b58-24e7-4c42-8467-892e369dd1e0-patient-info_prescription.png)
*Caption: Patient information, clinical sections, medications, vitals, follow-up, and remarks.*

       ### Patient Information

       | Field | Description |
       | --- | --- |
       | **Name** | Patient’s full name |
       | **Age** | Patient’s age |
       | **Gender** | Male / Female / Other |
       | **Phone** | Contact number |
       | **Date** | Prescription date |
       | **Address** | Patient’s address |

       Use **Change Patient** at any time to switch to a different patient.

       ### Clinical sections

       | Section | How to use it |
       | --- | --- |
       | **COMPLAINTS** | Click **+ Add Complaints** to record the patient’s complaints |
       | **HISTORY** | Click **+ Add History** to record relevant medical history |
       | **DIAGNOSIS** | Enter the diagnosis in the free-text field |
       | **INVESTIGATIONS** | Click **+ Add Investigations** to record tests or investigations |
       | **OBSERVATION** | Enter any observation notes |

       ### Medications

       Add each medicine with:

       - **MEDICINE** name
       - **FREQUENCY** (dropdown)
       - **DURATION** (in days)

       Frequency options:

       | Code | Meaning |
       | --- | --- |
       | `OD` | Once Daily |
       | `BD` | Twice Daily |
       | `TDS` | Three times |
       | `QID` | Four times |
       | `PRN` | As needed |
       | `SOS` | If needed |
       | `STAT` | Immediately |
       | `1-0-1` | Morning and Evening |
       | `1-1-1` | Morning, Afternoon, Evening |
