       ![Frequency dropdown](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/a874b8aa-5dfb-409d-9452-e5d4025cbb79-frequency-prescription.png)
*Caption: Common dosing frequencies available while adding medicines.*

       ### Vitals

       | Field | Unit |
       | --- | --- |
       | **BP** | e.g. 120/80 |
       | **Weight** | kg |
       | **Height** | cm |
       | **Temp** | °F |
       | **Pulse** | bpm |
       | **SpO2** | % |

       ### Follow-up and Remarks

       - Set a **Follow-up Date** or use the quick buttons: **1 Day**, **3 Days**, **1 Week**, **2 Weeks**
       - Add any additional notes or instructions in **Remarks**

4. **Save the prescription**

   Click **Save & Print** at the top right.

       The prescription is saved, appears in the doctor’s **Prescription History**, and becomes available on the pharmacy side for dispensing.

---

## Pharmacy Side: Prescriptions List

Navigate to **Clinic → Prescriptions**.

This is the view used by the store or pharmacist.

![Pharmacy Prescriptions](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/e2fa8f66-a769-4cf4-b82e-937983ee4b15-pside-prescription.png)
*Caption: Search, Pending/All filters, and Dispense action.*

### What you see

- Search and select a customer to view their prescriptions
- Filter chips: **Pending** and **All**
- Table of prescriptions waiting to be dispensed

### Prescriptions table

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **DATE** | Date and time the prescription was issued |
| **PATIENT** | Patient name with phone number |
| **MEDICINES** | Prescribed medicines shown as chips |
| **ACTIONS** | **Dispense** button |

![Prescriptions table](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/2a0974dd-55c6-49f4-9f7f-64082620eb28-prescription-table.png)
*Caption: Columns for Date, Patient, Medicines, and the Dispense action.*
---

## Dispensing A Prescription

Click **Dispense** on any pending prescription.

You are taken directly to the **Add Sale** page with the prescription details already loaded.

![Add Sale opened from Dispense](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/f06f1f0d-0417-4ab4-95c1-747141f70247-dispense-prescription.png)
*Caption: Prescription Details panel on the right and Rx items pre-filled in the drug table.*

### What is pre-filled

**Right panel – Prescription Details**
- Patient name, phone, and address
- List of prescribed medicines with **Frequency** and **Duration**

**Drug table**
- Each prescribed medicine is added as a row
- **Type** is set to `Rx`
- You can adjust quantity, rate, discount, and other sale fields as needed

Complete the sale as you normally would: select payment status, review the bill summary, and save.

> **[Note]** The **Prescription Details** panel stays visible on the right so you can use it as a live reference while building the bill.

---

## Full Flow Summary

1. Doctor opens **Clinic → My Prescriptions**
2. Clicks **+ Add Prescription**
3. Selects an existing patient or adds a new one
4. Fills clinical details, medicines, frequency, duration, vitals, and follow-up
5. Clicks **Save & Print**
6. Pharmacy opens **Clinic → Prescriptions**
7. Finds the prescription under **Pending**
8. Clicks **Dispense**
9. Completes the sale on the **Add Sale** page with medicines already loaded

---

## Common Mistakes To Avoid

> **[Warning: Missing frequency or duration]** Always set **Frequency** and **DURATION** for every medicine. These details appear on the printed prescription and in the pharmacy view.


> **[Warning: Dispensing without checking stock]** Use the pre-filled medicines as a guide, then confirm actual batch, expiry, and available quantity before finalising the sale.

---

## After Dispensing


  * Add Sale - Full retail and wholesale billing workflow.
  * [Doctors](/docs/clinics/doctors) - Manage the doctor profiles linked to prescriptions.
  * [Appointments](/docs/clinics/appointments) - View appointments that may be linked to a prescription.
  * [Customers](/docs/customers) - Manage patient profiles used across prescriptions and sales.

docs/clinics/schedules.title: Schedules
docs/clinics/schedules.description: Set doctor availability, configure booking rules, and generate shareable booking links for patients.
docs/clinics/schedules.body:
# Schedules

The **Schedules** page is where you define when each doctor is available for consultations. A schedule controls the days and times a doctor can be booked, along with rules like slot duration, breaks, and how far in advance patients can book, this is what powers the Appointments and Pending Bookings pages.

---

## Searching And Filtering Schedules
The search bar lets you search by **doctor name or speciality**.

![Schedules search bar](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/cec81ab7-f655-474d-8df5-acf2731cc916-schedule-searchbar.png)
*Caption: Search schedules by doctor name or speciality*

Click **Filters** to open the **Filter & Sort** panel:

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Days of Week** | Filter schedules active on specific days |
| **Time Slot** | Filter by a Start Time and End Time |
| **Status** | Active, Draft, Inactive, or Archived |
| **Consultation Fee Range** | Set a Minimum and Maximum fee |
| **Sort By** | Sort by Recently Added, in ascending or descending order |

Click **Apply Filters** to apply, or **Reset** to clear all filters.

![Filter & Sort panel](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/e01def9e-37f6-48b4-9eba-e746fff53b80-schedule-filter.png)
*Caption: Filter and sort schedules using multiple criteria*

---

## The Schedules List
Each schedule card shows the doctor's name and speciality, their **consultation fee**, the **days** they're available, and their **status** (e.g., Active).

Click the **⌄** arrow on a card to expand it and see full details:

| Section | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Weekly Schedule** | Time ranges the doctor is available for, per day |
| **Exception Dates** | Specific dates the doctor is marked unavailable (or otherwise), overriding their regular weekly schedule |
| **Booking Rules** | Slot Duration, Buffer Time, Max Patients/Slot, and Advance Booking window for this schedule |
| **Notes** | Any additional notes added when the schedule was created |

![Schedules list](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/ca940d74-352a-4546-aff4-d2b283ffe782-all-schedule-list.png)
*Caption: Schedule cards showing doctor availability overview*

![Expanded schedule card](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/9cfe6200-4a3f-40f0-946b-12bba845a6b6-schedule-list.png)
*Caption: Expanded view showing weekly schedule, exception dates, and booking rules*

---

## Row Actions
Click the **⋮** menu on any schedule card to:

| Action | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **View** | Opens the schedule in a detailed view |
| **Edit** | Opens the schedule for editing |
| **Booking Link** | Generates a shareable link patients can use to book an appointment with that doctor directly |
| **Archive** | Archives the schedule, removing it from active use without deleting it |
| **Delete** | Permanently removes the schedule |

![Row actions menu](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/a89f35b3-989b-4f60-8225-8114680bd3af-row-actions.png)
*Caption: Schedule card actions including View, Edit, Booking Link, Archive, and Delete*

---

## Adding A Schedule
Click **+ Add Schedule** to open the **Add New Schedule** form:

![Add Schedule button](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/f70b0c9a-c5f9-4d84-aa12-f772d969315d-add-schedule.png)
*Caption: Button to open the Add New Schedule form*

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Select Doctor** | Choose the doctor this schedule is for, required |
| **Consultation Fee** | Fee charged per consultation, required |

### Schedule Type
Choose how patients book against this schedule:

| Type | What it means |
| --- | --- |
| **Slot Based** | Patients book a specific time slot |
| **Token Based** | Patients book by date, with a maximum number of patients per day. Selecting this adds a **Max Patients Per Day** field, required |

### Recurring Schedule
Click **+ Add Day** to add a day to the doctor's weekly availability. For each day:

- Select the **day of the week**
- Set a time range (**from** – **to**)
- Click **+ Add Time Slot** to add more than one time range for the same day
- Use the copy icon to duplicate a day's schedule, or the delete icon to remove it

### Break Times
Click **+ Add Break Time** to block out a recurring time range within the day (e.g., a lunch break), with a time range and a label describing the break.

### Exception Dates
Click **+ Add Exception Date** to mark a specific date as an exception to the doctor's regular schedule, set a date, mark it **Unavailable** (or otherwise), and optionally add a reason.

### Booking Rules
| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Slot Duration (minutes)** | Length of each bookable slot |
| **Buffer Time (minutes)** | Gap maintained between consecutive slots |
| **Max Patients Per Slot** | Number of patients that can be booked into one slot |
| **Advance Booking (days)** | How many days in advance patients can book |
| **Allow Same Day Booking** | Lets patients book for the current day |
| **Allow Walk-ins** | Allows patients to be added without a prior booking |
| **Allow Rescheduling** | Lets patients reschedule an existing booking |

### Other Fields
| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Schedule Poster** | Optional image shown on the schedule's booking link |
| **Effective From** | Date this schedule takes effect |
| **Notes** | Any additional notes about the schedule |

Once configured, click **Create Schedule** to save, or **Cancel** to discard.

![Add New Schedule form](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/07f711d8-9eaa-42b6-a3b3-e5eae9816d02-schedule-form.png)
*Caption: Complete form for creating a new doctor schedule with all fields and sections*

---

## FAQs


  ### What's the difference between Slot Based and Token Based scheduling?

Slot Based lets patients pick a specific time slot within the doctor's availability. Token Based only lets patients pick a date, with a maximum number of patients allowed that day — useful for doctors who see patients on a first-come basis rather than fixed time slots.
  ### What happens if I archive a schedule instead of deleting it?

Archiving keeps the schedule on record but removes it from active use, so it won't be available for new bookings. This is useful if a doctor's availability is paused temporarily rather than ended for good.
  ### Can I share a doctor's schedule directly with patients?

Yes, use **Booking Link** from the row's action menu to generate a shareable link patients can use to book an appointment with that doctor.


---

## Common Mistakes To Avoid
- Setting **Advance Booking** too short: if it's too restrictive, patients may not be able to book far enough ahead
- Forgetting to add **Break Times**: without this, patients could end up booking into a doctor's lunch or rest period
- Leaving old schedules active instead of archiving them: this can cause confusion when multiple schedules exist for the same doctor

---

## Your Schedule Is Live

  * [Appointments](/docs/clinics/appointments) - See bookings made against this schedule.
  * [Pending Bookings](/docs/clinics/pending-bookings) - Confirm or reject requests for this schedule.
  * [Doctors](/docs/clinics/doctors) - View the doctor whose schedule you just configured.
  * [Prescriptions](/docs/clinics/prescriptions) - View prescriptions written during these appointments.

docs/customers/add-customer.title: Add a Customer
docs/customers/add-customer.description: Learn how to add a new pharmacy customer in MediFlux. Create Consumer or Business profiles, track Udhaar, and manage GST-ready ledgers easily.
docs/customers/add-customer.body:
# Add a Customer

> **Video:** [How to Add a Customer in MediFlux](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=)

When you **add a new customer** in MediFlux, you can create either a **Consumer** profile (for individual, walk-in patients) or a **Business** profile (for businesses or other pharmacies you supply to). Both options are available from the Customer List page and from the **`+` quick-add menu** available on every screen.

---

## Opening The Add Customer Form
You can open the **Add New Customer** form in two ways:

- From the Customer List page, click **+ Add Customer**
- Click the **`+` menu** in the top-right corner of any screen and select **Add Customer**

![MediFlux Add New Pharmacy Customer Form](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783661642600-740603868-add-customer.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux form for adding a new customer, showing the Consumer and Business profile toggle at the top.*

---

## Option 1: Consumer
Use the **Consumer** tab to add an individual customer.

### Basic Details
| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Full Name** | Yes | Customer's full name |
| **Gender** | Yes | Select the customer's gender |
| **Phone Number** | Yes | Customer's primary contact number |
| **Email Address** | No | Customer's email address |
| **Aadhaar Number** | No | Customer's Aadhaar ID number |
| **Age** | No | Customer's age |

### PMJAY / Ayushman Bharat Customer
Tick the **PMJAY / Ayushman Bharat Customer** checkbox to mark this customer as a beneficiary of the Ayushman Bharat PMJAY scheme. This reveals additional fields:

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Ayushman Card Number** | Yes | The customer's PMJAY card number |
| **Beneficiary ID** | No | Beneficiary ID, if available |
| **ABHA Number** | No, but recommended | The customer's Ayushman Bharat Health Account number |

> **[Note]** Marking a customer as a PMJAY beneficiary does not apply any automatic discount. It simply tags the customer so their sales can be handled separately during billing and tracked in dedicated PMJAY sales reports.

![MediFlux PMJAY / Ayushman Bharat Customer Details](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783661752801-133018284-pmjay-customers.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux consumer form with expanded PMJAY fields for Ayushman Card Number, Beneficiary ID, and ABHA Number.*

### Additional Information
| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **State** | Yes | Customer's state |
| **Full Address** | Yes | Customer's complete address |
| **Notes** | No | Any internal notes about this customer |
| **Opening Outstanding** | No | Any existing amount this customer already owed you before adding them to MediFlux. Defaults to `0`. |
| **Customer Rating** | No | A manual 1–5 star rating reflecting how reliable or valued this customer is. |

![MediFlux Consumer Additional Information](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783661988626-617696622-consumer-form.png)
*Caption: Additional consumer fields in MediFlux, including State, Address, Notes, Opening Outstanding, and Customer Rating.*

---

## Option 2: Business
Use the **Business** tab to add a business or another pharmacy store as a customer.

### Basic Details
| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Business Name** | Yes | Name of the business, e.g., ABC Enterprises |
| **Phone Number** | Yes | Primary contact number |
| **Email Address** | No | Business email address |
| **License Number** | Yes | Drug license number of the business |
| **GSTIN** | No | GST Identification Number |

### Additional Information
| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **State** | Yes | Business's state |
| **Full Address** | Yes | Business's complete address |
| **Notes** | No | Any internal notes about this customer |
| **Opening Outstanding** | No | Any existing amount this business already owed you before adding them to MediFlux. Defaults to `0`. |
| **Customer Rating** | No | A manual 1–5 star rating reflecting how reliable or valued this customer is. |

![MediFlux Business Pharmacy Customer Form](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783661988625-840150066-bussiness-form.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux business customer form filled out with required details like Business Name, License Number, and GSTIN.*

---

## Continue With This Customer

  * [Customer Profile](/docs/customers/customer-profile) - View and manage the customer you just created.
  * [Customer Ledger](/docs/customers/customer-ledger) - Record opening outstanding or track payment history.
  * [Billing Notes](/docs/customers/billing-notes) - Set special pricing or credit terms for this customer.
  * [Customer List](/docs/customers/customer-list) - See all customers including the new one.

docs/customers/billing-notes.title: Billing Notes
docs/customers/billing-notes.description: Manage debit notes raised by your connected retailers and credit notes issued to your customers, a supplier-only feature in MediFlux.
docs/customers/billing-notes.body:
# Billing Notes

> **[Note]** Billing Notes is only available to users with a **supplier or distributor account** on MediFlux. If you do not have a supplier account, this page will not be visible to you.

The **Billing Notes** page helps suppliers manage medicine return requests from their retailers and track credit notes issued to their customers. It has two tabs: **Debit Notes** and **Credit Notes**.

Navigate here from the sidebar: **Customers → Billing Notes**.

![Billing Notes](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783664466284-836507570-billingnotes-sidebar.png)
*Caption: Navigate from sidebar to billing notes.*

---

## Debit Notes Tab
When a connected retailer, party, or customer on MediFlux generates a debit note for medicines you sold them, that note appears here in your Debit Notes tab. This tells you exactly which medicines your retailer wants to return.

From here you can take action on each debit note:

- **Credit it:** accept the return request. The debit note is converted into a credit note and moves to the Credit Notes tab, for both you and the retailer who raised it
- **Reject it:** decline the return request. This is reflected on the retailer's dashboard as well

> **[Note]** As a supplier, you cannot generate debit notes yourself. Debit notes can only be raised by your connected retailers or customers from their end. If none of your connected retailers have raised a debit note, this tab will show **No Debit Notes Found**.

![Debit Notes tab, empty state](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783664645388-538747133-customer-debitnote.png)
*Caption: No debit notes have been raised by connected retailers yet.*

---

## Credit Notes Tab
The Credit Notes tab shows all credit notes associated with your customers and retailers. Credit notes appear here in two ways:

**From a credited debit note:** when you accept and credit a debit note raised by your retailer, it is automatically converted into a credit note and appears here. At the same time, it also appears in the Credit Notes tab of the retailer who originally raised the debit note.

**Manually generated:** if you want to issue a credit note directly to a customer or retailer without a debit note being raised first, you can create one from **Sales → Add Credit Note**. These appear directly in this tab.

> **[Note]** Every time a credit note is generated, whether from a credited debit note or manually, a credit note entry is automatically added to that customer's ledger. You can verify this at **Customers → Ledger → [customer/retailer name]**.

Each entry in the Credit Notes tab shows:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **CRN** | Credit note number (e.g. `CN/2026001`) with **Credit Note** label below |
| **Customer** | The customer or retailer the credit note was issued to, with date and time |
| **Amount** | Credit amount |
| **Actions** | View Details or View Invoice |

![Credit Notes tab](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783664763801-87473369-customer-creditnotes.png)
*Caption: List of credit notes with CRN, customer, amount, and actions.*

---

## Credit Note Actions
Clicking the **three-dot menu (⋮)** on any credit note row gives you two options:

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **View Details** | Opens the full credit note detail page showing Debit Note Date, Credit Note Date, Amount, and a full Summary breakdown |
| **View Invoice** | Opens the printable credit note invoice |

From the detail page you can also **Print**, **Download**, or **Delete** the credit note using the **More** menu.

![Credit Note detail page](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783664968396-298751002-actions-buttons.png)
*Caption: Full credit note details with the More menu open showing Print, Download, and Delete options.*

---
## Check Out 

  * [Add Credit Note](/docs/sales/add-credit-note) - Manually issue a credit note to a customer or retailer.
  * [Customer Ledger](/docs/customers/customer-ledger) - Verify credit note entries in customer transaction history.
  * [Store Requests](/docs/customers/store-request) - Connect with retailers who can raise debit notes against you.
  * [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - View original sales that may be returned.

docs/customers/customer-ledger.title: Customer Ledger
docs/customers/customer-ledger.description: Manage your pharmacy customer ledger in MediFlux. Track Udhaar, outstanding balances, payments, refunds, and credit notes in one place.
docs/customers/customer-ledger.body:
# Customer Ledger

The **Customer Ledger** page gives you a complete financial record of all your **pharmacy customer transactions** in **MediFlux**. You can view a consolidated ledger across all customers at once, or click into any individual customer to see their dedicated ledger with a running **Udhaar (outstanding) balance**.

Navigate here from the sidebar: **Customers → Ledger**.

---

## Page Layout
The Ledger page is split into two panels:

**Left panel: Customer list**
Shows all your customers with their name, address, and individual outstanding balance in red. The total outstanding across all customers is shown at the bottom. Use the search bar to find a specific customer instantly. Click **View All Customers** to go back to the full Customer List page.

**Right panel: Ledger entries**
Shows the transactions for the selected customer, or all entries across every customer if no customer is selected.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Customer Ledger Page Layout](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783663149930-270715838-customer-ledger.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux customer ledger showing the left panel with the customer list and the right panel with Udhaar ledger entries.*

---

## Consolidated View: All Customer Entries
When no individual customer is selected, the right panel shows **All Customer Entries**, every transaction across all your customers combined in one view.

The entry type tabs at the top let you filter what you see:

| Tab | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **All** | Every transaction across all customers |
| **Payment** | Payments received from customers |
| **Sale** | Sale entries recorded for customers |
| **Returns** | Items returned by customers |
| **Refund** | Refunds issued to customers |
| **Credit Note** | Credit notes recorded for a customer |
| **Adjustment** | Manual balance corrections |

The consolidated table has the following columns:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Customer** | Name and contact number of the customer |
| **Date** | Date and time of the transaction |
| **Debit** | Amount reducing what the customer owes: returns and refunds |
| **Credit** | Amount increasing what the customer owes: sales, opening balance |
| **Receipt** | Receipt or reference number if recorded |
| **Notes** | Any notes added at the time of entry |
| **Actions** | Delete the entry |

![MediFlux Consolidated Pharmacy Customer Ledger View](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783663231249-84345622-consolidated-view.png)
*Caption: View every transaction, payment, and Udhaar balance across all pharmacy customers in one combined MediFlux ledger view.*

---

## Individual Customer Ledger
Click on any customer name in the left panel to open their dedicated ledger. The right panel updates to show only that customer's transactions.

At the top of the individual ledger you'll see the customer's **name, address, and phone number**.

### Action Buttons
| Button | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Export** | Export this customer's ledger entries as PDF or Excel |
| **Add Payment** | Record a payment or refund against this customer |
| **Adjust** | Add a manual adjustment entry to correct the ledger balance |
| **Filter** | Filter entries by date range, entry type, and sort order |

![MediFlux Individual Customer Ledger Action Buttons](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783663315727-882956436-customer-ledger-actionbuttons.png)
*Caption: Export, Add Payment, Adjust, and Filter buttons at the top of an individual pharmacy customer's Udhaar ledger in MediFlux.*

### Entry Type Tabs
Same as the consolidated view, filter by **All, Payment, Sale, Returns, Refund, Credit Note,** or **Adjustment**.

### Individual Ledger Columns
| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Date** | Date and time of the transaction, with the entry type shown as a label |
| **Debit** | Amount reducing what the customer owes |
| **Credit** | Amount increasing what the customer owes |
| **Balance** | Running outstanding balance after every entry: updates automatically with each transaction |
| **Receipt** | Receipt or reference number if recorded |
| **Notes** | Any notes added at the time of entry |
| **Actions** | Delete the entry |

![MediFlux Customer Ledger Running Balance Column](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783663398217-757586122-balance-column.png)
*Caption: The running Udhaar balance column updates automatically after every pharmacy customer transaction in MediFlux.*

> **[Note]** The **Balance** column updates after every single entry, so you can trace exactly how the outstanding amount changed step by step from day one.

---

## Adding A Payment Or Refund
Click **Add Payment** on the individual customer ledger to open the **Add Customer Payment** dialog. It has two tabs, **Payment** and **Refund**.

The dialog also shows a **Recent Payments** table at the top with a quick link back to the full **Ledger**, listing recent entries with their Date, Type, Amount, Balance, Receipt, and payment method (Via).

### Payment Tab
| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Select Customer** | Yes | Search and select the customer |
| **Payment Amount** | Yes | The amount being paid by the customer |
| **Payment Method** | Yes | How the payment was made |
| **Payment Date** | Yes | Defaults to today's date. Can be changed |
| **Receipt Number** | No | Receipt or reference number |
| **Notes** | No | Any additional notes about this payment |

### Refund Tab
Use the **Refund** tab when you need to pay money back to a customer.

Click **Add Payment** to save. Click **Reset** to clear all fields.

---

## Adding An Adjustment Entry
Click **Adjust** on the individual customer ledger to manually correct the customer's balance, for example a price correction, rounding adjustment, or write-off.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Adjustment Amount** | Enter a positive number (e.g. `500`) if the customer owes you more, or a negative number (e.g. `-500`) if the customer owes you less |
| **Entry Date** | Defaults to today's date. Can be changed |
| **Receipt / Reference Number** | Optional reference number for this adjustment |
| **Notes** | Reason for the adjustment: e.g. price correction, rounding adjustment, write-off |

Click **Add** to save. Click **Reset** to clear all fields.

---

## Filtering The Ledger
Click **Filter** on the individual customer ledger to open the Ledger Filters panel.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Ledger Filter Icon](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783663530792-583321130-filter-icon.png)
*Caption: Filter pharmacy customer ledger entries by date range and transaction type in MediFlux.*

## You can filter by:
| Filter | Options |
| --- | --- |
| **Date Range** | Today, This Month, Last Month, This Quarter, Last Quarter, This Year, Last Year: or set a custom Start and End date |
| **Entry Type** | All Types, Payment, Sale, Returns, Refund, Credit Note, Adjustment, Delete Credit Note |

Click **Apply** to apply the filters. Click **Clear** to reset them all.

![MediFlux Customer Ledger Filters Panel](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783663622495-606285712-ledger-filters.png)
*Caption: Filter pharmacy customer ledger entries by date range and entry type with the dropdown expanded in MediFlux.*

---

## Exporting Ledger Entries
Click **Export** on the individual customer ledger to open the Export Options dialog. Choose a **date range** and an **export format**:

- **PDF Document**
- **Excel Spreadsheet**

Click **Export** to download.

![MediFlux Export Pharmacy Customer Ledger](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783663737908-69399000-customer-export.png)
*Caption: Export pharmacy customer ledger entries to PDF or Excel format for accounting and Udhaar tracking in MediFlux.*

---

## Deleting A Ledger Entry
Click the **three-dot menu (⋯)** on any entry row and select **Delete Entry** to remove it.

![MediFlux Delete Customer Ledger Entry](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783663856262-268376688-delete-entry.png)
*Caption: Access the delete option from the row actions menu to remove a specific pharmacy customer ledger entry in MediFlux.*

---

## Common Mistakes To Avoid
> **[Warning: Confusing Refund with Returns]** A **Return** records an item physically returned by the customer. A **Refund** records the money paid back to the customer. They can happen independently: a return doesn't always mean a refund was issued, and vice versa.

---

## From This Profile

  * [Ledger](/docs/customers/customer-ledger) - Track transactions, payments, and running balance.
  * [Billing Notes](/docs/customers/billing-notes) - Set special pricing or credit terms for this customer.
  * [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - View all sales and filter by this customer.
  * [Customer List](/docs/customers/customer-list) - Browse and manage all your customers.

docs/customers/customer-list.title: Customer List
docs/customers/customer-list.description: View and manage customers, track outstanding balances and credit limits, record bulk payments, filter and export customer data, and perform bulk updates or deletions.
docs/customers/customer-list.body:
# Customer List

The **Customer List** is your main directory of customers linked to your pharmacy, including individual consumers and businesses.

It provides an overview of customer details, outstanding balances, credit limits, and payment history, with options to search, filter, record bulk payments, import, export, and manage multiple customers at once.

---

## Summary Cards

At the top of the page, four summary cards give you an overview of your customer base.

| Card | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Total Customers** | Total number of customer profiles |
| **Outstanding** | Total outstanding amount across customers |
| **Linked Stores** | Number of pharmacy stores linked through MediFlux |
| **Local Customers** | Number of local customer profiles |

![Customer summary cards](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/c95643ae-4c19-4008-89d7-ddd19120bb5d-customer-summary-cards.png)
*Caption: Overview of total customers, outstanding balances, linked stores, and local customers.*

---

## Searching Customers

Use the search bar at the top of the **Customer List** to find customers by **name, phone number, email, or address**.

The **All** dropdown lets you narrow the search to a particular field.

![Search customers](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/b5f4c5fb-27ff-46ea-b777-bcc6f24b0f7c-search-customers.png)
*Caption: Search customer records using names, phone numbers, emails, or addresses.*

---

## Quick Filters

Below the search bar, two quick filters let you narrow the customer list.

| Filter | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Linked Stores** | Customers who are other pharmacy stores linked through MediFlux |
| **Local Customers** | Local customers added to your store |

![Customer quick filters](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/2d84650c-b4d2-4046-a65a-d5d3b6c28169-customer-quickfilters.png)
*Caption: Filter customers by Linked Stores or Local Customers.*

---

## Customer Table

The **Customer List** displays customer information in a table.

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Checkbox** | Select customers for bulk editing or deletion |
| **Name** | Customer name and customer type. Displays **Limit Exceeded** when the customer has exceeded their credit limit |
| **Phone** | Customer's contact number |
| **Outstanding** | Customer's current outstanding balance |
| **Last Payment** | Date of the customer's last recorded payment |
| **Actions** | Opens the individual customer's action menu |

![Customer List](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/88241ddc-2d7f-473b-afc8-fa0d8756a6d8-customer-list.png)
*Caption: Customer records showing names, phone numbers, outstanding balances, last payment dates, and actions.*

### Sorting The Table

The **Name** and **Outstanding** columns are sortable.

Click either column heading to change the sorting order between ascending and descending.

---

## Customer Credit Limit

MediFlux lets you set credit limits to control how much outstanding credit customers can accumulate.

You can set a **Global Customer Credit Limit** for your store or configure a separate limit for an individual customer.

When a customer's outstanding balance exceeds their applicable limit, MediFlux displays a **Limit Exceeded** indicator in the Customer List and warns you during the sales process.

### Setting a Global Customer Credit Limit

The **Global Customer Credit Limit** is a store-wide credit threshold that applies to customers who do not have an individual credit limit configured.

1. **Open Account Settings**

   Go to **Settings → Account**.

2. **Edit Account Information**

   Click **Edit** to open the account information form.

3. **Enter the global credit limit**

   Find **Global Customer Credit Limit (₹)** and enter the amount you want to set.

   For example, enter `1000` to set a global customer credit limit of ₹1,000.

4. **Save the changes**

   Save the updated account information.

   The global credit limit now applies to customers who do not have an individual credit limit.

{/* Add Figure: Global Customer Credit Limit field in Settings → Account → Edit */}

> **[Note]** A customer's individual credit limit overrides the global credit limit when one is configured.

### Setting an Individual Customer Credit Limit

You can also set a separate credit limit for a particular customer.

There are two ways to do this:

- **When creating a customer:** Enter the credit limit while adding a new customer profile.
- **When editing a customer:** Open the existing customer's details and update their credit limit.

For example, suppose your global credit limit is ₹1,000, but a particular customer has an individual limit of ₹5,000.

MediFlux uses the customer's individual limit of ₹5,000 instead of the global ₹1,000 limit.

### Identifying Customers Who Exceed Their Credit Limit

Go to **Customers → Customer List**.

Customers whose outstanding balance exceeds their applicable credit limit are marked with a red **Limit Exceeded** label beside their name.

For example:

| Customer | Credit Limit | Outstanding | Status |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Naveed Anjum | ₹1,000 | ₹3,739 | **Limit Exceeded** |
| Another Customer | ₹1,000 | ₹500 | Within Limit |

This makes it easier to identify customers whose outstanding balances have crossed their allowed credit limit without opening each customer profile.

{/* Add Figure: Customer List showing Limit Exceeded labels beside customer names */}

### How Credit Limits Affect Sales

Customer credit limits are also checked when creating a sale.

When you search for a customer in **Add Sale**, MediFlux indicates whether their credit limit has already been exceeded.

#### Credit Limit Warning During Customer Search

In the **Quick Add Customer** search, customers who have exceeded their credit limit display a red **Limit Exceeded** label beside their name.

This allows you to identify the customer's credit status before selecting them.

{/* Add Figure: Quick Add Customer search showing Limit Exceeded */}

#### Restriction on Unpaid Sales

If you select a customer whose credit limit has already been reached or exceeded, MediFlux prevents an **Unpaid** sale.

A warning appears showing the customer's outstanding amount and credit limit.

For example:

**Credit limit exceeded for customer "Naveed Anjum"!**

`Outstanding: ₹3,739, Limit: ₹1,000`

This prevents additional unpaid sales when the customer's credit limit has already been reached.

{/* Add Figure: Add Sale showing the credit limit exceeded warning */}

> **[Note]** The credit limit applies to customer credit during sales. When the customer's applicable limit has already been reached or exceeded, an additional **Unpaid** sale is blocked.

---

## Filter And Sort

Select the **Filter** icon beside the quick filters to open additional filtering and sorting options.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Sort By** | Sort customers by Name or Last Payment |
| **Last Payment Date Range** | Filter customers using a start and end date based on their last payment |

Select **Apply Filters** to apply your choices or **Reset** to clear them.

![Customer Filter and Sort](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783660640379-866791328-filterandsort-panel.png)
*Caption: Apply additional filters and sorting options to the Customer List.*

---

## Page-Level Actions

At the top of the **Customer List**, you can access the main customer management actions.

| Action | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Add Customer** | Opens the form to create a new customer profile |
| **Add Payment** | Opens the customer payment form |
| **Actions → Bulk Payment** | Record payments from multiple customers in a single operation |
| **Actions → Import** | Imports customer records from a file |
| **Actions → Export** | Exports customer data |

![Customer List actions](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/d24ca0cc-f03b-489a-af61-c21a7f6b7a5e-bulk-actions.png)
*Caption: Access Add Customer, Add Payment, Bulk Payment, Import, and Export from the Customer List.*

---

## Bulk Customer Payment

**Bulk Customer Payment** allows you to record payments received from multiple customers in a single operation.

Instead of opening each customer's ledger and recording payments separately, you can select multiple customers, enter their payment details, and submit the payments together.

This is useful when collecting outstanding payments from several customers.

### How to Record Bulk Customer Payments

1. **Open Bulk Payment**

   Go to **Customers → Customer List**.

   At the top-right, click **Actions → Bulk Payment**.

   The **Bulk Customer Payment** dialog opens.

2. **Select customers**

   The dialog displays customers along with their outstanding balances.

   Use the checkboxes to select the customers whose payments you want to record.

   You can search for customers by **name, phone number, or address**.

   | Column | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | **Checkbox** | Select or deselect customers |
   | **Customer** | Customer name, phone number, and address |
   | **Outstanding** | Current outstanding amount for the customer |

   Customers with outstanding balances are shown with the amount in red, while customers with a zero balance are shown in green.

   ![Select customers for bulk payment](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/1a22e21f-0e99-4d8d-94dd-8027dd77fd08-bulk-customer-payment.png)
*Caption: Search and select customers while reviewing their outstanding balances.*

   After selecting the required customers, click **Next**.

3. **Enter payment details**

   The next screen displays a separate payment section for each selected customer.

   At the top of the dialog, you can set:

   | Field | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | **Date** | Payment date |
   | **Payment Method** | Payment method selected at the top of the form |
   | **% of amt.** | Percentage field for calculating payment amounts |

   Each selected customer has their own payment details.

   | Field | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | **Amount (₹)** | Amount received from the customer |
   | **Full Pay** | Fills the payment amount with the customer's current outstanding balance |
   | **Payment Date** | Date the customer's payment was received |
   | **Method** | Payment method for the individual customer |
   | **Receipt No.** | Optional payment receipt or transaction number |
   | **Notes** | Optional remarks about the payment |

   ![Enter bulk customer payment details](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/2c943fc5-c816-40bc-af45-4f0fe4fe9e13-bulk-payment-details.png)
*Caption: Record payment amounts, dates, methods, receipt numbers, and notes for multiple customers.*

4. **Review the total payment**

   At the bottom of the dialog, **Total Payment** displays the combined amount entered for all selected customers.

   The number of selected customers is also displayed beside the total.

   Review the individual payment amounts before submitting.

5. **Submit payments**

   Click **Submit** to record the customer payments.

   You can review the recorded payments and updated outstanding balances in the respective [**Customer Ledgers**](/docs/customers/customer-ledger).

### Example: Recording Payments for Two Customers

Suppose two customers have the following outstanding balances:

| Customer | Outstanding | Payment Received | Remaining |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Customer A | ₹14,622.65 | ₹5,000 | ₹9,622.65 |
| Customer B | ₹4,269 | ₹4,269 | ₹0 |
| **Total** | **₹18,891.65** | **₹9,269** | **₹9,622.65** |

Enter ₹5,000 for Customer A and use **Full Pay** for Customer B.

The **Total Payment** at the bottom displays ₹9,269.

After recording these payments, Customer A still has an outstanding balance, while Customer B's balance is cleared.

> **[Note]** You can enter different payment amounts and payment methods for each customer. Use **Full Pay** to fill the customer's complete outstanding amount, or enter a smaller amount to record a partial payment.

---

## Selecting Customers And Bulk Actions

You can select multiple customers to update or delete their records together.

Select the checkboxes beside the customers you want to manage.

Once at least one customer is selected, a bulk action toolbar appears above the table.

The toolbar displays the number of selected customers and provides:

| Action | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Bulk Edit** | Update State and Area for the selected customers |
| **Bulk Delete** | Delete selected customer profiles and ledger entries |
| **Clear Selection** | Deselect all selected customers |

![Customer bulk actions](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/883f4235-84de-4344-9182-36e882eb00d6-bulk-actions-customers.png)
*Caption: Select multiple customers to access Bulk Edit, Bulk Delete, and Clear Selection.*

---

## Bulk Edit Customers

**Bulk Edit** lets you update the address-related information of multiple customers at once.

You can change the **State** and **Area** without opening each customer profile individually.

### How To Bulk Edit Customers

1. **Select customers**

   Go to **Customers → Customer List**.

   Select the checkboxes beside the customers you want to update.

2. **Open Bulk Edit**

   Click **Bulk Edit** from the selection toolbar.

   The **Bulk Edit Customers** dialog opens and displays the number of selected customers.

3. **Enter the changes**

   You can update the following fields:

   | Field | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | **State** | Select the state to apply to the selected customers |
   | **Area** | Enter the area to apply to the selected customers |

   Fields marked **Unchanged** are left as they are.

   You can update one field without changing the other.

   ![Bulk Edit Customers](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/4e7b1a65-fd4b-4e61-8a0f-036e3a557caf-customerbulk-edit.png)
*Caption: Update the State and Area of multiple selected customers.*

4. **Apply updates**

   Review your changes and click **Apply Updates**.

   The specified changes are applied to the selected customer profiles.

> **[Note]** Bulk Edit applies the same entered values to all selected customers. Leave a field unchanged if you do not want to modify it.

---

## Bulk Delete Customers

**Bulk Delete** lets you delete multiple customer profiles together.

When you select **Bulk Delete**, MediFlux opens a confirmation dialog showing the number of selected customers.

If the selected customers have outstanding balances, the dialog provides settlement options for handling positive and negative balances before deletion.

> **[Warning: Customer profiles and ledger entries will be deleted]** Bulk Delete removes the selected customer profiles and their ledger entries. Review the customers and balance settlement options carefully before confirming.

### How To Bulk Delete Customers

1. **Select customers**

   Go to **Customers → Customer List**.

   Select the customers you want to delete using the checkboxes.

2. **Open Bulk Delete**

   Click **Bulk Delete** from the selection toolbar.

   The **Bulk Delete Customers** dialog opens and displays the number of selected customers.

   ![Bulk Delete Customers](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/fe6c057a-323a-41d0-8129-e9f1e3fabda4-customer-bulk-delete.png)
*Caption: Review selected customers and available balance settlement options before deletion.*

3. **Choose positive balance settlement**

   If the selected customers have positive balances, choose how those balances should be settled.

   | Option | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | **Refunded to Customer** | Record the balance as refunded to the customer |
   | **Customer Credit Write-off** | Write off the customer's remaining credit balance |

4. **Choose negative balance settlement**

   If the selected customers have negative balances, the **Negative Balance Settlement** field appears.

   Choose how the balance should be handled.

   | Option | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | **Customer Paid** | Record the outstanding amount as paid by the customer |
   | **Bad Debt / Waive Off** | Write off the outstanding amount instead of collecting payment |

5. **Select the payment method**

   When a settlement involves a payment or refund, select the **Payment Method**.

   Available options include:

   - **Cash**
   - **Card**
   - **UPI**
   - **Net Banking**

6. **Confirm deletion**

   Review the selected customers and their balance settlement options.

   Click **Confirm Delete** to proceed or **Cancel** to return without deleting the customers.

> **[Note]** The settlement fields displayed depend on the balances of the selected customers. If your selection includes customers with both positive and negative balances, MediFlux provides options for handling both.

### Accounting Records For Balance Settlements

When customer balances are settled during bulk deletion, MediFlux automatically records the corresponding transactions in **Accounting → Journals**.

These records include:

| Settlement | Accounting record |
| --- | --- |
| **Refunded to Customer** | Records the customer refund |
| **Customer Credit Write-off** | Records the credit balance write-off |
| **Customer Paid** | Records the payment received from the customer |
| **Bad Debt / Waive Off** | Records the outstanding balance written off as bad debt |

This ensures that balance settlements remain traceable in accounting even after the customer profiles and ledger entries are deleted.

For more information, see [**Journals**](/docs/accounting/journals).

---

## Importing Customers

To import customer records in bulk, select **Actions → Import**.

The import process works in four steps:

1. **Upload**

   Upload your CSV or Excel file using **Select File** or drag and drop it into the upload area.

   You can also select **Download Template** to get a file with the expected column headers.

2. **Map Headers**

   Match the columns from your uploaded file to the corresponding MediFlux customer fields.

3. **Preview**

   Review the imported data and check for missing or incorrect information.

4. **Complete**

   Confirm the import to add the valid customer records to your Customer List.

![Import Customers](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783661173515-480779070-import-customers.png)
*Caption: Upload customer records using a CSV or Excel file.*

> **[Note]** Download the import template before preparing your file to make sure the column headers match the expected format.

---

## Exporting Customers

Select **Actions → Export** to open the **Export Customers** dialog.

You can choose which customer information to include, apply filters, and select the export format.

### Columns To Include

**Name** is included by default.

Additional columns include:

`GSTIN`, `License Number`, `Phone`, `Address`, `Created At`, `Last Payment Date`, `Last Bill Date`, and `Current Outstanding`.

Use **Deselect All** to clear the optional column selections.

### Filter By Date Ranges

You can filter the export using three date fields:

- **Created At**
- **Last Payment Date**
- **Last Bill Date**

Each supports date range options such as **All Time**, **This Month**, **Last Month**, **This Quarter**, **This Year**, **Last Year**, or a custom date range.

### Filter By Outstanding

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Has outstanding** | Includes customers with an outstanding balance |
| **No outstanding** | Includes customers with no outstanding balance |
| **All** | Includes customers regardless of outstanding balance |

You can also enter a **Min (₹)** and **Max (₹)** outstanding amount.

### Sort By

Choose the field and sorting order for the exported records.

### Export Format

Select the export format:

- **Export PDF**
- **Export Excel**

![Export Customers](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783661247374-941995045-export.png)
*Caption: Select customer columns, date filters, outstanding balance filters, and export format.*

---

## Where To Go From Here


  * [Add a Customer](/docs/customers/add-customer) - Create a new customer profile.
  * [Customer Ledger](/docs/customers/customer-ledger) - Track payments, credit, and outstanding dues.
  * [Accounting Journals](/docs/accounting/journals) - Review accounting entries created for customer balance settlements.
  * [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - View all sales and filter by customer.

docs/customers/customer-profile.title: Customer Profile
docs/customers/customer-profile.description: View a customer's complete sales history, outstanding balance, and manage their details from one page.
docs/customers/customer-profile.body: # Customer Profile Clicking on any customer's name in the Customer List opens their **Customer Profile**, a dedicated page showing everything about that customer in one place. From here you can view their sales history, track outstanding dues, and take actions like editing details or recording a new sale. --- ## Profile Header At the top of the page you'll see: - A **Created by You** badge, indicating this profile was created by you - The customer's name in large text under the **CUSTOMER** label - **Last edited** timestamp showing when the profile was last updated - The customer's **phone number, email, and address** displayed on the right side of the header ![Profile header](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783662350918-645919954-customer-profile.png) *Caption: Customer name, contact details, and last edited timestamp.* --- ## Summary Cards Four stat cards sit below the header giving you a quick snapshot of this customer: | Card | What it shows | | --- | --- | | **Total Sales** | The all-time total amount of sales made to this customer | | **Number of Sales** | Total number of sales transactions with this customer | | **Total Refund** | Total amount refunded to this customer | | **You'll Pay / You'll Get** | Shows **You'll Pay** if you owe this customer money. Shows **You'll Get** if this customer owes you money | ![Summary cards, You'll Get](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783662247423-151895708-customer-summarycards.png) *Caption: Example showing the You'll Get state when the customer owes you.* ![Summary cards, You'll Pay](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783662650990-966716158-customerprofile-youllpay.png) *Caption: Example showing the You'll Pay state when you owe the customer.* > **[Note]** The fourth card label changes depending on who owes whom, **You'll Pay** means you owe the customer (for example, after a refund or credit), while **You'll Get** means the customer has an outstanding balance owed to you. --- ## Page-Level Actions Three buttons and a menu sit at the top-right of the customer profile: | Button | What it does | | --- | --- | | **Add Sale** | Create a new sale entry directly linked to this customer | | **Ledger** | Jump to this customer's individual ledger | | **More** | Opens a dropdown with additional actions | ### Add Sale Click **Add Sale** to create a new sale entry directly linked to this customer, without having to search for or select the customer again in the sale form. ### Ledger Click **Ledger** to jump straight to this customer's individual ledger, showing their full transaction history, running balance, and options to add payments or adjustments. ![Action buttons](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783662778870-66190072-page-level-actions.png) *Caption: Quick access to the customer's sale and transaction ledger.* ### More Menu Options | Option | What it does | | --- | --- | | **Sales** | View all sales linked to this customer | | **Edit** | Edit the customer's profile details | | **Delete** | Delete this customer profile | ![More menu](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783662778869-687137828-more-button.png) *Caption: Additional actions available from the dropdown menu.* --- ## Recent Sales Below the summary cards, the **Recent Sales** table shows the latest sale entries recorded for this customer: | Column | Description | | --- | --- | | **Date** | Date and time the sale was recorded | | **Invoice** | Invoice number of the sale | | **Drugs** | Number of drug line items in the sale | | **Amount** | Total value of the sale | | **Method** | Payment method used for the sale | | **Actions** | Options to View, open Invoice, or Edit the sale entry | ![Recent Sales table](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783662928189-497719953-recent-sales-actions.png) *Caption: Latest sales with actions menu open showing View, Invoice, and Edit options.* --- ## Notes At the bottom of the profile, the **Notes** section displays any internal remarks entered when the customer was first created. If no notes were added, it shows **No remarks provided**. To update the notes, use the **Edit** option from the **More** menu. > **[Warning: Common mistake to avoid]** **Trying to edit the Opening Outstanding from the customer profile** > > The Opening Outstanding field is locked once the customer is saved and cannot be changed from the Edit form. If the original amount was wrong, you'll need to correct it through the customer's Ledger. --- ## From This Profile * [Ledger](/docs/customers/customer-ledger) - Track transactions, payments, and running balance. * [Billing Notes](/docs/customers/billing-notes) - Set special pricing or credit terms for this customer. * [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - View all sales and filter by this customer. * [Customer List](/docs/customers/customer-list) - Browse and manage all your customers.

docs/customers/customer-trash.title: Customer Trash
docs/customers/customer-trash.description: View and restore deleted customer profiles.
docs/customers/customer-trash.body:
# Customer Trash

The **Trash** page holds all customer profiles that have been deleted from your system. Deleted customers are not permanently removed immediately. They stay in Trash so you can restore them if needed.

Navigate here from the sidebar: **Customers → Trash**.

---

## The Trash Table
The Trash page shows the same table structure as the Customer List in list view:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Name** | Customer name with type (Consumer/Business) shown below |
| **Age** | Customer's age if added. Shows `—` if not provided |
| **Gender** | Customer's gender if added |
| **Phone** | Primary contact number |
| **Email** | Customer's email address |
| **Outstanding** | Amount owed by this customer at time of deletion |
| **Last Payment** | Date of last payment. Shows `—` if none recorded |
| **Actions** | Options to manage the deleted customer |

The page shows a **Found X** count above the table.

![Customer Trash page](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783665113513-310023942-customer-trash.png)
*Caption: Trash table showing a deleted customer with all details and actions.*

---

## Searching In Trash
The search bar at the top works the same as the Customer List. Search across **names, phone numbers, emails, and addresses**.
![Search deleted customers](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783665226263-260542003-customer-trash-searchbar.png)
*Caption: Search across names, phone numbers, emails, and addresses to find deleted customers instantly.*
---

## Row Actions
Clicking the **three-dot menu (⋮)** on any row gives you two options:

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **View Sales** | View all sales history linked to this customer even after deletion |
| **Restore** | Restores the customer profile back to your active Customer List |

> **[Note]** Restoring a customer brings back their full profile, sales history, and outstanding balance exactly as it was at the time of deletion.
---
## Restore And Continue

  * [Customer List](/docs/customers/customer-list) - Find restored customers back in your active list.
  * [Customer Profile](/docs/customers/customer-profile) - Review and update a restored customer's details.
  * [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - View all sales including those from restored customers.
  * [Customer Ledger](/docs/customers/customer-ledger) - Check outstanding balance after restoring a customer.

docs/customers/overview.title: Customers
docs/customers/overview.description: Manage pharmacy customers in MediFlux. Track outstanding Udhaar payments, record sales, manage billing notes, and maintain GST-ready ledgers.
docs/customers/overview.body:
# Customers

The **Customers** section is your central hub for managing everyone your pharmacy sells to in **MediFlux**. This includes individual consumers, businesses, and other pharmacy stores linked through our platform. From adding a new customer profile to tracking outstanding dues and managing billing notes, everything you need to maintain accurate customer accounts is here.

---

## Overview
Customer profiles connect directly to your sales workflow so staff can quickly look up accounts, record payments, and review past purchases and outstanding balances, all without leaving the MediFlux platform.

---

## What You Can Do In Customers
- **Maintain a customer directory:** Store contact details, GSTIN, license numbers, and ratings for every customer.
- **Track outstanding payments:** See at a glance how much each customer owes you and the total across all customers.
- **View sales history:** Every sale is linked to the customer it was made to.
- **Record payments:** Mark dues as paid and keep your ledger accurate.
- **Manage billing notes:** Record and track credit notes issued to customers and debit notes raised by connected retailers.
- **Accept or reject store link requests:** Connect with other pharmacy stores on MediFlux as linked customers.
- **Export customer data:** Download customer data as PDF or Excel for accounting and audits.

---

## Navigating the Customers Section
The **Customers** section in the left sidebar expands into five main pages:

| Page | What it's for |
| --- | --- |
| **Customer List** | View, search, and manage all your customer profiles |
| **Ledger** | See a consolidated ledger of all entries across every customer |
| **Store Requests** | Accept or reject requests from other pharmacy stores wanting to link as a customer |
| **Billing Notes** | Manage debit notes raised by connected retailers and credit notes issued to customers |
| **Trash** | Recover removed customer profiles |

![MediFlux Pharmacy Customer Management Sidebar](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783659084964-852540645-customer-sidbar.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux left sidebar showing Customer List, Ledger, Store Requests, Billing Notes, and Trash navigation options.*

---

## Quick Actions From The Dashboard
You don't have to navigate to the Customers section to add a customer or record a payment. The **`+` button** in the top-right corner of any screen gives you instant access to the most common actions from anywhere in MediFlux:

- **Add Customer:** Create a new customer profile without leaving the dashboard.
- **Add Customer Payment:** Record a payment directly without navigating away.

![MediFlux Dashboard Quick Add Customer Menu](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783659084961-915579957-customer-quickAdd.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux dashboard quick-add menu showing Add Customer and Add Customer Payment options for fast workflow.*

> **[Note]** The `+` quick-add menu is available on every screen, not just the dashboard. Use it whenever you need to add a customer or record a payment without breaking your current workflow.

---

## Customer Types
MediFlux distinguishes between two types of customers:

**Linked Stores** are other pharmacy stores on the MediFlux platform that you've connected with as a customer. These are typically used when you supply to or transact with another pharmacy. These connections start as a Store Request, which you can accept or reject.

**Local Customers** are individual consumers or businesses you add manually. These are your regular walk-in customers, regular buyers, or local businesses.

When adding a local customer, you can choose between two profiles:

**Consumer:** For individual walk-in patients. Supports fields like age, gender, Aadhaar number, and PMJAY/Ayushman Bharat scheme details.

**Business:** For businesses or other pharmacies you supply to. Supports fields like business name, license number, and GSTIN.

You can filter your customer list by type at any time using the **Linked Stores** and **Local Customers** quick-filter chips.

---

## Customer List
The **Customer List** is your complete customer directory. View all your customers at a glance with contact details, outstanding balances, and customer ratings. Search by name, phone, or GSTIN. Filter by linked stores or local customers. Click any customer to view their full profile, sales history, and ledger.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Customer List Directory](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783659400339-441793118-customerlist-overview.png)
*Caption: The complete MediFlux customer directory with search, filters, and outstanding balance metrics.*

---

## Ledger
The **Ledger** page gives you a complete financial record of all your customer transactions. View a consolidated ledger across all customers at once, or click into any individual customer to see their dedicated ledger with a running balance. Track sales, payments, credit notes, and manual adjustments. Filter by date range, entry type, and payment method. Export entries as PDF or Excel.

![MediFlux Customer Ledger and Payment Tracking](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783659510887-231343907-customerledger-overview.png)
*Caption: Consolidated and individual pharmacy customer ledgers in MediFlux with balance tracking and export options.*

---

## Store Requests
The **Store Requests** page shows incoming connection requests from other pharmacy stores on the MediFlux platform who want to link with you as a customer. Review each request, check the requesting store's details, and choose to **Accept** or **Reject**. Once accepted, the store appears as a Linked Store in your Customer List and you can start transacting with them seamlessly.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Store Connection Requests](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783659729261-409006637-storerequests-overview.png)
*Caption: Review and manage incoming link requests from other pharmacy stores on the MediFlux platform.*

---

## Billing Notes
The **Billing Notes** page tracks all credit notes you've issued to customers and debit notes raised by connected retailers. View status, amounts, and settlement details in one place. Filter by date, customer, or note type to stay on top of returns and adjustments. This keeps your customer accounts accurate and audit-ready.

![MediFlux Customer Billing Notes Management](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783659729253-991871219-billingnotes-overview.png)
*Caption: Track credit notes issued and debit notes received from pharmacy customers in MediFlux.*

---

## Trash
Deleted customers aren't gone forever. The **Trash** page holds all customer profiles that have been removed from your system, so you can restore them if needed. View deletion history, check outstanding balances at the time of deletion, and restore customers back to your active directory with one click. All linked sales records and ledger entries are preserved even after deletion.

![MediFlux Deleted Customer Recovery](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783659729252-799752974-trash-overview.png)
*Caption: Recover deleted pharmacy customers in MediFlux and view their preserved sales history.*

---

## Common Mistakes To Avoid
> **[Warning: Forgetting to add the opening outstanding balance]** If a customer already owes you money before you add them to MediFlux, make sure to enter it in the **Opening Outstanding** field when creating their profile. This field cannot be edited after saving. If you forget, correct it through the customer's [Ledger](/docs/customers/customer-ledger) using an **Adjustment entry**.

> **[Warning: Skipping GSTIN and License Number for business customers]** These fields are optional but highly recommended for business customers. Without a GSTIN, your sales entries will not be GST-ready, which can cause issues when generating GSTR reports.

---

## FAQs

  ### What is the difference between a Linked Store and a Local Customer?

A Linked Store is another pharmacy on MediFlux that has connected with you through a Store Request. A Local Customer is anyone you add manually, whether individual consumers or businesses. Both appear in your Customer List and work the same way once added.
  ### Can I add both Consumer and Business profiles?

Yes. When adding a new customer, you choose whether they are a Consumer or a Business. Each type has its own set of fields suited to that customer type.
  ### What happens to sales history if I delete a customer?

All sales records and ledger entries are preserved even after a customer is deleted. You can still view them from the Trash page via **View Sales**. Restore the customer at any time to bring them back to your active list.
  ### Can I track how much all my customers owe me at once?

Yes. The Customer List page shows a summary card with the total outstanding amount across all customers. The Ledger page also shows a running total at the bottom of the customer panel.
  ### Is the PMJAY/Ayushman Bharat checkbox mandatory?

No. It is optional. Tick it only if the customer is a registered PMJAY beneficiary. It does not apply any automatic discount. It simply tags the customer so their sales can be handled separately during billing and tracked in PMJAY sales reports.


---

## Next Steps

  * [Customer List](/docs/customers/customer-list) - View, search, and manage all your customer profiles.
  * [Add a Customer](/docs/customers/add-customer) - Create a new customer profile.
  * [Ledger](/docs/customers/customer-ledger) - Track customer transactions and payment history.
  * [Store Requests](/docs/customers/store-request) - Accept or reject link requests from other pharmacy stores.
  * [Billing Notes](/docs/customers/billing-notes) - Manage credit and debit notes for customers.
  * [Trash](/docs/customers/customer-trash) - Recover deleted customer profiles and view their history.

docs/customers/store-request.title: Store Requests
docs/customers/store-request.description: Accept or reject requests from other pharmacy stores on MediFlux who want to connect with you as a customer.
docs/customers/store-request.body:
# Store Requests

When another pharmacy store on MediFlux adds you as their **supplier** (via the Link Supplier option in their Suppliers section), a request is sent to you. This request appears on the **Store Requests** page, where you can choose to accept or reject the connection.

Navigate here from the sidebar: **Customers → Store Requests**.

---

## How Store Requests Work
When another pharmacy store on MediFlux uses **Link Supplier** to connect with your store, a request is sent to you. It appears on your **Store Requests** page, showing the requesting store's name, contact person, phone number, email, and address. From here you can **Accept** or **Reject** the connection, accepting adds them to your Customer List as a **Linked Store**.

---

## Viewing A Request
Each request is shown as a card with the following details:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Store Name** | Name of the pharmacy requesting to link with you |
| **Contact Person** | Name of the contact person at that store |
| **Phone Number** | Their contact number |
| **Email** | Their email address |
| **Address** | Their store address |
| **Request Date** | When the request was sent |

![Pending store request](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783664090317-753756925-store-request-sidebar.png)
*Caption: Store request card showing store details and Accept/Reject actions.*

---

## Accepting A Request
Click **Accept** on a request card. A confirmation dialog appears:

> **Accept Request?**
> Store manager will be able to see your store on his dashboard once you accept the request.

Click **Confirm** to accept, or **Cancel** to go back without accepting.

![Accept Request confirmation](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783664090311-101534203-aceppt-request.png)
*Caption: Confirmation dialog before accepting a store link request.*

Once accepted, the store is added to your **Customer List** as a **Linked Store**, and they will be able to see your store as a supplier on their end.

---

## Rejecting A Request
Click **Reject** on a request card. A confirmation dialog appears:

> **Reject Request?**
> You'll have to wait for the supplier to resubmit the request if you reject it.

Click **Confirm** to reject, or **Cancel** to go back without rejecting.

![Reject Request confirmation](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783664090310-525795748-reject-request.png)
*Caption: Confirmation dialog before rejecting a store link request.*

> **[Note]** If you reject a request, the requesting store will need to send the link request again from their end if they want to reconnect.

---

## Searching Requests
Use the search bar at the top to search through requests by **names, phones, emails, or addresses**.

![Search Bar](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783664218431-611690353-request-searhbar.png)
*Caption: Use search bar to search through requests by names, phone , emails , or addresses.*
---
## Connected Workflows

  * [Customer List](/docs/customers/customer-list) - Browse and manage all your customers.
  * [Supplier List](/docs/supplier/supplier-list) - Link to other pharmacies who supply you.
  * [Add Wholesale Sale](/docs/sales/add-wholesale) - Create bulk sale bills for linked stores.
  * [Catalog Share](/docs/inventory/catalog-share) - Share your drug catalog with connected stores.

docs/contributing/how-to-write.title: How to Write Docs
docs/contributing/how-to-write.description: Internal guide for the MediFlux documentation team, file structure, frontmatter, components, and writing conventions.
docs/contributing/how-to-write.body:
# How to Write Docs

> **[Note: Internal only]** This page is **not linked in the sidebar or navigation**. Share the URL directly with team members: `/docs/how-to-write`. Do not add this file to any `meta.json`.

This guide covers everything you need to author, organize, and publish MediFlux documentation. The site is built with [Fumadocs](https://fumadocs.dev) + Next.js. Documentation lives under `content/docs/`. Help & FAQs live under `content/help/` with the same folder, `meta.json`, and MDX component setup.

## Quick Reference
| Task | What to do |
| ---- | ---------- |
| Add a new page | Create `content/docs/{section}/{slug}.mdx` |
| Set the URL | File path maps to `/docs/{section}/{slug}` (omit `index` for section roots) |
| Show in sidebar | Add the slug to that section's `meta.json` → `pages` array |
| Page title & SEO | Set `title` and `description` in frontmatter |
| Sidebar icon (docs only) | Set `icon` to a [Lucide](https://lucide.dev/icons) icon name (PascalCase) |
| FAQ tags (help only) | Set `tags` to a list of strings, e.g. `[sales, gst]` |
| Related docs (help only) | Set `related` to `/docs/...` URLs for the full guides |
| Add a Help FAQ | Create `content/help/{section}/{slug}.mdx` and add the slug to that section's `meta.json` |
| Step-by-step guides | Use `<Steps>` + `<Step>` |
| Link grids on index pages | Use `<Cards>` + `<Card>` |
| Full-width link rows | Use `<WideCards>` + `<WideCard>` |

---

## File Structure And URLs
All documentation files live in `content/docs/`. The folder structure determines the URL:

```text
📁 content/docs/
📁 introduction/
  📄 index.mdx → /docs/introduction
  📄 getting-started.mdx → /docs/introduction/getting-started
  📄 meta.json
📁 sales/
  📄 index.mdx → /docs/sales
  📄 create-sale.mdx → /docs/sales/add-sale-retail
  📄 meta.json
  📄 meta.json (root navigation)
  📄 how-to-write.mdx → /docs/how-to-write (hidden)
```

### Naming Rules
- Use **kebab-case** for file and folder names: `create-sale.mdx`, not `CreateSale.mdx`.
- Every section folder should have an **`index.mdx`**: this is the landing page for that section (e.g. `/docs/sales`).
- Co-locate a **`meta.json`** inside each section folder to control sidebar order.

### Where To Put A New Page
1. Pick the section (e.g. `sales`, `purchases`, `introduction`).
2. Create `{section}/{slug}.mdx`.
3. Add the slug (without `.mdx`) to `{section}/meta.json` under `"pages"`.
4. If you created a **new section**, also add the folder name to the root `content/docs/meta.json`.

Example, adding a page to Sales:

```json title="content/docs/sales/meta.json"
{
  "title": "Sales",
  "pages": ["index", "create-sale", "returns", "your-new-page"]
}
```

Example, root navigation with section dividers:

```json title="content/docs/meta.json"
{
  "title": "MediFlux",
  "pages": [
    "---Introduction---",
    "introduction",
    "---Sales---",
    "sales"
  ]
}
```

Strings like `"---Introduction---"` render as **non-clickable section labels** in the sidebar.

---

## Help & FAQs
Help articles use the same MDX components and `meta.json` navigation as docs. They live in `content/help/` and map to `/help/{section}/{slug}`.

Do **not** put an `index.mdx` at the help root: `/help` is the searchable FAQ list. Each section still needs its own `index.mdx` and `meta.json`.

### Help vs documentation
Keep these as two layers, not two copies of the same page.

| | Documentation (`content/docs`) | Help & FAQs (`content/help`) |
| - | --- | --- |
| Job | Explain how a feature works | Unblock someone who is stuck |
| Voice | “Here is Sales List and what you can do” | “How do I find last week’s bill?” |
| Length | Full guide | Short answer, then a link to the guide |
| In-page FAQs | Short accordion answers on the doc are fine | Do not paste the whole doc into Help |

Rules:

1. **Docs own the feature.** Help should not retell the full workflow.
2. **Help owns the stuck moment.** Write the question the way a pharmacist would ask it.
3. **Link, don’t copy.** Every Help article should set `related` to one or more `/docs/...` URLs. Those render as “Related documentation” under the answer.
4. **Doc-page FAQs stay short.** If an accordion answer on a doc grows past a few sentences, move it to Help and link there.

```yaml
---
title: Why is GST not applying on a sale?
description: Check tax settings, item HSN, and customer GSTIN when GST is missing from a bill.
tags: [sales, gst, billing]
related:
  - /docs/sales/add-sale-retail
---
```

- Use `title` and `description` the same way as docs.
- Use `tags` instead of `icon`. Tags appear as filters on `/help`.
- Use `related` for the canonical doc pages. Titles and descriptions are pulled from those pages.
- Add the slug to `{section}/meta.json`, and add new sections to `content/help/meta.json`.
- Search on `/help` matches title, description, tags, section, **and the answer body**.

---

## Frontmatter
Every MDX file starts with YAML frontmatter between `---` delimiters:

```yaml
---
title: Create Sale
description: Learn how to create and process a new sale transaction.
icon: Plus
---
```

### Supported Fields
| Field | Required | Description |
| ----- | -------- | ----------- |
| `title` | Yes | Page heading (H1) and browser tab title |
| `description` | Recommended | Subtitle under the title; used for SEO and search |
| `icon` | Optional | Docs only. Lucide icon name for search results and cards that link to this page |
| `tags` | Optional | Help & FAQs only. List of strings shown as filters on `/help` |
| `related` | Optional | Help & FAQs only. List of `/docs/...` URLs shown as related guides |
| `badge` | Optional | Small label (reserved for future use) |
| `enableToc` | Optional | Show table of contents on the right (default: `true`). Set `false` for short pages |
| `index` | Optional | Fumadocs index flag (default: `false`) |

### Icons
Use any icon name from [Lucide Icons](https://lucide.dev/icons) in **PascalCase**:

```yaml
icon: ShoppingCart   # ✓
icon: shopping-cart  # ✗ won't render
```

Icons appear in search results and are auto-filled on `<Card>` / `<WideCard>` when you link to a page that has an `icon` set.

---

## Writing A Doc
### Structure
Follow this pattern for most guides:

1. **Opening paragraph**, what the page covers and who it's for (2–4 sentences).
