2. **Prerequisites or context**, link to related pages if needed.
3. **Main sections**, use `##` for top-level sections (these appear in the table of contents).
4. **Steps or tabs**, for procedural or multi-path content.
5. **Reference tables or code**, for API fields, shortcuts, config options.
6. **Next steps**, cards linking to related docs.

### Headings
- Use a single `#` only if you need an in-page heading: the page `title` in frontmatter is already rendered as the H1.
- Use `##` for main sections (shown in TOC).
- Use `###` inside steps, tabs, or accordions.
- Keep heading text short and scannable.

### Links
Internal links use root-relative paths:

```markdown
See [Installation](/docs/introduction/installation) for setup steps.
```

External links open in a new tab automatically. You don't need to add `target="_blank"`.

### Text Formatting
```markdown
**Bold** for UI labels and emphasis.
*Italic* for terms on first use.
`inline code` for keys, commands, and field names.
```

Keyboard shortcuts use the `<kbd>` HTML tag:

Press <kbd>F2</kbd> to start a new sale.

### Lists
Unordered:

```markdown
- First item
- Second item
  - Nested item
```

Ordered:

```markdown
1. Step one
2. Step two
3. Step three
```

---

## Standard Markdown Elements
These work out of the box, no custom components needed.

### Tables
Tables are wrapped automatically in a responsive scroll container:

| Column | Type | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ----------- |
| `id` | string | Unique identifier |
| `status` | enum | `pending`, `completed` |

### Code Blocks
Use fenced code blocks with an optional language and title:

````markdown
```typescript title="Example: Create a sale"
const sale = await fetch("/v1/sales", { method: "POST" });
```
````

Features:

- Syntax highlighting for common languages
- **Copy button** on hover
- Title bar when you add `title="..."` after the language

Supported title syntax: ` ```lang title="My title" ` or the `data-title` attribute.

### Images
Standard Markdown images get a styled figure with the alt text as caption:

```markdown
![Dashboard overview](https://example.com/image.png)
```

For separate title and description, use the `Figure` component (see [Media](#media)).

---

## Components
All components below are registered in `lib/mdx-components.tsx` and available in every MDX file without importing.

### Callout
Highlighted boxes for tips, warnings, and important notes.

**Props:** `type` (`info` | `warning` | `success` | `danger` | `note`), optional `title`

```mdx
> **[Info]** MediFlux supports both cloud and on-premise deployments.

> **[Warning: Important]** Prescription items require pharmacist verification before payment.
```

**Shorthand aliases:**

```mdx
> **[Note]** Same as Callout type="info".
> **[Warning]** Same as Callout type="warning".
```

<Callout type="info">
  This is a live `info` callout.
</Callout>

<Callout type="warning" title="Example warning">
  This is a live `warning` callout with a title.
</Callout>

<Callout type="success">
  This is a live `success` callout.
</Callout>

<Callout type="danger">
  This is a live `danger` callout.
</Callout>

<Callout type="note" title="Example note">
  This is a live `note` callout.
</Callout>

---

### Steps
Numbered vertical steps for procedures. Each step can contain headings, paragraphs, code, and callouts.

**`<Steps>` props:** optional `className`

**`<Step>` props:** optional `title` (renders above step body; you can also use `###` headings inside)

```mdx
1. **First step**

   Body text for step one.

2. ### Or Use A Heading Inside
    Body text for step two.
```

<Steps>
  <Step title="Example step one">
    Steps render with numbered circles and a connecting line.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Example step two">
    Nest callouts, code blocks, and lists inside steps freely.
  </Step>
</Steps>

---

### Tabs
Switch between alternative content (install methods, languages, auth types).

**`<Tabs>` props:** `items` (tab labels), optional `defaultValue`, optional `className`

**`<Tab>` props:** `value` (must match an entry in `items`), optional `label`

```mdx
### Docker

Docker install instructions…

### Manual

Manual install instructions…
```

<Tabs items={["Tab A", "Tab B"]}>
  <Tab value="Tab A">
    Content for tab A.
  </Tab>
  <Tab value="Tab B">
    Content for tab B.
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

---

### Cards
Grid of link cards, ideal for section index pages and "Explore" sections.

**`<Cards>` / `<CardGroup>` props:** `cols` (`1` | `2` | `3` | `4`, default `2`)

**`<Card>` props:** `title`, `description`, `icon`, `href`, optional `className`

When `href` points to an internal doc page, **title, description, and icon are auto-filled** from that page's frontmatter if you omit them.

```mdx

  * [Create Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Step-by-step sale workflow.
  * [Returned Sales](/docs/sales/returned-sales)

```

<Cards cols={2}>
  <Card
    title="Cards example"
    description="Grid layout with optional icons and links."
    icon="LayoutGrid"
  />
  <Card
    title="Linked card"
    description="Links to the sales section."
    href="/docs/sales"
  />
</Cards>

---

### Wide Cards
Full-width stacked link rows, good for "Next steps" at the bottom of a page.

**`<WideCards>` props:** optional `className`

**`<WideCard>` props:** `title`, `description`, `icon`, `href`, `target`, optional `className`

External URLs open in a new tab automatically. Use `target="_blank"` to force it on internal links if needed.

```mdx

  * [Installation](/docs/introduction/installation)
  * [External link](https://example.com) - Opens in a new tab.

```

<WideCards>
  <WideCard
    title="Wide card example"
    description="Full-width card for prominent links."
    icon="ArrowRight"
  />
</WideCards>

---

### Accordion
Collapsible sections for FAQ-style or advanced content.

Use `<Accordions>` as the wrapper and `<Accordion>` for each item (these names map to the underlying Accordion / AccordionItem components).

**`<Accordions>` props:** `type` (`single` | `multiple`, default `single`)

**`<Accordion>` props:** `title` (required), optional `value`

```mdx

  ### First question

Answer content here.
  ### Second question

More answer content.

```

<Accordions>
  <Accordion title="What is an accordion?">
    A collapsible panel for dense or optional content.
  </Accordion>
  <Accordion title="When should I use it?">
    FAQ sections, advanced config, or content most readers can skip.
  </Accordion>
</Accordions>

---

### Badge
Inline status labels.

**Props:** `variant` (`default` | `secondary` | `destructive` | `outline`)

```mdx
**[New]**
**[Beta]**
**[Deprecated]**
**[Optional]**
```

Examples: <Badge>New</Badge> <Badge variant="secondary">Beta</Badge> <Badge variant="destructive">Deprecated</Badge> <Badge variant="outline">Optional</Badge>

---

### File Tree
Visual folder structure for explaining project layout.

**`<FileTree>` props:** optional `className`

**`<FileTreeFolder>` props:** `name`, optional `defaultOpen`, children

**`<FileTreeFile>` props:** `name`, optional `active`

```mdx
```text
📁 src/
  📄 index.ts
  📄 utils.ts
```
```

---

### Media
#### Figure
Image with separate title and description (better than Markdown when you need both).

**Props:** `src`, `title`, optional `description`, optional `alt`, optional `className`

```mdx
![Example screenshot](https://picsum.photos/seed/example/800/400)
*Caption: Replace with a real product screenshot.*
```

#### YouTube
**Props:** `id` or `url`, optional `title`, optional `description`

```mdx
> **Video:** [Walkthrough](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ)
> **Video:** [Walkthrough](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=)
```

#### Video
Hosted MP4 or other video URL.

**Props:** `src`, optional `title`, optional `description`

```mdx
> **Video:** [Product demo](https://example.com/demo.mp4)
```

---

## Putting It Together, Checklist
Before opening a PR for a new doc page:

1. File is in the correct section folder with kebab-case name
2. Frontmatter has `title` and `description`
3. `icon` is set (PascalCase Lucide name)
4. Slug added to section `meta.json` (unless intentionally hidden like this page)
5. Opening paragraph explains purpose without repeating the title
6. `##` headings structure the page and populate the TOC
7. Procedures use `<Steps>`; alternatives use `<Tabs>`
8. Code blocks include `title="..."` when the snippet needs context
9. Internal links use `/docs/...` paths
10. Index/landing pages link to child pages via `<Cards>`

---

## Local Development
```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000/docs/how-to-write](http://localhost:3000/docs/how-to-write) to preview this page.

After editing MDX, the dev server hot-reloads. If a new file doesn't appear, restart the dev server once so Fumadocs regenerates the content source.

---

## Adding A New Component
If the team needs a component that doesn't exist yet:

1. Create it in `components/mdx/your-component.tsx`
2. Register it in `lib/mdx-components.tsx` inside `getMdxComponents()`
3. Mirror the registration in `mdx-components.tsx` (used by the MDX bundler)
4. Document it on this page with props and a live example

Keep components in `components/mdx/` and follow existing patterns (Tailwind classes, `cn()` utility, client directive only when needed).

---

## Markdown Export
Every public doc page exposes a raw markdown version at `{url}.md` (e.g. `/docs/sales/add-sale-retail.md`). This is used by the "Copy markdown" action and LLM integrations. Write content so it reads well in both rendered and plain markdown form.

docs/introduction/dashboard-overview.title: Dashboard
docs/introduction/dashboard-overview.description: Explore the MediFlux pharmacy dashboard. View real-time stats on inventory, sales, payments, expired drugs, and drug movement to manage your store efficiently.
docs/introduction/dashboard-overview.body:
# Dashboard

The **MediFlux Dashboard** is the first screen you see when you log in. It gives you a real-time snapshot of everything happening in your pharmacy: how much stock you have, what your sales look like, who owes you money, which drugs have expired, and how your inventory is moving. No navigation required. Everything critical is surfaced automatically.

---

## Cards Overview

Below the banner, five summary cards give you an instant health check of your pharmacy business:

| Card | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Drugs** | Total number of unique drugs currently in your inventory |
| **Drug Value** | Total MRP value of all stock on hand |
| **Suppliers** | Number of supplier profiles linked to your store |
| **Supplier Outstanding** | Total amount you currently owe to all suppliers, shown in red |
| **Customers** | Number of customer profiles in your system |

![MediFlux Dashboard Overview Cards](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/a0c09e29-ef0c-41d1-8f99-1994145a55de-dashboad-overview-cards.png)
*Caption: Five summary cards on the MediFlux dashboard showing total drugs, drug value, suppliers, supplier outstanding, and customers.*

---

## Expired Drugs

If any drugs in your inventory have crossed their expiry date, they appear here in a dedicated table so you can take action immediately.

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **DRUG** | Name of the expired drug |
| **SUPPLIER** | Supplier the drug was purchased from |
| **EXPIRY** | Expiry date, shown in red |
| **QTY** | Quantity still in stock |

Click **View All** to jump to the full Drug List with expiry filters applied, where you can update or remove these items.

![MediFlux Expired Drugs Table](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/f50546d5-59fa-4a19-8ae3-4463e98cf024-expired-drugs-dashboard.png)
*Caption: Dashboard table highlighting expired pharmacy drugs with supplier, expiry date, and quantity for quick action.*

---

## Sales Performance

The **Sales** section shows your pharmacy's revenue performance over time. Use the **Last 7 Days** dropdown or click **Custom** to change the date range.

| Element | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Sales Overview** | Total sales value for the selected period |
| **Profit vs Sales chart** | A line graph comparing profit (green) against total sales (teal) day by day |
| **Collected on Sale** | Percentage of sales revenue collected upfront |
| **Payment breakdown** | How much came via Cash, UPI, Net Banking, and how much is still on Credit |
| **Collected / On Credit** | Total cash collected versus total amount still outstanding from customers |

![MediFlux Sales Performance Chart](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/66d53c63-563e-4603-b0f7-21fb73456d40-sales-dashboard.png)
*Caption: Revenue chart on the MediFlux dashboard showing profit vs sales trend and payment method breakdown.*

> **[Note]** If **On Credit** is high, it means a large portion of your revenue is tied up in customer dues. Use the **Customers → Ledger** page to follow up on outstanding payments.

---

## Payment Analytics

The **Payment Analytics** section (marked **New**) tracks how effectively you're converting billed amounts into actual cash.

| Card | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Collections Over Time** | Total cash collected in the selected period, with a billed vs collected trend chart |
| **Net Receivable** | Total outstanding amount across all your books |
| **Collected (Last 7d)** | Actual cash recovered in the last 7 days |
| **Billed (Last 7d)** | New credit extended to customers in the last 7 days |
| **Credit Expansion (Last 30d)** | How much new credit was given versus how much was recovered |
| **Avg Daily Recovery** | Rolling average of daily collections over the last 7 days |
| **Stale Balances (45d+)** | Old outstanding amounts that haven't been paid in over 45 days |
| **Highest Exposure** | The customer who owes you the most, with their name and amount |
| **Payment Regularity** | Percentage of customers who paid on time vs total billed customers |

![MediFlux Payment Analytics](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/e3115a8c-6126-4888-910b-b43ae9b53685-payment-analytics.png)
*Caption: Collections trend, net receivable, recovery stats, and credit health metrics on the pharmacy dashboard.*

> **[Warning: Concentration Risk]** If a small number of customers hold a large percentage of your total receivables, a banner appears at the top warning you that **Top 20% of customers hold X% of your receivables**. This means your cash flow depends heavily on just a few accounts. Follow up on these immediately.

---

## Drug Movement

The **Drug Movement** section shows which pharmacy drugs are selling fast and which are sitting idle.

| Tab | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **By Quantity Sold** | Drugs ranked by total units sold in the selected period |
| **By Sales Velocity** | Drugs ranked by how quickly they turn over |

Each side lists drugs with their sold quantity, split into:

- **Fast Moving:** your best sellers, the drugs that move off the shelf quickly
- **Slow Moving:** drugs with low or no sales activity, potential dead stock

Use the **This Month** dropdown to change the period, or click **PDF** / **CSV** to export the list.

![MediFlux Drug Movement Report](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/ffb9fef2-1d30-4c71-b7a9-eff3e5c80b2e-drug-movement.png)
*Caption: Dashboard view of fast-moving and slow-moving pharmacy drugs with quantity sold.*

> **[Note]** Slow moving drugs tie up working capital and shelf space. Consider running promotions, returning them to suppliers via debit notes, or reducing future orders for these items.

---

## Next Steps


  * [Drugs](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - View and manage your full inventory.
  * [Sales](/docs/sales) - Record sales, issue credit notes, and manage returns.
  * [Customers](/docs/customers) - Manage customer profiles and track outstanding dues.
  * [Accounting](/docs/accounting) - View detailed financial reports and GST compliance.

docs/introduction/getting-started.title: Getting Started
docs/introduction/getting-started.description: Learn how to set up your MediFlux pharmacy software in minutes. Configure billing, import inventory, and make your first sale with our step-by-step guide.
docs/introduction/getting-started.body:
# Getting Started

This guide walks you through setting up **MediFlux pharmacy billing software** for the first time, from creating your cloud store to making your first sale. Whether you prefer a quick self-service setup or guided onboarding with our support team, you'll be up and running within minutes.

---

## What You Need
**MediFlux** is a web-based PWA that runs on any device with a browser and internet connection. **No downloads or local servers are required.**

| Component | Minimum | Recommended |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Operating System** | Any modern OS | Windows 10+, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS |
| **Processor** | Any dual-core CPU | Intel Core i3 or above |
| **RAM** | 2 GB | 4 GB or above |
| **Internet** | Basic connectivity (2 Mbps) | Stable 4G or broadband (5–10 Mbps) |
| **Browser** | Latest Chrome, Firefox, Edge | Chrome (latest version) |

Even pharmacies in remote areas with modest connectivity and basic desktops can operate efficiently.

---

## Creating Your Store
You have two ways to get started with your MediFlux setup:

| Method | Best for |
| --- | --- |
| **Self-service signup** | Pharmacy owners who want to explore the platform immediately |
| **Assisted onboarding** | Teams who want help with data migration, configuration, and staff training |

### Self-Service Signup
1. Go to the [Start Free Trial](https://app.mediflux.in/registration) page and enter your pharmacy details, GSTIN, and business type.

2. Your cloud store is provisioned instantly: **no downloads, no servers, no IT team required.**

3. Log in and start exploring the MediFlux dashboard right away.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Registration Form](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/08/86e84dd3-cbb6-4f6a-93f9-c4b96d85feb3-sign-up-page.png)
*Caption: Step 1 of the MediFlux signup flow: enter your store name, address, state, district, and pincode to create your cloud account.*

### Assisted Onboarding (Remote Setup)
1. Fill out the form on the [Start Free Trial](https://app.mediflux.in/registration) page with your basic pharmacy details.

2. Our support team will contact you to schedule a guided setup process.

3. We connect remotely (via UltraViewer) to help you understand the system and give you a live walkthrough.

4. We assist with importing or manually adding your stock and customer records.

5. We guide you through billing preferences, expiry alerts, and staff role configuration.

6. Training is provided remotely so your team can start using **MediFlux** confidently from day one.

---

## Configuring Your Store
Once your store is created, configure these basics before you start billing:

| Setting | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| **GST rates** | Set your default GST rates and HSN preferences under **Settings → Accounting Settings** |
| **Invoice templates** | Choose your bill format under **Settings → Bill Templates** |
| **Payment methods** | Configure accepted payment methods and linked bank accounts under **Settings → Accounting Settings** |
| **Customer credit policies** | Set credit limits and payment terms if you offer Udhaar (credit) sales |
| **User roles** | Add staff members and assign permissions under **Settings → User Management** |

---

## Adding Your Inventory
You can populate your pharmacy drug catalog in three easy ways:

| Method | How it works |
| --- | --- |
| **Excel import** | Upload your existing drug list via Excel. **MediFlux** pre-fills drug names, compositions, and HSN codes where available. |
| **Barcode scan** | Scan drug barcodes to auto-populate name, batch, expiry, MRP, and stock details. |
| **Manual entry** | Add medicines one by one through the **Drugs → Add Drug** form. |

![MediFlux Drug List and Inventory Management](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/08/ba5c3a04-acdb-47e5-b7ac-76a2d1a83587-drug-list.png)
*Caption: View your full pharmacy inventory, check stock levels, and use the Import button to bulk upload drugs via Excel.*

For detailed instructions, see our complete [Drug List Guide](/docs/inventory/drug-list).

---

## Making Your First Sale
Once your inventory is set up, you're ready to process your first pharmacy bill:

1. Go to **Sales → Add Sale** and select **Retail** or **Wholesale** mode.

2. Add a customer (or leave as a cash sale) and select drugs from your inventory.

3. Choose the payment status: **Paid**, **Unpaid**, or **Partial**.

4. Click **+ Add** to finalise the bill and print or share it via WhatsApp.

![MediFlux Add Retail Sale Screen](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/08/f5d9a796-0bca-4cef-9a58-d515f5113753-add-sale.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux retail sale form showing customer details, payment status, and the drug table ready for billing.*

Your first sale is now recorded. You can view it anytime in the [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list).

---

## Moving To A Paid Subscription
After your free trial, our team will guide you through purchasing a subscription. We offer **transparent yearly and multi-year plans with no hidden fees or surprise charges.** Payment can be made via UPI, net banking, or other secure channels.

| Step | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Receive your invoice and make payment through your preferred mode |
| 2 | **Subscription activates instantly** upon payment confirmation |
| 3 | Full access and continuous support continues with no downtime |

With your paid subscription, you get access to all advanced features, regular updates, and our support team whenever you need help.

---

## What's Next
Once your setup is complete, explore these features to get the most out of **MediFlux**:

![MediFlux Dashboard Overview](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/08/ed9cc5bd-a9c8-4492-a6e3-e9015c7d369f-dashboard.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux home screen showing key metrics, total drugs, drug value, suppliers, customers, and expired stock alerts.*

- **Expiry and stock alerts**: Get notified before drugs expire or run low
- **Sales analytics**: Track trends, profit margins, and top-selling drugs from the dashboard
- **GST reports**: Generate GSTR-1, GSTR-2, and GSTR-3B with one click
- **Customer and supplier ledgers**: Track credit, payments, and outstanding dues
- **Role-based access**: Control what each staff member can view and edit

> **[Info: Quick tip]** Click the **+ button** in the top bar from any page to quickly add a Sale, Purchase, Customer, Customer Payment, Supplier, or Supplier Payment without navigating through menus.

---

## FAQs

  ### How long does the free trial last?

The free trial gives you **full access for 7 days** with no credit card required.
  ### Can I switch from assisted onboarding to self-service later?

Yes. Even if you start with assisted onboarding, you retain full self-service access to all settings and features at any time.
  ### What happens to my data if I don't subscribe after the trial?

Your data remains in the system for a limited grace period. We recommend subscribing before the trial ends to avoid any interruption. Contact support if you need an extension.
  ### Do I need a GSTIN to use MediFlux?

**No.** While entering your GSTIN enables GST-compliant invoicing and reporting, you can use **MediFlux** for basic billing and inventory without it.
  ### Can I use MediFlux on multiple devices?

**Yes.** **MediFlux** syncs across all devices in real time. You can bill from your shop computer, check stock from your phone, and manage reports from a tablet.


---

## Next Steps

  * [Add Retail Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Create your first retail bill.
  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Manage and import your drug catalog.
  * [Settings: Account](/docs/settings/account-info) - Configure store details and preferences.
  * [Settings: User Management](/docs/settings/user-management) - Add staff and set permissions.

docs/introduction/installation.title: Installation & Setup
docs/introduction/installation.description: Install MediFlux pharmacy software in minutes. Choose self-service setup or free remote installation by our experts. No downloads required. Start your free trial today.
docs/introduction/installation.body:
# Installation & Setup

Before you can start billing, your MediFlux store needs to be created. **MediFlux is a cloud-based pharmacy billing software** that runs entirely in your browser. You can do this yourself in a few minutes, or have our support team connect remotely and set everything up for you. This page covers both paths, along with how to install MediFlux as an app on your device. Once your store is created, head to [Getting Started](/docs/introduction/getting-started) to configure billing, add inventory, and make your first sale.

---

## What You Need
MediFlux is a web-based PWA that runs on any device with a browser and internet connection. No downloads or local servers are required for the software itself.

| Component | Minimum | Recommended |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Operating System** | Any modern OS | Windows 10+, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS |
| **Processor** | Any dual-core CPU | Intel Core i3 or above |
| **RAM** | 2 GB | 4 GB or above |
| **Internet** | Basic connectivity (2 Mbps) | Stable 4G or broadband (5–10 Mbps) |
| **Browser** | Latest Chrome, Firefox, Edge | Chrome (latest version) |

Even pharmacies in remote areas with modest connectivity and basic desktops can run MediFlux comfortably. *(See our [Getting Started guide](/docs/introduction/getting-started) for next steps.)*

---

## Self-Service Setup
If you'd rather get started right away without waiting for support, sign up directly:

Go to the [Start Free Trial](https://app.mediflux.in/registration) page and enter your pharmacy details, GSTIN, and business type. Your cloud store is provisioned instantly. No downloads, no servers, and no IT team required.

Once done, log in and your store is ready to configure.

---

## Assisted Setup (Remote Installation)
If you'd prefer our team to handle the setup for you, we install and configure your store remotely using **UltraViewer**, a remote-access tool that lets our support team see and control your screen with your permission, so they can set things up exactly as you'd do it yourself.

**Here's how it works:**

You'll need UltraViewer running on the computer you want to set up. You can either download it directly from your browser, or our team will send you the installer file directly over WhatsApp, or [click here](https://www.ultraviewer.net/) to download.

Once UltraViewer is open, it displays a unique **ID** and **Password** for your computer. Share this ID and Password with our support team over call or chat. They'll enter it on their end and connect to your computer with your permission.

**From there, our team will:**

- Create and configure your MediFlux store
- Help import or manually add your stock and customer records
- Set up billing preferences, expiry alerts, and staff roles
- Walk you through the system live, so your team can start using MediFlux confidently

> **[Note]** You stay in control throughout the session. UltraViewer only allows access once you've shared your ID and Password, and you can close the connection at any time from your end.

![UltraViewer Remote Setup for MediFlux Installation](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/08/7a5d35c5-e6af-4ea9-889e-ebf21078dda0-ultraviewer-ss.png)
*Caption: UltraViewer interface showing ID and Password fields for remote MediFlux installation by the support team.*

---

## Installing MediFlux As An App
MediFlux can be installed directly on your desktop or mobile device as a standalone app, so it opens with its own icon instead of running inside a browser tab.

### Desktop (Windows)
1. Go to [mediflux.in](https://mediflux.in)
2. Scroll to the footer and click **Download for Windows**
3. Run the downloaded **MediFluxSetup.exe** installer

### Mobile (Android)
1. Go to [mediflux.in](https://mediflux.in) on your Android device
2. Scroll to the footer and click **GET IT ON Google Play**
3. Install the MediFlux app from the Play Store

> **[Note]** This is separate from the remote UltraViewer setup described above. Installing MediFlux as an app is simply a faster way to launch it on your own device. It doesn't involve anyone else connecting to your computer.

![Download MediFlux App for Windows and Android](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/08/8864ca9c-90e2-4269-98c0-1fa28a489b87-website-url-for-mediflux-app.png)
*Caption: Install MediFlux as a standalone app on a Windows desktop or Android mobile device for quick, easy access.*

---

> **[Success: You're in Control]** Close UltraViewer anytime once your store is configured. The connection ends immediately, with no lingering access.

---

## FAQs

  ### Do I need to install anything to use MediFlux day-to-day?

No, MediFlux runs entirely in your browser, or as an installed app if you prefer. UltraViewer is only needed temporarily if you choose assisted setup.
  ### Is it safe to share my UltraViewer ID and Password with support?

Yes, this only grants access for that specific session, and only after you've shared the credentials yourself. You can end the session at any time.
  ### Can I switch from self-service to assisted setup later, or vice versa?

Yes, reach out to our support team at any point and they can help you with either path.
  ### What happens after my store is set up?

Head to our [Getting Started guide](/docs/introduction/getting-started) to configure invoice templates, add inventory, and make your first sale.


---

## Start Using MediFlux
Your store is ready. Here's how to get billing.


  * [Getting Started](/docs/introduction/getting-started) - Configure your store, add inventory, and make your first sale.
  * [Account](/docs/settings/account-info) - Set up your store's business details, logo, signature, and stamp.
  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Import or add your drug catalog before you start billing.
  * [Add Retail Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Create your first sale once inventory and settings are in place.

docs/introduction/overview.title: Introduction
docs/introduction/overview.description: MediFlux is India's trusted cloud-native pharmacy billing and inventory software. Streamline operations, ensure GST compliance, and grow your business today.
docs/introduction/overview.body:
# Introduction

MediFlux is the **pharmacy management and billing software** trusted by **5,000+ pharmacies** across India. Built specifically for the Indian healthcare market, it unifies everything a pharmacy needs, from lightning-fast GST billing and barcode scanning to real-time inventory tracking, expiry management, customer and supplier ledgers, advanced accounting, and intelligent analytics into one intuitive, cloud-native platform.

Whether you run a single medical retail counter, a wholesale distribution business, or a clinic with an attached dispensary, MediFlux eliminates the operational chaos that slows you down and replaces it with clarity, speed, and control.

> **[Info]** **New here?** If you haven't set up your MediFlux account yet, start with our [Installation & Setup](/docs/introduction/installation) guide to get your pharmacy running in under 3 minutes.

---

## What MediFlux Does
MediFlux transforms how pharmacies operate by replacing fragmented tools, spreadsheets, manual ledgers, standalone billing apps, and paper stock registers with a single, integrated system that works seamlessly across desktop, tablet, and mobile.


  * [GST-Compliant Billing](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Generate professional invoices in seconds with automatic HSN-based tax calculations, barcode scanning, and WhatsApp sharing.
  * [Real-Time Inventory](/docs/inventory) - Track every drug batch, monitor expiry dates, get low-stock alerts, and never turn away a customer due to missing supplies.
  * [Supplier & Purchase Management](/docs/purchases) - Manage purchase orders, supplier ledgers, inward stock, and outstanding payments from local distributors and wholesalers.
  * [Customer & Credit Tracking](/docs/customers) - Maintain digital customer records, track credit (Udhaar), monitor pending dues, and send payment reminders.
  * [Analytics & Reporting](/docs/reports) - Get actionable insights with sales trends, profit margins, top-selling drugs, and GST-ready audit reports.
  * [Cloud Backup & Security](/docs/introduction#security-compliance) - Your data is encrypted, backed up automatically, and accessible from anywhere, no local servers required.


---

## Who MediFlux Is For
MediFlux is purpose-built for the Indian healthcare ecosystem. No matter your scale or business model, the platform adapts to your workflow, not the other way around.

### Medical Retail Stores
Single-counter pharmacies and neighborhood medical shops that need fast, reliable billing and accurate stock tracking without the complexity of enterprise software.

### Wholesale Distributors
Large-scale distributors managing thousands of SKUs, multiple suppliers, bulk invoicing, and complex credit networks.

### Clinics & Healthcare Facilities
Clinics with attached dispensaries that need patient-linked prescription billing, drug dispensing records, and integrated inventory management.

> **[Success]** **Trusted across India:** From Tier-1 cities to small-town medical stores, 5,000+ pharmacies rely on MediFlux for their daily operations.

---

## Why Pharmacies Choose MediFlux
The Indian pharmacy market is fiercely competitive, and operational inefficiency directly impacts profitability. MediFlux was built to solve the specific pain points that pharmacy owners face every single day.

### Cut Billing Time By 80%
With high-speed barcode scanning, automatic HSN tax lookup, and one-click invoice generation, what used to take minutes now takes seconds. Share digital bills instantly via WhatsApp, no paper, no hassle.

![MediFlux WhatsApp Invoice Sharing](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1782645020031-695489709-Screenshot%202026-06-28%20163953.png)
*Caption: Share digital pharmacy bills instantly via WhatsApp or print directly from the MediFlux billing screen.*

### Eliminate Expiry Losses
Smart batch-wise tracking and automated expiry alerts ensure you never sell an expired drug or lose money to dead stock. Know exactly what's expiring when, and take action before it's too late.

![MediFlux Expiry Stock Tracking](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1782645259700-965516744-exp.png)
*Caption: Identify expired pharmacy inventory and create debit notes against suppliers automatically in MediFlux.*

### Stay GST-Ready Year-Round
Automatic GST calculation, GSTR-1, GSTR-2, and GSTR-3B report generation, and audit-ready ledgers mean tax season becomes a non-event instead of a nightmare.

![MediFlux GST Report Generation](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1782645400611-704254695-gstr1.png)
*Caption: Generate compliant GSTR reports with built-in validation for GSTIN, POC, and HSN codes in MediFlux.*

### Know Your Business In Real Time
The intuitive dashboard gives you instant visibility into daily sales, outstanding payments, top-selling drugs, profit margins, and inventory health, all updated live as transactions happen.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Dashboard Analytics](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1782645596756-811856943-dash1.png)
*Caption: Access real-time pharmacy sales analytics, payment distribution, and stock alerts right from your MediFlux dashboard.*

### Scale Without Switching Software
Start with a single store and grow your revenue and inventory without ever outgrowing the platform. MediFlux's cloud-native architecture scales with your business, not against it.

---

## How MediFlux Works
Getting started with MediFlux takes minutes, not days. The platform is designed to get you from signup to your first sale with minimal friction.

1. **Create your store**

   [Sign up at MediFlux](https://app.mediflux.in/registration), enter your pharmacy details, GSTIN, and business type. Your cloud store is provisioned instantly: no downloads, no servers, no IT team required.

2. **Import or add your inventory**

   Upload your existing drug list via Excel, scan barcodes to auto-populate details, or add medicines manually. MediFlux pre-fills drug names, compositions, and HSN codes where available.

3. **Configure GST & billing preferences**

   Set your default GST rates, invoice templates, payment methods, and customer credit policies. Everything is customizable to match how your store actually operates.

4. **Start billing & managing**

   Begin creating sales, managing purchases, tracking expiry, and monitoring your business health from the unified dashboard. Your data syncs across all devices in real time.

---

## Security & Compliance
Your pharmacy data is among your most valuable assets. MediFlux treats it that way.

- **Role-based access control**: Define who can view, edit, or approve transactions
- **Automatic cloud backups** with 30-day retention
- **GST-compliant audit trails**: Every transaction is logged and immutable
- **SOC 2-aligned security practices** and regular third-party penetration testing

For account security and access settings, see [User Management](/docs/settings/user-management).

---

## Getting Started
Ready to transform your pharmacy operations? Choose your path:


  * [Installation & Setup](/docs/introduction/installation) - Step-by-step guide to creating your MediFlux store, importing inventory, and configuring billing.
  * [Quick Start Guide](/docs/introduction/getting-started) - Learn the essentials, create your first sale, manage stock, and generate a GST invoice in under 15 minutes.
  * [Video Tutorials](https://www.youtube.com/@MediFluxSoftware/playlists) - Watch guided walkthroughs of core workflows, from billing to advanced reporting.


---

## FAQs

  ### Is MediFlux suitable for a single medical shop?

Absolutely. MediFlux is designed to be powerful enough for large distributors yet simple enough for a single-counter medical store. You only pay for what you use, and the interface scales to your needs.
  ### Do I need technical knowledge to use MediFlux?

No. MediFlux is built for pharmacy owners and staff, not IT professionals. The interface is intuitive, and most users are billing confidently within their first hour. We also provide free onboarding support.
  ### Can I use MediFlux on my mobile phone?

Yes. MediFlux is a Progressive Web App (PWA) that works seamlessly on smartphones, tablets, and desktops. Access your store from any device with a browser.
  ### Is my data safe if I stop using MediFlux?

Yes. You can export all your data, inventory, sales, purchases, and ledgers at any time in standard formats (Excel, CSV, PDF). We never lock you in.
  ### Does MediFlux work on slow internet?

Yes. MediFlux is optimized for Indian network conditions. We intelligently cache data, compress payloads, and batch sync requests so the app stays fast and responsive even on 2G or unstable broadband connections. A stable internet connection is required, but slow speeds won't hold you back.
  ### What happens to my data during GST audits?

MediFlux maintains complete, immutable audit trails for every transaction. Generate GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, and detailed sales/purchase registers instantly, fully compliant with Indian GST regulations.


---

## Next Steps

  * [Explore the Dashboard](/docs/introduction/dashboard-overview) - Understand every widget, metric, and shortcut on your MediFlux home screen.
  * [Create Your First Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - A complete walkthrough of the billing workflow, from scanning to invoice generation.
  * [Manage Inventory](/docs/inventory) - Learn batch tracking, expiry alerts, stock adjustments, and reorder workflows.
  * [Contact Support](https://mediflux.in/support) - Need help? Our pharmacy-specialized support team is available via chat, email, and phone.


> **[Success]** **Join 5,000+ pharmacies** already using MediFlux to run smarter, faster, and more profitable operations. [Start your free trial today](https://app.mediflux.in/registration), no credit card required, full access for 7 days.

docs/inventory/billing-notes.title: Billing Notes
docs/inventory/billing-notes.description: Track the debit notes you've raised to suppliers and the credit notes issued back to you.
docs/inventory/billing-notes.body:
# Billing Notes

The **Billing Notes** page is where you track every debit note you've raised to a supplier and every credit note issued back to you once a debit note is accepted. It's split into two tabs: **Debit Notes** and **Credit Notes**, giving you a complete record of your return requests and their outcomes.

---

## Debit Notes
Every debit note you raise, whether from the Drug List's Separated View or from **Create Debit Note**, appears here.

### Searching
The search bar lets you search by **supplier** or **DRN number**. Use the **All** dropdown to the left to narrow the search to a specific field:

| Option | Searches by |
| --- | --- |
| **All** | Both fields combined |
| **Supplier** | Supplier name |
| **DRN** | Debit Reference Number |

![Search Bar](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783589077974-968209360-billing-searchbar.png)
*Caption: Search by supplir, DRN numbers.*
---

### The Debit Notes Table
| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Debit Note Details** | DRN number and status (e.g. Pending) |
| **Supplier** | Supplier the debit note was raised to, with the date and time it was raised |
| **Amount** | Debit amount |
| **Actions** | Opens a menu with View Details, Credit, and Cancel |

![Debit Notes tab](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783588917776-122328328-billingnotes-sidebar.png)
*Caption: List of pending and processed debit notes with supplier, amount, and actions.*

### Row Actions
| Action | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **View Details** | Opens the full breakdown of the debit note |
| **Credit** | Marks the debit note as accepted, converting it into a credit note. It then moves to the Credit Notes tab |
| **Cancel** | Discards a pending debit note that hasn't been credited yet |

> **[Note]** A debit note stays in **Pending** status until it's either credited or cancelled. Once credited, it can no longer be edited or cancelled from here. It becomes a credit note instead.

---

## Credit Notes
Once a debit note is credited, it shows up here as a **Credit Note (CRN)**. This tab uses the same search and filtering as Debit Notes, but only offers **View Details** from the row's Actions menu, since a credit note reflects a completed transaction.

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **CRN** | Credit note number and status |
| **Supplier** | Supplier associated with the credit note, with the date and time it was created |
| **Amount** | Credit amount |
| **Actions** | View Details |

![Credit Notes tab](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783588917772-246911346-creditnote.png)
*Caption: List of completed credit notes with supplier, amount, and view action.*

---

## Viewing A Note'S Details
Clicking **View Details** on either a debit or credit note opens its full breakdown:

| Section | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Header** | Who created the note, the supplier, and the note's reference number |
| **Dates & Amount** | Draft note date, credit note date (if credited), and total amount |
| **Summary** | Subtotal, Discount, Tax, and Grand Total, along with a line-item breakdown |
| **Drugs** | Every drug included in the note, with Qty, Free, Cost, Discount, Sub Total, Tax, and Total for each, plus a Grand Total row |
| **Remarks** | Any notes added when the debit note was created. Shows **No remarks provided** if none |

![Note detail view](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783588917771-265983922-noteview.png)
*Caption: Full breakdown of a debit or credit note with header, dates, summary, drugs, and remarks.*

---

## Track And Adjust

  * [Supplier Ledger](/docs/supplier/supplier-ledger) - Check how debit and credit notes affected supplier balances.
  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Verify stock levels after processing debit notes.
  * [Supplier List](/docs/supplier/supplier-list) - See which suppliers have pending or resolved billing notes.
  * [Create Debit Note](/docs/inventory/create-debit-note) - Raise another debit note if more stock needs returning.

docs/inventory/catalog-share.title: Catalog Share
docs/inventory/catalog-share.description: Generate secure, time-limited links to share your product catalog with partners and customers.
docs/inventory/catalog-share.body:
# Catalog Share

**Catalog Share** lets you create a shareable link to your product catalog. This is useful when you want to send your stock and pricing to a partner or customer without giving them access to MediFlux itself. Each link can be time-limited and configured to show or hide MRP before it's shared.

![Catalog Share](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783588428998-550062592-catalog-sidebar.png)
*Caption: Generate secure, time-limited links to share your product catalog.*

---

## Creating A Share Link
### Link Expiration
Choose how long the link should stay valid:

| Option | Validity |
| --- | --- |
| **30 Minutes** | Quick access |
| **1 Hour** | Short term |
| **8 Hours** | Work day |
| **1 Day** | Daily access |
| **1 Week** | Weekly access |
| **1 Month** | Monthly access |

### Permissions
The **Show MRP** toggle controls whether recipients can see the maximum retail price of products in the catalog. Turn it off if you only want to share product availability without pricing.

![Permissions](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783588586943-676246507-permission.png)
*Caption: Show MRP toggle and referral selection.*

### Select Referral
A **Referral** is a label used to identify who you're sharing the catalog with, for example, a partner or customer's name. You can either:

- Select an existing referral from the dropdown, or
- Add a new one by typing a name and clicking **Add**

Each referral gets a unique Referral ID, shown once selected.

Once you've configured these options, click **Generate Share Link** to create the link. **Reset Form** clears your selections and starts over.

![Share Catalog Links form](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783588754463-81080947-referral.png)
*Caption: Configure expiration, permissions, and referral before generating the link.*

---

## Existing Links
Below the form, the **Existing Links** section lists every link you've generated, along with how many are currently active.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Status** | Shows as **Active Link** or **Expired Link** |
| **Expires** | Time remaining before expiry, or **Expired** if it has already lapsed |
| **Link URL** | The shareable catalog link |
| **Expiration** | Exact date and time the link expires |
| **Permissions** | Shows **MRP Visible** if the Show MRP toggle was enabled for this link |

Each link has **Copy** and **Delete** actions. An expired link shows a note that it's no longer accessible and cannot be opened by recipients.

![Existing Links](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783588428993-105029146-links.png)
*Caption: List of active and expired catalog share links.*

---

## What Recipients See
When someone opens a shared catalog link, they see a public storefront-style page with your store's name, address, and phone number, along with a search bar to browse your products.

Each product is listed with its **Units/Pack**, **Approx Rate** (shown only if Show MRP was enabled), and a quantity selector to add it to their cart. Recipients can adjust quantities and click **Proceed** to review and place their order.

### Placing An Order
Clicking **Proceed** opens a **Confirm Your Order** form, where the recipient enters:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Store Name** | Name of the recipient's store |
| **Email** | Contact email |
| **Phone Number** | Contact number |
| **State, City, Pincode** | Delivery location |

Below this, the **Selected Products** section lists everything added to the cart, with quantity controls and a **Clear All** option. The recipient can also set an **Order Priority**: **Low**, **Medium**, or **High**, before clicking **Place Order** to submit the order to your store.

> **[Note]** The catalog link is public. Anyone with the link can view your catalog and place an order until it expires, so share it only with intended recipients.

Once placed, the order appears on your end under **Sales → Orders**, where you can review and accept or reject it.

---

## Share And Sell

  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Update stock and pricing before sharing your catalog.
  * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Restock items to keep your catalog well-supplied.
  * [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - View sales that may have come through catalog links.
  * [Settings, Referrals](/docs/settings/referrals) - Manage referral labels for catalog sharing.

docs/inventory/create-debit-note.title: Create Debit Note
docs/inventory/create-debit-note.description: Create debit notes from the Drug List, manually, or through full and partial purchase returns, including warehouse stock.
docs/inventory/create-debit-note.body:
# Create Debit Note

> **Video:** [](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=)

A **Debit Note** records medications being returned to a supplier, such as damaged, expired, or excess stock.

Creating a debit note deducts the returned quantity from your inventory, making that stock unavailable for sale.

There are three ways to create a debit note in MediFlux.

| Method | When to use it |
| --- | --- |
| **Method 1: From Drug List** | Select medications from your inventory and generate a debit note using prefilled details |
| **Method 2: From Create Debit Note** | Select a supplier, search for medications, and enter return details manually |
| **Method 3: From Purchase List** | Return an entire purchase or selected medications and quantities from an existing purchase |

> **[Note]** **Warehouse module:** Your **Main Store** is available by default. To add and manage additional warehouses, subscribe to and enable the **Warehouse** module under **Settings → Modules**.
>
> When enabled, you can also create debit notes for medications stored in warehouses.
>
> For more information, see [Modules](/docs/settings/modules).

---

## Method 1: From Drug List (Separated View)

This method lets you create a debit note directly from your existing inventory without entering medication details manually.

You can select one or more medications and adjust their return quantities, suppliers, discounts, and pricing before creating the debit note.

### How To Create A Debit Note From Drug List

1. **Select medications**

   Go to **Drugs → Drug List → Separated View**.

   Find the medications you want to return and select them using the checkboxes.

   Once selected, the bulk actions toolbar appears.

   Click **Generate Debit Note**.

   ![Generate Debit Note from Drug List](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/3bd1c372-b6e5-428c-bad0-4cb263e0b93a-generate-debit-note.png)
*Caption: Select medications in Separated View and click Generate Debit Note from the bulk actions toolbar.*

2. **Review the selected medications**

   The **Create Debit Note** dialog opens with the selected medications already added.

   MediFlux automatically fills in the available medication details, including the drug name, current stock, supplier, and unit cost.

   You can review and modify the return details before creating the debit note.

   ![Create Debit Note dialog](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/9a0db021-1387-45b3-a416-9fcc137fa373-review-debit-note.png)
*Caption: Review selected medications, current stock, return quantities, pricing, and suppliers.*

3. **Set return quantities**

   You can enter the return quantity manually using **Strips Qty** and **Tablets Qty**, where applicable.

   Alternatively, use **Return % Stock** to calculate the return quantities automatically.

   | Option | What it does |
   | --- | --- |
   | **25%** | Calculates 25% of available stock |
   | **50%** | Calculates 50% of available stock |
   | **75%** | Calculates 75% of available stock |
   | **100% (Full)** | Calculates the full available stock |
   | **Custom %** | Lets you enter a custom return percentage |

   Select the percentage and click **Apply**.

   MediFlux automatically fills the return quantity fields based on the selected percentage.

   You can adjust the calculated quantities manually.

   ![Return percentage](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/98aaffe1-ba33-46e0-aaff-9ad51d734fb4-return-percentage.png)
*Caption: Calculate return quantities using preset or custom percentages.*

4. **Review medication details**

   Each selected medication has its own row containing the following information:

   | Field | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | **Medication Details** | Drug name and units per strip |
   | **Current Stock** | Available stock quantity |
   | **Strips Qty** | Number of strips to return |
   | **Tablets Qty** | Additional tablets to return |
   | **Free Qty** | Free quantity included in the return |
   | **Disc %** | Discount percentage |
   | **Unit Cost (₹)** | Cost per unit |
   | **Supplier** | Supplier against whom the debit note will be created |

   You can modify the return quantities, free quantity, discount, unit cost, and supplier.

5. **Assign suppliers**

   The **Supplier** field is populated automatically for each selected medication.

   If you want to create the debit note against a different supplier, select another supplier from that medication's dropdown.

   You can also use **Assign Supplier to All Medications** to select a common supplier for every medication in the dialog.

   ![Assign suppliers](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/66746e98-7ee7-40dc-b784-02c5daf4c164-assign-supplier.png)
*Caption: Change the supplier for an individual medication or assign one supplier to all selected medications.*

6. **Review totals**

   At the bottom of the dialog, MediFlux displays:

   - **Medications:** Number of medications included
   - **Total Units:** Total quantity selected for return

   Use **Reset** to reset the return quantities.

   You can also remove an individual medication using the delete icon beside its row.

7. **Create the debit note**

   Review the return quantities, pricing, discounts, and suppliers.

   Click **Create Debit Note**.

   A confirmation prompt appears showing the total quantity to be removed.

   Click **Confirm** to finalize the debit note or **Cancel** to return without submitting.

   ![Debit Note confirmation](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/c5fcfaa0-b34b-438c-842a-44634e250017-confirm-dialog.png)
*Caption: Review the total units being removed before confirming the debit note.*

   Once confirmed, the selected quantities are deducted from inventory.

> **[Note]** When using this method, the selected medications are already added to the debit note. You only need to review and adjust their return details before confirming.

---

## Method 2: From Drugs → Create Debit Note

This method lets you create a debit note manually without selecting medications from the Drug List first.

You can select the supplier, search for medications, and enter their return quantities and pricing information.

### How To Create A Debit Note Manually

1. **Open Create Debit Note**

   Go to **Drugs → Create Debit Note**.

   The page opens with a date field, supplier selection, and medication entry table.

   ![Create Debit Note page](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/15f39cdf-e230-4f2e-af8e-1eda1ea75627-create-debit-note.png)
*Caption: Create a debit note manually by selecting a supplier and entering medication details.*

2. **Select the date and supplier**

   At the top of the page, enter the debit note information.

   | Field | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | **Date** | Date of the debit note |
   | **Search for suppliers** | Select the supplier against whom the debit note is being created |

3. **Search for medications**

   Click the **Drug Name** field.

   Start typing the medication name.

   MediFlux displays matching medications in a dropdown.

   Select the medication you want to return.

4. **Enter medication details**

   For each medication, enter or review the following information:

   | Field | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | **Drug Name** | Medication being returned |
   | **Stock** | Current stock quantity |
   | **Qty** | Number of strips to return |
   | **Tablets** | Additional tablets to return |
   | **Batch** | Batch number |
   | **Expiry** | Expiry date in `MM/YY` format |
   | **Free** | Free quantity included in the return |
   | **Cost** | Cost price |
   | **MRP** | Maximum retail price |
   | **Disc %** | Discount percentage |
   | **CGST** | Central GST rate |
   | **SGST** | State GST rate |
   | **IGST** | Integrated GST rate |

   ![Medication return details](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/d376eb83-09ea-4b16-8cbf-ce78961bf578-debit-meds.png)
*Caption: Enter quantity, tablets, batch, expiry, free quantity, cost, MRP, discount, and GST rates.*

5. **Enter strips and tablets**

   You can enter both complete strips and individual tablets.

   For example, suppose a medication contains `10` tablets per strip.

   If you want to return `2` strips and `3` additional tablets:

   | Field | Value |
   | --- | --- |
   | **Qty** | `2` |
   | **Tablets** | `3` |
   | **Total tablets** | `23` |

   This allows you to return loose tablets along with complete strips.

6. **Add or remove medications**

   Click the **+** button below the table to add another medication row.

   To remove a medication, click the delete icon beside its row.

7. **Create the debit note**

   Review the supplier, medications, return quantities, and pricing.

   Click **Create Debit Note**.

   Once successfully submitted, the returned stock is deducted from inventory.

   The newly created debit note appears under **Drugs → Billing Notes → Debit Notes**.

> **[Note]** Unlike Method 1, this method starts with an empty medication entry table. You select the supplier and add the medications manually.

---

## Method 3: Purchase Returns

You can also create a debit note by returning medications from an existing purchase.

This method is useful when you want to return stock associated with a particular purchase without manually creating a separate debit note.

MediFlux provides two purchase return options:

| Return Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Return Full Purchase** | Return the entire purchase |
| **Partial Return** | Return selected medications or quantities from a purchase |

Both options create a debit note for the returned stock.

### How To Start A Purchase Return

1. **Open Purchase List**

   Go to **Purchases → Purchase List**.

   Find the purchase you want to return.

   You can search using the supplier name, drug name, or challan/invoice number.

   ![Purchase List](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/4e1d3f72-5eab-40c9-b3f5-50d797814aa2-purchase-list.png)
*Caption: Find an existing purchase using supplier, medication, or invoice information.*

2. **Open purchase details**

   Select the purchase to open its details.

   The purchase details page displays the supplier, purchase date, invoice number, purchase summary, and purchased medications.

   At the top of the page, you can access **Invoice**, **Download**, **Print Labels**, and **More**.

   ![Purchase details](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/879efff1-b545-41d3-8134-814b4d1fd21e-list-options.png)
*Caption: View purchase information and access the available purchase actions.*

3. **Open Return Purchase**

   Click **More**.

   Expand **Return Purchase**.

   You will see:

   - **Return Full Purchase**
   - **Partial Return**

   ![Return Purchase options](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/3a9b6228-9664-4616-bd8e-ccf5acedc6e3-return-purchase.png)
*Caption: Choose Return Full Purchase or Partial Return from the purchase details page.*

### Option 1: Return Full Purchase

Use **Return Full Purchase** when you want to return the complete purchase to the supplier.

1. **Select Return Full Purchase**

   Open the purchase details page.

   Go to **More → Return Purchase → Return Full Purchase**.

2. **Review the purchase**

   Check the purchase information and ensure you intend to return the complete purchase.

3. **Complete the return**

   Proceed with the full purchase return.

   MediFlux creates the corresponding debit note and deducts the returned stock from inventory.

4. **Review the debit note**

   Go to **Drugs → Billing Notes → Debit Notes**.

   Find the debit note created for the purchase return.

> **[Warning: Returning an entire purchase]** Use **Return Full Purchase** only when you intend to return the complete purchase. If you want to return selected medications or quantities, choose **Partial Return**.

### Option 2: Partial Return

Use **Partial Return** when you want to return only certain medications or quantities from a purchase.

You do not need to return every medication included in the purchase.

#### How To Create A Partial Purchase Return

1. **Open Partial Return**

   Go to the purchase details page.

   Select **More → Return Purchase → Partial Return**.

   The **Partial Purchase Return** dialog opens.

   ![Partial Purchase Return](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/54e74415-9fd2-43ab-b836-74f7757cd8ae-partial-purchase.png)
*Caption: Select medications and specify the quantities to return from an existing purchase.*

2. **Review medication information**

   The dialog displays the medications included in the purchase.

   | Column | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | **Select** | Checkbox to include a medication in the return |
   | **Drug Information** | Medication name, batch, and expiry |
   | **Total Stock** | Current stock quantity |
   | **Purchased** | Quantity originally purchased |
   | **Returned** | Quantity previously returned |
   | **Return Now** | Quantity to return in the current transaction |

3. **Select medications**

   Use the checkboxes to select the medications you want to return.

   You can select one or more medications.

4. **Enter return quantities**

   For each selected medication, enter the quantity in **Return Now**.

   For example:

   | Medication | Total Stock | Purchased | Returned | Return Now |
   | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
   | MUPICIP OINTMENT | `3` | `3` | `0` | `3` |
   | OFLOX OZ NF SUSP | `4` | `4` | `0` | `2` |
   | OTRIVIN FAST REL. | `3` | `3` | `0` | `0` |
   | BETADINE SOLUTION | `102` | `2` | `0` | `0` |
   | COREX DX | `11` | `11` | `0` | `7` |
   | ADHESIVE TAPE 10 CM | `2` | `2` | `0` | `0` |


   Only the selected medications and specified quantities are included in the return.

   ![Partial return quantities](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/30fd64b7-80c7-4500-8b0f-313d2ea5729c-partial-return-selected.png)
*Caption: Select medications and enter the quantity to return in the Return Now field.*

5. **Submit the return**

   Review the selected medications and quantities.

   Click **Submit Return**.

   MediFlux deducts the specified quantities from current stock and adjusts the supplier's ledger.

   A corresponding debit note is created.

> **[Note]** Review **Total Stock**, **Purchased**, and **Returned** before entering the quantity in **Return Now**.

---

## Creating Debit Notes For Warehouse Stock
If you have enabled the **Warehouse** module, you can create debit notes for medications stored in your warehouses using two methods:

| Method | How it works |
| --- | --- |
| **From Drug List** | Filter medications by warehouse, select them in **Separated View**, and click **Generate Debit Note** |
| **From Create Debit Note** | Search for a medication and select the correct warehouse stock entry using its warehouse label, such as `WH1` |

### Method 1: From Drug List

1. **Select the warehouse**

   Go to **Drugs → Drug List**.

   Use the warehouse filter to select the warehouse containing the medications you want to return.

   You can select a specific warehouse or **All Warehouses** to view stock across locations.

2. **Select warehouse medications**

   Switch to **Separated View**.

   Find the medications you want to return.

   Warehouse medications display a warehouse label, such as `WH1`, beside their names.

   Select the required medications using the checkboxes.

   ![Select warehouse medications](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/36afd34e-9857-47fa-a91d-41a11ffb88df-warehouse-debitnote.png)
*Caption: Select medications marked with their warehouse label in Separated View and access Generate Debit Note.*

3. **Generate the debit note**

   Click **Generate Debit Note**.

   The selected warehouse medications appear in the **Create Debit Note** dialog.

   Review the automatically populated details, return quantities, pricing, and suppliers.

   Click **Create Debit Note** and confirm the return.

### Method 2: From Create Debit Note

You can also select warehouse medications directly when creating a debit note manually.

1. **Open Create Debit Note**

   Go to **Drugs → Create Debit Note**.

   Select the date and supplier.

2. **Search for warehouse medications**

   Click the **Drug Name** field and start typing the medication name.

   The search dropdown displays matching medications.

   Warehouse medications show a label such as `WH1` beside their names.

   Each result also displays the available stock and units per pack.

   | Information | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | **Drug Name** | Medication name |
   | **Warehouse Label** | Warehouse associated with the medication, such as `WH1` |
   | **Stock** | Available stock quantity |
   | **Units/Pack** | Number of units in each pack |

   For example, searching for **ACILOC** can display medications such as **ACILOC 300 TAB** and **ACILOC 150 TAB**, along with their warehouse labels and stock quantities.

   ![Search warehouse medications](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/dc344696-e533-437b-baae-b2b20b14d7ff-warehouse-debitnote3.png)
*Caption: Medication search results showing warehouse labels, available stock, and units per pack.*

3. **Select the correct warehouse medication**

   Select the medication entry associated with the warehouse from which you want to return stock.

   Check the warehouse label and stock quantity before selecting it.

4. **Complete the debit note**

   Enter the return quantities, batch, expiry, free quantity, cost, MRP, discount, and applicable GST information.

   Add other medications if needed.

   Click **Create Debit Note** to submit the return.

> **[Note]** When the same medication is available in multiple locations, check the warehouse label and stock quantity before selecting it.
>
> For information about enabling additional warehouses, see [**Modules**](/docs/settings/modules).

---

## Reviewing Created Debit Notes

Debit notes created using any of the three methods appear under:

**Drugs → Billing Notes → Debit Notes**

The page displays the debit notes recorded against suppliers.

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Debit Note Details** | Debit note number and status |
| **Supplier** | Supplier associated with the debit note |
| **Amount** | Debit amount |
| **Actions** | Available actions for the debit note |

A debit note may display a status such as **Pending**.

![Debit Notes list](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/164943f3-dd02-4ff2-bb72-145b8168b1e0-billing_notes.png)
*Caption: View debit note numbers, supplier information, debit amounts, and statuses.*

For more information, see [Billing Notes](/docs/inventory/billing-notes).

---

## Mistakes To Avoid

> **[Warning: Selecting the wrong supplier]** When creating a debit note from the Drug List, check the supplier assigned to each medication.
>
> If you use **Assign Supplier to All Medications**, verify that the selected supplier is correct.

> **[Warning: Selecting the wrong warehouse]** When the **Warehouse** module is enabled, the same medication may be available in multiple locations.
>
> Check the warehouse label before selecting stock for return.

> **[Warning: Missing required details]** When creating a debit note manually, ensure the required batch, expiry, pricing, and applicable GST information is provided.
>
> Missing required details may prevent submission.

---

## Restock Or Review


  * [Billing Notes](/docs/inventory/billing-notes) - View and track debit notes created for supplier returns.
  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Review inventory and verify stock quantities after a return.
  * [Purchase List](/docs/purchases/purchase-list) - Review purchases and initiate full or partial purchase returns.
  * [Supplier Ledger](/docs/supplier/supplier-ledger) - Review supplier transactions and adjustments related to returns.

docs/inventory/drug-list.title: Drug List
docs/inventory/drug-list.description: Manage your pharmacy drug inventory in MediFlux. Track batches, monitor expiries, reconcile negative stock, and import or export data easily.
docs/inventory/drug-list.body:
# Drug List

The **Drug List** is the main **pharmacy drug inventory** directory in **MediFlux**. It gives you a real-time view of the medicines available in your store, including stock, batches, prices, expiry, suppliers, and inventory activity.

You can view inventory in three ways: **Consolidated View**, **Separated View**, and **Negative Stock**.

---

## Summary Cards

At the top of the page, summary cards give you an at-a-glance overview of your inventory.

| Card | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Total Drugs** | Total number of unique drugs in your inventory |
| **Total Value** | Total MRP value of your current stock, along with its cost value |
| **Expired / Out of Stock** | Number of expired drugs and drugs with no available stock |

![MediFlux Pharmacy Inventory Summary Cards](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/0d6cd04b-6c83-491b-9e67-d451c40250dd-inventory_summary.png)
*Caption: Summary cards showing key pharmacy inventory information like total drugs, value, and expired or out of stock counts.*

---

## Searching Drugs

Use the search bar at the top of the **Drug List** to quickly find medicines.

You can search across **brands, salts, drug classes, or manufacturers**.

The **All** dropdown lets you narrow the search to a particular field:

| Option | Searches by |
| --- | --- |
| **All** | Searches across all supported fields |
| **Batch Number** | Batch number of the drug |
| **HSN** | HSN code |
| **Manufacturer** | Manufacturer name |
| **Rack Number** | Rack location |
| **Salts** | Active salts in the drug |

![MediFlux Drug List Search Bar](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/863170c9-7083-4ee4-8569-ccd0fa40c416-search_Drug.png)
*Caption: Search the pharmacy Drug List using medicine names, batch numbers, HSN codes, manufacturers, or salts.*

---

## Quick Filters

Quick filters below the search bar let you narrow the Drug List without opening the complete filter panel.

| Filter | Available options |
| --- | --- |
| **Stock** | In Stock, Out of Stock |
| **Schedule** | All, NRx, Rx, OTC, Sch H1, Sch H, Sch G |
| **Expiry** | Unexpired, Expired, In 1 Month, In 3 Months, In 6 Months, In 1 Year |

If the **Warehouse Module** is enabled, an additional warehouse filter lets you switch between the **Main Store**, individual warehouses, and **All Warehouses**.

For details about warehouse inventory and stock transfers, see [Warehouse](/docs/inventory/warehouse).

The filters can be used together to narrow the inventory further.

![MediFlux Drug List Quick Filters](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/d5ae33dc-4a16-4ce0-a1d3-94e59c795219-drug-filters.png)
*Caption: Filter pharmacy inventory by stock status, drug schedule, expiry, and warehouse in MediFlux.*

---

## Filter and Sort

Select **Filter** to open additional filtering and sorting options.

Use the filter panel when you need more control than the quick filters provide.

You can filter inventory using stock, expiry, supplier, and other drug information, as well as save frequently used filter combinations.

![MediFlux Filter and Sort Panel for Drugs](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/dc1d9031-fa09-4baf-ac18-8bee8a550e86-filter-and-sort.png)
*Caption: Apply additional filters and sorting options to the pharmacy Drug List in MediFlux.*

---

## Inventory Views

The Drug List has three inventory views:

- **Consolidated View**
- **Separated View**
- **Negative Stock**

Each view provides a different way to work with your inventory.

---

## Consolidated View

**Consolidated View** groups matching inventory into a simpler inventory-level view.

Use it when you want to review your inventory without working with every stock entry individually.

The table includes:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **S.No** | Row number |
| **Name** | Drug name |
| **Batch** | Batch number |
| **HSN** | HSN code |
| **Stock** | Available stock |
| **Trade P** | Trade price |
| **MRP** | Maximum retail price |
| **Expiry** | Expiry month and year |
| **Supplier** | Supplier associated with the stock |

### Selecting Drugs

Select one or more groups using the checkboxes to open the bulk action toolbar.

| Action | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Export CSV** | Exports the selected inventory data |
| **Export Activities** | Exports the activity history of the selected inventory groups |

![MediFlux Consolidated View for Pharmacy Inventory](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/c4307e45-a5ad-4dba-8c0b-57ad65369f8c-consolidated-view.png)
*Caption: Export inventory data or activity history for selected drug groups in MediFlux Consolidated View.*

---

## Separated View

**Separated View** displays inventory at the individual stock-entry level.

Use this view when you need to work with a specific rack, batch, expiry, supplier, or stock entry.

The table includes:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **S.No** | Row number |
| **Name** | Drug name |
| **Rack** | Rack location |
| **Batch** | Batch number |
| **HSN** | HSN code |
| **Stock** | Current stock |
| **Price** | Price of the drug |
| **Expiry** | Expiry month and year |
| **Supplier** | Supplier associated with the stock |
| **Actions** | Opens actions for the individual drug entry |

### Selecting Drugs

Selecting one or more drugs displays the available bulk actions:

| Action | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Export Activities** | Exports the activity history of the selected drugs |
| **Generate Debit Note** | Generates a debit note for the selected drugs |
| **Reorder** | Reorders the selected drugs |
| **Update** | Opens **Bulk Update Drugs** to update selected stock entries together |
| **Delete** | Removes the selected drugs and moves them to Trash |

![MediFlux Separated View Bulk Actions](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/1319f545-c72d-4f7a-b678-caf662de6c34-seperated-view.png)
*Caption: Bulk actions available for selected individual pharmacy drug stock entries in MediFlux Separated View.*

### Bulk Update Selected Drugs

In **Separated View**, select multiple drugs and click **Update** to open **Bulk Update Drugs**. This is useful when you need to apply the same change to several medicines, such as updating their **Discount (%)** or **Scheduling** together.

> **[Note]** **Bulk Update:** You can apply a common **Discount (%)** or change the **Scheduling** classification for all selected drugs without editing them individually. Only fields you fill in are updated. Leave other fields blank or set dropdowns to **Leave unchanged** to preserve their existing values. Review the changes and click **Update Drugs** to apply them.

![MediFlux Bulk Update Pharmacy Drugs](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/0aa94827-1695-4616-a0b1-b4127040abf8-global-discount.png)
*Caption: Update discount, scheduling, stock, pricing, tax rates, and other fields for multiple selected pharmacy drugs.*

### Individual Drug Actions

Select the **⋮** menu beside a drug in **Separated View** to access actions for that individual stock entry.

| Action | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Edit** | Opens the stock entry for editing |
| **Add Deal** | Adds a purchase deal or scheme to the drug |
| **Move** | Moves stock between the Main Store and a warehouse when Warehouse Module is enabled |
| **Map** | Maps the drug entry |
| **Reconcile Stock** | Uses matching positive stock to clear a negative stock deficit, when applicable |

![MediFlux Individual Drug Stock Actions](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/961a8c84-7200-451d-8b0f-53cdc824eb17-individual-drug-actions.png)
*Caption: Access actions like Edit, Add Deal, Move, Map, and Reconcile Stock for an individual pharmacy drug entry.*

> **[Note]** Use **Consolidated View** for a grouped inventory view. Use **Separated View** when you need to work with individual stock entries.

---

## Negative Stock

The **Negative Stock** feature lets MediFlux record a sale even when the quantity being sold is greater than the available stock of a drug.

When this happens, the remaining quantity is recorded as **negative stock** instead of preventing the sale.

The **Negative Stock** tab gives you a separate view of drug entries that currently have a stock deficit and need to be reconciled. Negative quantities are shown directly in the **Stock** column.

![MediFlux Negative Stock View](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/3a5b1662-f499-4613-8ec5-d2c0a54477ec-negative-stock.png)
*Caption: View pharmacy drugs with stock below zero that need to be reconciled in MediFlux.*

---

## How Negative Stock Works

Suppose you have `1` unit of **Laprox** in stock and a customer purchases `10` units.

The available `1` unit is used, but the sale still requires another `9` units.

The stock therefore becomes:

`1 - 10 = -9`

Instead of blocking the sale, MediFlux records the remaining `9` units as a stock deficit.

| Drug | Stock before sale | Quantity sold | Stock after sale |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Laprox | `1` | `10` | `-9` |

The **Laprox** entry now appears under the **Negative Stock** tab with a stock quantity of `-9`.
