![MediFlux Negative Stock Example](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/43098396-7c48-4f95-825c-357accfe1b34-laprox-negative-stock.png)
*Caption: Example of a pharmacy drug (Laprox) appearing with negative stock after selling more units than available.*

This keeps the shortage visible so it can later be corrected through **Stock Reconciliation**.

> **[Note]** Only stock entries with a negative quantity need to be reconciled. Reconciliation is used to clear an existing stock deficit using matching positive stock.

---

## Reconciling Negative Stock

**Stock Reconciliation** is used when a drug already has negative stock and matching positive stock is available elsewhere in your inventory.

The positive stock may already exist under another inventory entry, including stock associated with another supplier. In that case, you can reconcile the negative stock directly.

If suitable positive stock is not currently available, stock can first be added through a purchase and then used for reconciliation.

A new purchase is therefore **not required every time you reconcile stock**.

### Reconciliation Example

After the sale above, **Laprox** has `-9` units.

Another matching **Laprox** stock entry has `22` units available. The `9` unit deficit can be reconciled using `9` units from that positive stock.

| Medicine | Before | Reconciliation | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Negative Laprox | `-9` | `+9` | `0` |
| Positive Laprox | `22` | `-9` | `13` |

The negative entry is cleared, while the matching positive stock is reduced from `22` to `13`.

![MediFlux Positive and Negative Stock Reconciliation](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/41c91406-8896-4967-a548-113a95962d73-laprox-reconcile-show.png)
*Caption: Matching pharmacy drug entries showing negative stock and positive stock available for reconciliation in MediFlux.*

---

## How To Reconcile Negative Stock

1. **Find the negative stock**

   Go to **Drugs → Drug List → Negative Stock** and find the drug with the negative stock quantity you want to reconcile.

2. **Open Reconcile Stock**

   Go to **Separated View** and locate the negative stock entry.

   Open the drug's **⋮ Actions** menu and select **Reconcile Stock**.

3. **Set the reconciliation quantity**

   The **Multi-Stock Reconciliation** window shows the negative drug and its current deficit.

   Under **Reconcile Qty**, enter the quantity you want to reconcile. Select **MAX** to use the maximum quantity available for reconciliation.

4. **Select positive stock**

   Under **Positive Batches (Deducted)**, select the matching positive stock that should be used to offset the deficit.

   You can search the available positive stock by **batch number, rack, expiry, or supplier**.

5. **Review projected stock**

   Check **Projected Stock** before confirming the reconciliation.

   For example:

   `-9.00 → 0.00`

   means the complete `9` unit deficit will be cleared.

6. **Confirm the reconciliation**

   Select **Reconcile Stock**.

   MediFlux adds the reconciled quantity to the negative entry to clear its deficit and deducts the same quantity from the selected positive stock.

![MediFlux Multi-Stock Reconciliation Tool](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/f394966f-74b9-416b-90b6-45519bc4072d-reconcile-drug.png)
*Caption: Select matching positive pharmacy stock and specify the quantity to use for clearing a negative stock deficit.*

> **[Note]** A purchase is not a required step in reconciliation. If matching positive stock already exists, you can reconcile directly. If no suitable positive stock is available, stock must first become available before the deficit can be reconciled.

---

## Reconciliation Activity

Completed reconciliation is recorded in the drug's **Activity** history as **Stock Reconciliation**.

For example, if `9` units are deducted from positive **Laprox** stock containing `22` units, the activity records **Before** as `22`, **Change** as `-9`, and **After** as `13`.

`22 → -9 → 13`

This creates a traceable record of the stock deducted during reconciliation.

![MediFlux Stock Reconciliation Activity History](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/064955a9-41bc-49c8-b7f3-9a91f97f110f-reconcile-acitivity.png)
*Caption: Activity history showing the stock deducted from a positive pharmacy drug entry during reconciliation.*

---

## Viewing Drug Details And Activity

Click a **drug name** in the Drug List to open its detailed view.

The information available depends on the view you open the drug from:

| Opened from | Available tabs |
| --- | --- |
| **Consolidated View** | **Info**, **Batches**, **Activity**, and **Warehouse** when Warehouse Module is enabled |
| **Separated View** | **Info**, **Activity**, and **Warehouse** when Warehouse Module is enabled |

### Drug Details From Consolidated View

When you click a drug from **Consolidated View**, MediFlux opens the consolidated profile for that drug.

#### Info

The **Info** tab gives you an overview of the drug across its inventory.

| Section | Information shown |
| --- | --- |
| **Stock & Pricing** | Total Stock, Cost, Trade Price, MRP, and Total Batches |
| **Basic Information** | Generic Name, Brand Name, Dosage Form, Pack Size, Units Per Pack, and Schedule |
| **Identification Details** | HSN Code, Rack Numbers, Expiry Range, Batches Count, and Suppliers |

![MediFlux Consolidated Drug Information](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/76a87a83-e55c-417f-884d-5ee51cf0d248-consolidated-drug-info.png)
*Caption: View overall stock, pricing, basic information, and identification details for a pharmacy drug.*

#### Batches

Open **Batches** to view the individual batches associated with the drug.

| Field | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Batch Number** | Batch identifier |
| **Stock** | Current stock in the batch |
| **Cost** | Cost of the batch |
| **Trade Price** | Trade price |
| **MRP** | Maximum retail price |
| **Expiry** | Batch expiry |
| **Supplier** | Supplier associated with the batch |
| **Rack** | Rack location |

![MediFlux Drug Batches Overview](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/4a18f4e3-9e3a-4248-9316-a8943bcdba83-consolidated-drug-batched.png)
*Caption: View the individual batches, expiry dates, and suppliers associated with a pharmacy drug.*

#### Activity

Open **Activity** to view the inventory history for the drug across its stock entries.

Each activity shows:

| Column | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Date & Time** | When the activity occurred |
| **Activity** | The transaction or inventory action |
| **Before** | Stock before the activity |
| **Change** | Quantity added or deducted |
| **After** | Stock after the activity |
| **Reference** | Related transaction or inventory record |

Use **All Activity Types** to filter the history by inventory activity, such as **Add Purchase**, **Update Purchase**, **Delete Purchase**, **Restore Purchase**, **Purchase Return**, **Add Sale**, **Update Sale**, **Sale Return**, and **Stock Reconciliation**.

Use **All Dates** to filter the activity history by date.

![MediFlux Consolidated Drug Activity History](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/42a52dce-f511-415b-a375-83630820b7d6-consolidated-drug-activity.png)
*Caption: View and filter the complete inventory activity history of a pharmacy drug.*

---

### Drug Details From Separated View

When you click a drug from **Separated View**, MediFlux opens the details for that specific inventory entry.

The profile contains **Info** and **Activity**, along with **Warehouse** when Warehouse Module is enabled.

#### Info

The **Info** tab provides detailed information about the selected stock entry.

| Section | Information shown |
| --- | --- |
| **Stock & Pricing** | Unit Cost, Cost, Trade Price, Margin, Stock, Rack, and Expiry |
| **Deal Information** | Deal Start Date, Buy Quantity, and Free Quantity, when a deal is available |
| **Basic Information** | Dosage Form, Pack Size, Units Per Pack, Reorder Level, Schedule, and Discount |
| **Identification Details** | HSN Code, NDC Code, Batch Number, and Barcode |
| **Composition Details** | Active Salts and Drug Classes |
| **Tax Information** | CGST Rate, SGST Rate, and IGST Rate |
| **Clinical & Safety Information** | Indications, side effects, dosage, warnings, and other available clinical information |

![MediFlux Separated Drug Information Details](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/1a93aac2-620a-48e5-a98e-99071b908f6d-seperated-drug-info.png)
*Caption: View stock, pricing, deal, basic, identification, composition, tax, and clinical information for a specific pharmacy inventory entry.*

#### Activity

Open **Activity** to view the inventory history for that specific stock entry.

The activity table shows **Date & Time**, **Activity**, **Before**, **Change**, **After**, and **Reference**.

Use **All Activity Types** to filter by the type of inventory activity and **All Dates** to filter activity by date.

![MediFlux Separated Drug Activity History](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/9a9ddc91-38c6-41a2-b738-e1d84ddbe172-seperated-drug-activity.png)
*Caption: View and filter activity history for a specific pharmacy drug inventory entry.*

> **[Note]** Open a drug from **Consolidated View** to see its overall information, batches, and combined activity. Open it from **Separated View** to inspect the information and activity of a specific inventory entry.
>
> When the **Warehouse Module** is enabled, use the **Warehouse** tab to check stock availability across warehouses. See [Viewing Warehouse Stock](/docs/inventory/warehouse) for details.

---

## Add Deal

The **Add Deal** option is available from the individual drug's **⋮ Actions** menu in **Separated View**.

Use it to configure a purchase scheme for a drug, such as a buy quantity with a free quantity. You can set the **Buy Quantity**, **Free Quantity**, **Start Date**, **End Date**, and whether the deal is **Active**.

---

## Warehouse Inventory

**Main Store** is available by default. With the **Warehouse Module** enabled, you can also view stock in individual warehouses, move medicines between locations, and check warehouse-wise availability.

For instructions on enabling the module, see [Modules](/docs/settings/modules).

For warehouse filtering, stock transfers, and viewing a medicine's warehouse stock, see the [Warehouse](/docs/inventory/warehouse).

---

## Page-Level Actions

Select **Actions** at the top of the Drug List to access inventory-level actions.

| Action | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Export Stock** | Exports your stock data |
| **Stock Audit** | Opens the stock audit option |
| **Import** | Opens the inventory import process |

![MediFlux Drug List Page-Level Actions](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/89d77a2a-b129-450e-9a78-f9f4de58b016-actions.png)
*Caption: Access Export Stock, Stock Audit, and Import options from the pharmacy Drug List Actions menu.*

---

## Importing Your Inventory

If you're setting up MediFlux for the first time or need to add drugs in bulk, select **Actions → Import** to open the inventory import process.

The import process includes:

1. **Upload:** upload your inventory as a CSV or Excel file. You can also download a template to see the expected format
2. **Map Headers:** match the columns in your file to MediFlux's drug fields
3. **Preview:** review your data before confirming the import
4. **Complete:** finish the import and add the drugs to your inventory

![MediFlux Import Pharmacy Drugs via CSV/Excel](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783587724164-934031354-importdrugs.png)
*Caption: Import pharmacy inventory into MediFlux from a supported CSV or Excel file.*

---

## Common Follow-Ups


  * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Add purchased stock to your inventory.
  * [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - Review sales and transactions affecting your inventory.
  * [Add Retail Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Create a retail sale from your available inventory.
  * [Supplier List](/docs/supplier/supplier-list) - View and manage suppliers associated with your inventory.

docs/inventory/overview.title: Inventory
docs/inventory/overview.description: Manage pharmacy drug inventory in MediFlux. Track stock levels, monitor expiries, raise debit notes, and keep your pharmacy stock accurate from one central hub.
docs/inventory/overview.body:
# Inventory

The **Inventory** section (labelled **Drugs** in the sidebar) is where you manage every medicine and **pharmacy drug inventory** your store holds in **MediFlux**. It shows you how many units you have, what they cost, when they expire, which supplier they came from, and lets you keep this information accurate as stock moves in and out of your store.

---

## What You Can Do In Inventory
- **View your complete drug inventory:** Stock levels, batch numbers, HSN codes, trade price, MRP, and expiry, all in one list.
- **Track stock value:** See your total inventory value and cost at a glance.
- **Monitor expired and out-of-stock drugs:** Stay on top of stock that needs immediate attention.
- **Update drug details:** Correct batch numbers, rack numbers, stock, tax rates, and more.
- **Reorder drugs:** Send a purchase order directly to a connected supplier.
- **Raise debit notes:** Request a return to your supplier for a purchased drug.
- **Share your catalog:** Generate secure, time-limited links to share your stock list with partners or customers.
- **Import your inventory in bulk:** Upload a CSV or Excel file to add drugs quickly, useful when setting up MediFlux for the first time.
- **Export inventory data:** Download your drug list for accounting and record-keeping.

---

## Navigating the Inventory Section
The **Drugs** section in the left sidebar expands into five main pages:

| Page | What it's for |
| --- | --- |
| **Drug List** | View, search, and manage all the drugs in your inventory |
| **Catalog Share** | Generate secure, time-limited links to share your product catalog with partners or customers |
| **Create Debit Note** | Raise a debit note to a supplier to request a return on a purchased drug |
| **Billing Notes** | Track the debit notes you've raised to suppliers and the credit notes issued back to you |
| **Trash** | Recover drugs that have been deleted from inventory |

![MediFlux Pharmacy Inventory Sidebar Navigation](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783585798159-674676454-inventory-sidebar.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux left sidebar showing Drug List, Catalog Share, Billing Notes, Create Debit Note, and Trash navigation options.*

---

## Quick Actions From The Dashboard
Inventory doesn't have a dedicated "Add Drug" quick action. Instead, drugs are added to your inventory when you record a purchase. The **Add Purchase** option in the **`+` quick-add menu** (top-right corner of any screen) lets you add drugs bought from a supplier, and they'll automatically reflect in your inventory.

![MediFlux Dashboard Quick Add Purchase for Inventory](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783585866248-298967115-add-purchase.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux dashboard quick-add menu showing the Add Purchase option to instantly update pharmacy inventory.*

> **[Note]** To manually update an existing drug's details, like stock, batch, or tax rates, use the **Update** action from the Drug List instead. New drugs are added through purchases, not directly from Inventory.

---

## Drug Types
Every drug in your inventory is classified under a **Type**:

| Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **Rx** | Prescription required |
| **NRx** | Non-prescription (over-the-counter) |
| **H1** | Schedule H1 drug, subject to additional regulatory tracking |

You can filter your Drug List by type at any time.

---

## Drug List
The **Drug List** is your central inventory view. Search and filter drugs by name, composition, stock status, or expiry. View key details at a glance including current stock, MRP, trade price, batch number, and supplier. Update drug information, adjust stock levels, and reorder directly from the list.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Drug List and Inventory Overview](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783591392140-456868780-drugListOverview.png)
*Caption: The complete MediFlux pharmacy inventory view with search, filters, and detailed drug information.*

---

## Catalog Share
**Catalog Share** lets you generate secure, time-limited links to share your product catalog with partners, customers, or other stakeholders. They can view your available stock without accessing your MediFlux account. Set expiry dates on links and revoke access anytime.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Catalog Share Feature](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783591502202-659561370-catalogOverview.png)
*Caption: Generate and manage secure, time-limited shareable pharmacy catalog links in MediFlux.*

---

## Billing Notes
**Billing Notes** tracks all debit notes you've raised to suppliers and credit notes you've received back. View status, amounts, and settlement details in one place. Filter by date, supplier, or note type to stay on top of returns and adjustments.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Billing Notes and Debit Notes](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783591672463-546108573-billingNotesoverview.png)
*Caption: Track debit notes raised and credit notes received from pharmacy suppliers in MediFlux.*

---

## Create Debit Note
When you need to return a drug to your supplier due to expiry, damage, or overstock, use **Create Debit Note**. Select the drug, specify the quantity and reason, and send the debit note directly to the supplier. This automatically adjusts your inventory and supplier ledger.

![MediFlux Create Pharmacy Debit Note](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783591766407-581572982-debitnoteoverview.png)
*Caption: Raise a debit note in MediFlux to request a return of expired or damaged drugs from your pharmacy supplier.*

---

## Trash
Deleted drugs aren't gone forever. The **Trash** page holds all inventory items that have been removed, so you can restore them if needed. View deletion history, check associated stock and batch details, and restore drugs back to active inventory with one click.

![MediFlux Deleted Pharmacy Drug Recovery](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783591862429-549002883-trashOverview.png)
*Caption: Recover deleted pharmacy drugs in MediFlux and view their deletion history and batch details.*

---

## Manage Your Stock

  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - View, search, and manage all drugs in your inventory.
  * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Record new stock from suppliers to update inventory.
  * [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - See what's selling to plan restocking.
  * [Supplier List](/docs/supplier/supplier-list) - Manage suppliers for reordering stock.

docs/inventory/trash.title: Drug Trash
docs/inventory/trash.description: Learn how MediFlux handles deleted drugs, including soft delete vs hard delete behavior and how restoring or removing drugs affects your inventory and sales records.
docs/inventory/trash.body:
# Drug Trash

This guide explains how MediFlux handles deleted drugs, the difference between soft and hard deletion, and how restoring or permanently removing drugs affects your inventory and sales records.

## How Drug Deletion Works
When you delete a drug from your inventory, MediFlux handles it differently based on whether that drug has been involved in any sales transactions.

### Soft Delete (Drugs With Sales History)
If a drug has been sold at least once, meaning it appears in any past sale invoice, MediFlux performs a **soft delete**. The drug is moved to **Trash** instead of being permanently removed.

**Why soft delete?** Sales records are tied to drug data for compliance, GST reporting, and audit trails. Removing the drug entirely would break historical invoices and make your books inaccurate.

**What happens in soft delete:**

- The drug disappears from your active **Drug List** and inventory dropdowns
- The drug is moved to **Drugs → Trash**
- All sales history, purchase records, and ledger entries remain intact
- The drug can be **restored** at any time

**Restore a Soft-Deleted Drug**

1. Navigate to **Drugs → Trash**
2. Find the drug in the trashed items list
3. Click **Restore**, the drug returns to your active Drug List immediately

![Drug Trash Page](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783590638115-951573145-inventory-trash.png)
*Caption: Trash page showing soft-deleted drugs with supplier, HSN, batch details and Restore action.*

> **[Note]** Restoring a drug brings back all its data including stock levels, batch numbers, expiry dates, and supplier links. Make sure the restored stock count aligns with your current physical inventory.

### Hard Delete (Drugs With No Sales History)
If a drug has **never been sold**, it was added to inventory but never appeared in any sale, MediFlux performs a **hard delete**. The drug is removed permanently without going to Trash.

**Why hard delete?** Since there are no transactional dependencies, the drug can be safely removed without affecting any historical records.

**What happens in hard delete:**

- The drug is removed from the Drug List immediately
- No Trash entry is created
- The deletion is irreversible
- Purchase records for this drug (if any) may show "Unknown Drug" references

> **[Warning]** Hard deletion cannot be undone. If you accidentally delete a drug that hasn't been sold yet, you will need to re-add it manually from scratch.

## Credit Note Deletion And Stock Updates
Deleting a **credit note** (a return or adjustment entry) does **not** move anything to Trash. Instead, the deletion immediately reverses the stock adjustment that the credit note originally applied.

**What happens when you delete a credit note:**

- The credit note record is removed permanently
- The stock quantity is updated back to its pre-credit-note state
- If the credit note reduced stock (e.g., a customer return), deleting it adds that stock back
- If the credit note increased stock (e.g., supplier return reversal), deleting it reduces stock again
- Sales and purchase ledgers are updated to reflect the change

> **[Warning: Important]** Deleting a credit note affects your live inventory count immediately. Always verify the stock impact before confirming deletion, especially if the drug has low stock or is near expiry.

## Trash Page Overview
Navigate to **Drugs → Trash** to view all soft-deleted drugs.

**What you see:**

- A count banner showing how many drugs are in trash (e.g., "Found 1 drugs in trash")
- A table with columns: **Name**, **Supplier**, **HSN**, **Batch**, **Actions**
- Each row has a **Restore** button to reactivate the drug
- An empty state message when all trashed drugs have been viewed or restored: "You've seen all trashed drugs!"

**Trash Actions**

| Action | Result |
|--------|--------|
| Restore | Returns drug to active Drug List with all data intact |

![Trash Actions](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783590765176-51475385-restorepage.png)
*Caption: Trash page showing a soft-deleted drug with supplier details and the Restore action button.*

> **[Note]** Currently, MediFlux does not provide a "Delete Permanently" option from the Drug Trash. Soft-deleted drugs with sales history must remain in Trash to preserve invoice integrity. If you need to clean up old entries, contact your administrator.

## Summary Table
| Scenario | Delete Type | Goes to Trash? | Restorable? | Affects Stock? |
|----------|-------------|----------------|-------------|----------------|
| Drug with sales history | Soft delete | Yes | Yes | No (stock stays as-is) |
| Drug with no sales history | Hard delete | No | No | Yes (stock removed) |
| Credit note deletion | Permanent | No | No | Yes (reverses adjustment) |

--- 
## Back To Inventory

  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - View active inventory and check restored drugs.
  * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Add new drugs to your inventory.
  * [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - Review sales history tied to soft-deleted drugs.
  * [Supplier List](/docs/supplier/supplier-list) - Find suppliers to restock deleted items.

docs/inventory/warehouse.title: Warehouse
docs/inventory/warehouse.description: Manage stock across your Main Store and warehouses, filter inventory by location, transfer medicines between locations, and view warehouse-wise stock details.
docs/inventory/warehouse.body:
# Warehouse

The **Warehouse Module** in MediFlux helps you manage inventory across your **Main Store** and additional warehouses.

You can view stock available at each location, move medicines between the Main Store and warehouses, and check where a particular medicine is stocked.

Warehouse inventory is managed through the **Drug List**, so you can work with your existing medicine records without maintaining a separate drug directory for each location.

---

## Enabling the Warehouse Module

The **Main Store** is available by default in MediFlux.

To add and manage additional warehouses, you need to subscribe to and enable the [Warehouse Module](/docs/settings/modules).

1. **Open Modules**

   Go to **Settings → Modules**.

2. **Find Warehouse Module**

   Locate the **Warehouse Module** in the list of available modules.

3. **Subscribe and enable**

   Choose an available subscription plan and complete the subscription process.

   Once subscribed, enable the module to access warehouse-related inventory features.

> **[Note]** The warehouse selector and stock movement options become available after the [Warehouse Module](/docs/settings/modules) is enabled.

For complete subscription and activation instructions, see [Modules](/docs/settings/modules).

---

## Viewing Inventory by Warehouse

When the **Warehouse Module** is enabled, a warehouse selector appears alongside the filters in **Drugs → Drug List**.

Use this selector to choose which location's inventory you want to view.

| Option | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Main Store** | Inventory available in your Main Store |
| **Individual Warehouse** | Inventory available in the selected warehouse |
| **All Warehouses** | Inventory across all warehouses |

If you have multiple warehouses, each warehouse appears separately in the selector.

![Warehouse stock filter](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/1b7b8bfb-5f27-4fd8-a772-53d5b681c138-warehouse-filter.png)
*Caption: Switch between Main Store, individual warehouses, and All Warehouses from the Drug List.*

### How to Filter Warehouse Stock

1. **Open Drug List**

   Go to **Drugs → Drug List**.

2. **Select a location**

   Use the warehouse selector to choose **Main Store**, an individual warehouse, or **All Warehouses**.

3. **Review the inventory**

   The Drug List displays inventory for the selected location.

   You can use the existing stock, schedule, expiry, and search filters to narrow the results further.

> **[Note]** The warehouse selector controls which location's inventory is displayed. You can still use **Consolidated View** and **Separated View** to work with the displayed stock.

For more information about searching, filtering, and inventory views, see [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list).

---

## Moving Stock Between Locations

MediFlux allows you to transfer medicines between the **Main Store** and warehouses.

Stock can be moved in both directions:

- From a **warehouse to the Main Store**
- From the **Main Store to a warehouse**

Stock movement is performed from **Separated View** because the transfer uses a specific inventory entry.

### Move Stock From a Warehouse to the Main Store

Use this option when you need to bring stock from a warehouse into your Main Store.

1. **Select the warehouse**

   Go to **Drugs → Drug List**.

   Use the warehouse selector to choose the warehouse containing the medicine you want to move.

2. **Open Separated View**

   Select **Separated View**.

   Find the stock entry you want to transfer.

3. **Select Move**

   Open the stock entry's **⋮ Actions** menu and select **Move**.

4. **Enter the quantity**

   The **Move Stock** window displays the drug, batch, source warehouse, current stock, and destination.

   Enter the **Quantity to Move**.

   You can also add **Notes** to record the reason for the transfer.

5. **Confirm the transfer**

   Review the transfer details and select **Move Stock**.

   The specified quantity is moved from the warehouse to the **Main Store**.

![Move stock from warehouse to Main Store](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/489082c1-0836-435d-af49-f3ffdf04bc22-warehoue-to-mainstore.png)
*Caption: Enter the quantity to transfer from a warehouse to the Main Store.*

---

### Move Stock From the Main Store to a Warehouse

Use this option when you want to transfer medicines from the Main Store to a warehouse.

1. **Select Main Store**

   Go to **Drugs → Drug List**.

   Use the warehouse selector to choose **Main Store**.

2. **Open Separated View**

   Select **Separated View** and find the stock entry you want to move.

3. **Select Move**

   Open the stock entry's **⋮ Actions** menu and select **Move**.

4. **Choose the destination warehouse**

   In the **Move Stock** window, select the **Destination Warehouse**.

   If you have multiple warehouses, choose the warehouse that should receive the stock.

5. **Enter the quantity**

   Enter the **Quantity to Move**.

   The maximum quantity that can be moved is shown beside the field.

   You can also add **Notes** for the transfer.

6. **Confirm the transfer**

   Review the information and select **Move Stock**.

   The entered quantity is transferred from the **Main Store** to the selected warehouse.

![Move stock from Main Store to warehouse](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/9a885cae-4170-4305-9bf2-b07c6f4df584-mainstore-warehouse.png)
*Caption: Choose a destination warehouse and quantity when moving stock from the Main Store.*

> **[Note]** Moving stock transfers existing inventory between locations. It does not create new stock.
>
> The transferred quantity is deducted from the source location and added to the destination location.

---

## Viewing Warehouse Stock in a Drug Profile

When the **Warehouse Module** is enabled, a **Warehouse** tab becomes available in the drug details opened from both **Consolidated View** and **Separated View**.

This tab helps you identify **which warehouses contain a selected medicine and how much stock is available in each warehouse**.

You can access the tab whether you are currently viewing the **Main Store** or an individual warehouse in the Drug List.

### How to Check Warehouse Stock

1. **Open a drug**

   Go to **Drugs → Drug List**.

   Choose **Consolidated View** or **Separated View**, then click the medicine name to open its details.

2. **Open the Warehouse tab**

   Select **Warehouse** from the available drug details tabs.

   The tab displays the warehouses where the selected medicine is stocked.

3. **Review warehouse information**

   Each warehouse section shows:

   - **Warehouse Name**
   - **Warehouse Code**
   - **Total Stock**

   Below these details, a table provides the stock-entry breakdown.

   | Column | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | **Batch Number** | Batch number of the medicine |
   | **Expiry Date** | Expiry date of the stock entry |
   | **Rack** | Rack location, if available |
   | **MRP** | Maximum retail price |
   | **Available Stock** | Quantity available in that stock entry |

![Warehouse tab in drug details](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/47122ac7-41e1-4291-a410-bc21f62aa466-warehouse-drugview.png)
*Caption: View warehouses containing the selected medicine, with batch-wise stock, expiry, rack, and MRP.*

---

### Example: ACILOC 150 TAB

Suppose you open the **Warehouse** tab for **ACILOC 150 TAB**.

The tab shows that the medicine is available in **Test Warehouse**, with warehouse code `WH1`.

The warehouse contains two stock entries:

| Batch Number | Expiry Date | Rack | MRP | Available Stock |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `LD25442` | May 2028 | N/A | ₹50.44 | `20` units |
| `LD25442` | May 2028 | N/A | ₹50.44 | `38` units |

Together, these entries account for **58 units** in **Test Warehouse**.

This breakdown helps you identify the individual stock entries contributing to the warehouse's total available quantity.

> **[Note]** The **Warehouse** tab shows warehouses where the selected medicine is available, regardless of whether you opened its details while viewing the **Main Store** or another warehouse.
>
> If the medicine is stocked in multiple warehouses, the tab displays their respective stock details. The number of warehouses shown depends on where the medicine is actually stocked.

---

## Related Documentation


  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Search inventory, manage drug entries, and review stock and activity.
  * [Modules](/docs/settings/modules) - Subscribe to and enable the Warehouse Module.

docs/purchases/add-purchase.title: Add Purchase
docs/purchases/add-purchase.description: Learn how to add a new pharmacy purchase bill in MediFlux. Manually enter drugs, scan supplier invoices via OCR, or bulk import CSV files easily.
docs/purchases/add-purchase.body:
# Add Purchase

The **Add Purchase** page is where you **add a new pharmacy purchase bill** from a supplier in **MediFlux**. Enter the supplier and invoice details, add drugs to the bill line by line, and MediFlux automatically calculates taxes, totals, and margins as you go.

---

## Purchase Details
At the top of the page, enter:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Search for suppliers** | Select the supplier this purchase is from |
| **Invoice number** | The supplier's invoice/bill number |
| **Date** | Date of the purchase (defaults to the current date) |

![MediFlux Pharmacy Purchase Details Form](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/7f1ac66a-11fd-4cef-90ce-d7113e64c7a8-purchase-details.png)
*Caption: Select the pharmacy supplier, enter the invoice number, and set the purchase date in MediFlux.*

---

## Adding Drugs to the Bill
Each row in the purchase table represents one drug being purchased. You can add a new row using the **`+`** button below the table, or remove a row using the **trash icon** on the left of that row.

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **S.No** | Serial number of the line item |
| **Type** | Drug schedule type: **Rx**, **NRx**, or **H1** |
| **Drug** | Search and select the drug being purchased |
| **Units** | Number of units per pack |
| **HSN** | HSN code of the drug |
| **Batch** | Batch number |
| **Expiry** | Expiry date of the batch |
| **QTY** | Quantity purchased |
| **Packs** | Number of packs |
| **Deal** | Buy/free quantity deal applied to this line item, via **Add Deal** |
| **Free** | Free quantity received |
| **Cost** | Cost price per unit |
| **Trade P** | Trade price |
| **MRP** | Maximum Retail Price |
| **DIS** | Discount percentage |
| **SGST / CGST / IGST** | Applicable GST components |
| **Subtotal** | Line item value before tax |
| **Total** | Line item value including tax |
| **Margin** | Profit margin for that line item |

![MediFlux Pharmacy Purchase Drug Table](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/855ee83f-9f30-45da-aa9b-be58b29a6d1d-purchase-table.png)
*Caption: Add drugs line by line to your pharmacy purchase bill with batch, expiry, quantity, cost, MRP, and tax details.*

> **[Note]** Once you select a drug and enter its expiry date, MediFlux shows a price comparison note below the table, for example, flagging if the cost has decreased or increased compared to the average purchase price for that drug. Clicking the **expand icon** on this note opens more detail.

---

## Adding a Deal
Click **Add Deal** on any line item to open the **Add Deal** popup:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Buy Quantity** | Minimum quantity to buy for this deal to apply |
| **Free Quantity** | Free quantity received with the deal |

Click **Save Deal** to apply it to that line item, or **Cancel** to close without saving.

![MediFlux Add Supplier Deal to Pharmacy Purchase](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/63dd7f1e-ee90-481c-8c17-973375fb9d52-add-deak.png)
*Caption: Set buy and free quantities for supplier deals on any pharmacy purchase line item in MediFlux.*

---

## Discount, Payment, and Notes
Below the drug table:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Total Discount** | Overall discount on the purchase, as a percentage or amount |
| **Enter amount paid** | Amount already paid to the supplier for this purchase |
| **Notes** | Free-text field for any additional notes or remarks about the purchase |

![MediFlux Pharmacy Purchase Discount and Payment](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/89049851-2846-427b-94cc-5cf4a28ebfd0-discount.png)
*Caption: Apply overall discount, record the amount paid, and add notes to your pharmacy purchase bill.*

---

## Bill Summary
The bar at the bottom of the page shows a running summary as you build the bill:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Sub Total** | Total value of all line items before discount and tax |
| **Disc** | Total discount applied |
| **Tax** | Total tax across all line items |
| **Bill** | Final bill amount |
| **Margin** | Overall profit margin for the purchase |

From here, you can **Save Draft** to save the purchase without finalising it, or click **Add** to record it as a completed purchase.

---

## Scan
Click **Scan** at the top-right of the **Add Purchase** page to scan a supplier invoice instead of entering medicines manually.

On phones and tablets, you can use **Camera** to capture the invoice or **Upload Files** to upload photos or PDFs. On desktops and laptops, only **Upload Files** is available.

The uploaded invoice is stored in **Purchase Drafts** while it is processed. Once scanning is complete, open the draft and click **Insert** to begin the import process.

Before importing, you must:

1. **Map Invoice Headers** to match the supplier's invoice columns with MediFlux fields.
2. **Review Scanned Items** to verify medicine names, quantities, batches, prices, and other details.
3. Click **Import** to add the extracted medicines to the purchase table.

![MediFlux Scan Pharmacy Supplier Invoice with OCR](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/5b60ce06-2b1d-4120-867f-829858435a98-scan.png)
*Caption: Scan or upload physical pharmacy supplier invoices and import extracted medicines into a MediFlux purchase bill.*

> **[Note]** For a complete walkthrough of scanning, managing drafts, mapping invoice headers, and importing medicines, see the [**AI Bill Scan**](/docs/purchases/ai-bill-scan) guide.

---

## Import CSV
Click **Import CSV** to bulk-import purchase data from a CSV or Excel file. This opens the **Import Purchase Data** dialog, which walks you through three steps:

| Step | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| **1. Upload File** | Drag and drop your CSV or Excel file, or click **Select File** to browse |
| **2. Map Headers** | Match the columns in your file to MediFlux's purchase fields |
| **3. Review & Import** | Review the mapped data before confirming the import |

![MediFlux Bulk Import Pharmacy Purchase Data via CSV](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/1b94a4c5-364b-4a57-bffa-e87e810ce887-import-csv.png)
*Caption: Bulk import pharmacy purchase data via CSV or Excel with automated header mapping in MediFlux.*

---

## Drafts
Click **Drafts** to open the **Purchase Drafts** panel, which lists purchase bills that were previously scanned. Each draft shows its ID, scan status (e.g., **Scanned**), date and time, and the number of files attached. From here you can:

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Rescan** | Re-run the scan on this draft |
| **Append** | Add the draft's line items to the purchase you're currently building |
| **Insert** | Replace the current purchase form with this draft's data |
| **Delete (trash icon)** | Remove the draft |

---

## Clear
Once you've added at least one drug to the bill, a **Clear** button appears next to **Drafts**, letting you reset the form and start over.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Purchase Drafts and Clear Options](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/343b72df-f60e-4228-b8cf-d973bb99dfdc-drafts_and_clear.png)
*Caption: Review, rescan, append, insert, or delete scanned pharmacy purchase drafts in MediFlux.*

---

## Quick Tip
The **`+`** button in the top-right corner of any screen also has an **Add Purchase** option, so you can jump straight into this page from anywhere in MediFlux without navigating through the sidebar.

---

## Stock In, Ready To Go
Recorded your purchase? Here's what happens next.


  * [Purchase List](/docs/purchases/purchase-list) - Review your newly recorded purchase and check its status.
  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Verify the new stock and batches are reflected in your inventory.
  * [Supplier Ledger](/docs/supplier/supplier-ledger) - See how this purchase affected what you owe the supplier.
  * [Drafts](/docs/purchases/drafts) - Review and finalise any scanned invoices waiting in drafts.

docs/purchases/ai-bill-scan.title: AI Bill Scan
docs/purchases/ai-bill-scan.description: Scan pharmacy supplier invoices in MediFlux using OCR. Upload files or use your camera, map headers, and auto-import medicines into purchase bills.
docs/purchases/ai-bill-scan.body:
# AI Bill Scan

The **AI Bill Scan** feature allows you to **scan pharmacy supplier invoices** using OCR instead of entering each medicine manually in **MediFlux**.

You can capture an invoice using your phone's camera or upload invoice files for MediFlux to scan and extract the medicine details.

Once the invoice is processed, you can review the scanned items, map the invoice columns to MediFlux fields, and import the medicines into the [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) form.

Navigate to **Purchases → Add Purchase** and click **Scan** at the top-right.

![MediFlux AI Bill Scan Option on Add Purchase](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/2ac6035f-c22c-4fcf-a093-83f3a15ba24b-purchase-scan.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux Add Purchase page providing Scan, Import CSV, and Drafts options for entering pharmacy purchase data.*

---

## Available Scanning Methods

Click **Scan** to open the **Scan Invoice** dialog.

MediFlux provides two options depending on the device you are using.

| Method | Description | Availability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Camera** | Capture the supplier invoice using your device camera | Phone and tablet |
| **Upload Files** | Upload invoice photos or PDF documents | Phone, tablet, desktop, and laptop |

![MediFlux AI Bill Scan Options (Camera or Upload)](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/98633891-41a4-4f3b-819c-ac69ee860e92-scan-options.png)
*Caption: Choose Camera for a live pharmacy invoice scan or Upload Files to select invoice photos or PDFs in MediFlux.*

> **[Note]** On phones and tablets, you can use both **Camera** and **Upload Files**. On desktops and laptops, only **Upload Files** is available.

---

## Method 1: Scan Using Your Phone Camera

Use the **Camera** option when you have a physical supplier invoice and want to scan it directly.

1. **Open Add Purchase**

   Go to **Purchases → Add Purchase** on your phone or tablet.

2. **Open the scanner**

   Click **Scan** and select **Camera**.

   Allow camera access if your device requests permission.

3. **Capture the invoice**

   Position the supplier invoice within the camera view and capture it.

   Make sure the medicine names, batch numbers, quantities, prices, and other details are clearly visible.

4. **Wait for processing**

   After capturing the invoice, MediFlux processes the scanned document.

   The scanned invoice is available through **Purchase Drafts** while you continue the import workflow.

> **[Note]** For better scanning results, place the invoice on a flat surface, use sufficient lighting, and make sure the entire invoice is visible and readable.

---

## Method 2: Upload Invoice Files

Use **Upload Files** when you already have a digital copy or photograph of the supplier invoice.

This is the available scanning method on desktops and laptops.

1. **Open Scan Invoice**

   Navigate to **Purchases → Add Purchase**.

   Click **Scan** at the top-right.

2. **Select Upload Files**

   In the **Scan Invoice** dialog, select **Upload Files**.

   This option accepts invoice photos or PDF documents.

3. **Upload the invoice**

   Choose the invoice file or files from your device.

   MediFlux processes the uploaded documents to extract the purchase details.

4. **Access the scanned draft**

   Open **Drafts** to check the uploaded invoice and its processing status.

> **[Note]** **Scan** and **Import CSV** are separate features. Use **Scan** for invoice photos or PDFs. Use **Import CSV** when importing purchase data from a structured CSV file.

---

## Purchase Drafts

When you upload or scan a purchase invoice, it is stored in **Purchase Drafts** while the document is being processed.

This allows you to access the scanned invoice and continue working with it once processing is complete.

Click **Drafts** at the top-right of the **Add Purchase** page to open the **Purchase Drafts** panel.

![MediFlux Purchase Drafts Panel for Scanned Invoices](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/0b76d80c-a3e2-4559-8534-a6640b65ae24-purchase-drafts.png)
*Caption: View scanned pharmacy purchase drafts, OCR processing status, attached invoice files, and available draft actions in MediFlux.*

### Understanding the Draft Information

Each scanned draft displays information such as:

| Information | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Draft Number** | Unique reference for the draft |
| **Date and Time** | When the draft was created |
| **Status** | Processing status, such as Scanned |
| **Files Attached** | Number of invoice files attached to the draft |
| **File Previews** | Thumbnails of the uploaded invoice documents |

Once a draft has been scanned, you can review it and choose how to proceed.

### Available Draft Actions

| Action | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Edit** | Open the scanned draft for editing |
| **Rescan** | Scan the invoice again |
| **Append** | Add more files to the existing draft |
| **Insert** | Continue with importing the scanned invoice data |
| **Delete icon** | Delete the draft |

> **[Warning: Review before deleting]** Deleting a draft removes it from the Purchase Drafts list. Make sure you no longer need the draft before using the delete option.

### How to Continue a Scanned Draft

1. **Open Purchase Drafts**

   Click **Drafts** from the **Add Purchase** page.

2. **Find your invoice**

   Locate the draft using its reference number, date, or attached invoice previews.

   Check that its processing status shows **Scanned**.

3. **Review the available actions**

   You can use **Edit**, **Rescan**, or **Append** if the scanned draft needs further changes.

4. **Select Insert**

   When the scanned invoice is ready, click **Insert**.

   MediFlux opens the **Map Invoice Headers** dialog.

---

## Map Invoice Headers

Before importing the scanned medicines, you must review how the invoice's column headings are mapped to the corresponding fields in MediFlux.

Supplier invoices may use different column names for the same information.

For example, one invoice may use `Product Description` while another uses `Item Name`.

The **Map Invoice Headers** step ensures the extracted information is assigned to the correct purchase fields.

![MediFlux Map Invoice Headers for AI Bill Scan](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/cdda7c76-f74a-4ca2-a4dd-9f9353c6bcf3-mapping-purchase.png)
*Caption: Match detected pharmacy invoice columns with the corresponding MediFlux fields before importing scanned purchase data.*

### Understanding the Mapping Table

The mapping dialog displays two columns:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Detected Column** | Column name extracted from the scanned supplier invoice, along with a sample value |
| **Map To Field** | Corresponding MediFlux field where the extracted information should be imported |

For each detected column, select the correct field from the **Map To Field** dropdown.

### Common Header Mappings

| Detected Invoice Column | Map To Field |
| --- | --- |
| Product Description | Drug/Product Name |
| Pack | Units/Pack Size |
| HSN | HSN Code |
| Qty | Quantity |
| Free | Free Quantity |
| MRP | MRP |
| Batch | Batch Number |

The exact detected column names depend on the supplier's invoice.

> **[Warning: Check required fields]** Fields marked with `*` are required. Make sure they are mapped correctly before continuing.
>
> Pay particular attention to **Drug/Product Name**, **Quantity**, and **Batch Number**, as incorrect mapping can lead to incorrect purchase entries.

### How to Map Invoice Headers

1. **Review detected columns**

   Check each column name detected from the invoice.

   Use the sample value shown below the column name to understand what information it contains.

2. **Select the correct MediFlux field**

   Open the **Map To Field** dropdown and select the matching field.

   For example:

   - Map `Product Description` to **Drug/Product Name**
   - Map `Qty` to **Quantity**
   - Map `Batch` to **Batch Number**
   - Map `HSN` to **HSN Code**

3. **Check all required mappings**

   Scroll through the mapping list and make sure all required fields have been assigned correctly.

4. **Continue to review**

   Click **Next** to open the **Review & Import** step.

---

## Review Scanned Items Before Importing

After mapping the invoice headers, MediFlux displays the **Import Scanned Items** dialog.

This is the final review step before adding the extracted medicines to the purchase form.

![MediFlux Review Scanned Purchase Items Before Import](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/4b86d9fa-b090-4f92-8025-ac3b8fdd0d9b-import-headers.png)
*Caption: Preview extracted pharmacy medicines, quantities, rates, batches, MRP, subtotals, and HSN codes before importing into MediFlux.*

### What You Can Review

The dialog displays the number of items found in the scanned invoice and a preview of the extracted medicines.

Depending on the invoice, the preview can include:

| Detail | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Drug Name** | Medicine name extracted from the invoice |
| **Dosage Form** | Medicine form, such as Tablet or Gel |
| **Quantity** | Purchased quantity |
| **Free Quantity** | Free units supplied, if applicable |
| **Rate** | Purchase rate |
| **Batch** | Batch number |
| **MRP** | Maximum Retail Price |
| **Subtotal** | Extracted line subtotal |
| **HSN** | HSN code |

For example, a scanned invoice might contain:

| Drug | Quantity | Rate | Subtotal |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| PSI LIC-21/02241/30004488 | 2 | ₹23.50 | ₹47.00 |
| DAVERY GEL 30 GM | 6 + 1 free | ₹83.50 | ₹501.00 |
| MEGANERV-LC TAB | 3 | ₹16.85 | ₹50.55 |

Review the extracted details carefully before importing.

### Important: Existing Purchase Rows Will Be Replaced

> **[Warning: Import replaces current purchase entries]** Importing the scanned items will **replace all current entries in the purchase form**.
>
> If you have already entered medicines manually, review them before continuing with the import.

### Generic Items After Import

Scanned medicines are initially imported as **generic items**.

You can match them with medicines in your existing inventory after importing them into the purchase form.

> **[Note]** Importing scanned items does not automatically mean every medicine has been matched with an existing inventory record. Review and match the imported medicines as needed.

### How to Import Scanned Items

1. **Review the extracted medicines**

   Check the medicine names, quantities, rates, batch numbers, and other extracted details.

2. **Go back if corrections are needed**

   If the column mappings are incorrect, click **Back** to return to **Map Invoice Headers**.

   Correct the mappings and continue again.

3. **Confirm the import**

   Once the extracted data looks correct, click **Import**.

   MediFlux inserts the scanned medicines into the **Add Purchase** table.

---

## Review the Imported Purchase Bill

After importing, the extracted medicines appear as rows in the **Add Purchase** table.

You can review the imported values before saving the purchase.

![MediFlux Imported Medicines in Add Purchase Table](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/32d22eb7-b490-4a32-897c-ad109c7fcb86-review-purchase.png)
*Caption: Scanned pharmacy medicines populated in the MediFlux purchase table with drug names, batches, expiry dates, quantities, prices, and totals.*

### What to Check After Importing

Review the following information:

| Field | What to verify |
| --- | --- |
| **Drug** | Correct medicine name |
| **Units** | Correct units per pack |
| **HSN** | Correct HSN code |
| **Batch** | Correct batch number |
| **Expiry** | Correct expiry date |
| **QTY** | Correct purchased quantity |
| **Free** | Correct free quantity |
| **Cost** | Correct purchase rate |
| **MRP** | Correct maximum retail price |
| **SGST / CGST / IGST** | Correct applicable tax rates |
| **Subtotal / Total** | Correct calculated amounts |

You should also review the supplier, invoice number, invoice date, and warehouse selection before saving the purchase.

### Complete the Purchase

1. **Select the supplier**

   Choose the supplier associated with the scanned invoice.

2. **Enter invoice details**

   Enter or verify the invoice number and purchase date.

   Select a warehouse if the purchase should be assigned to a particular warehouse.

3. **Review the imported medicines**

   Check all imported medicine rows and correct any information that needs updating.

   Match generic items with your inventory where applicable.

4. **Review the bill summary**

   At the bottom of the page, review:

   - **Sub Total**
   - **Discount**
   - **Tax**
   - **Bill**
   - **Margin**

5. **Save the purchase**

   Click **+ Add** to record the purchase.

   Alternatively, click **Save Draft** if you want to complete it later.

---

## Complete Purchase Scanning Workflow

The complete process follows this order:

1. **Scan or upload**

   Open **Purchases → Add Purchase → Scan**.

   Use **Camera** on a phone or tablet, or **Upload Files** to upload invoice photos or PDFs.

2. **Wait for the scan**

   The uploaded invoice is stored in **Purchase Drafts** while processing.

3. **Open the scanned draft**

   Once the draft is scanned, open **Drafts** and locate the invoice.

   Use **Edit**, **Rescan**, or **Append** if needed.

4. **Insert the scanned invoice**

   Click **Insert** to continue with the import.

5. **Map the headers**

   Match the detected invoice columns with the correct MediFlux fields.

   Click **Next**.

6. **Review and import**

   Check the extracted medicine details.

   Click **Import** to populate the purchase table.

7. **Verify and save**

   Review the imported medicines, purchase details, and totals.

   Click **+ Add** to save the purchase.

---

## Important Things to Remember

- **Camera** and **Upload Files** are both available on phones and tablets.
- On desktops and laptops, use **Upload Files**.
- Scanned invoices are available through **Purchase Drafts** while processing.
- A scanned draft can be edited, rescanned, appended to, inserted, or deleted.
- Always review **Map Invoice Headers** before importing.
- The **Review & Import** step lets you check the extracted medicine details.
- Importing scanned items replaces the existing medicine entries in the purchase form.
- Imported medicines are initially treated as generic items and can be matched with inventory afterward.
- Review all medicine details, tax rates, and purchase totals before saving.

---

## Related Guides


  * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Learn how to create and save purchase bills.
  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Manage medicines and review existing inventory records.
  * [Warehouse](/docs/inventory/warehouse) - Manage warehouse locations for purchased stock.
  * [Scan & Image OCR for Sales](/docs/sales/scan-and-ocr) - Learn how barcode scanning and drug OCR work during sales.

docs/purchases/drafts.title: Drafts
docs/purchases/drafts.description: Track the status of scanned purchase bills and clean up drafts you no longer need.
docs/purchases/drafts.body:
# Drafts

The **Drafts** page lists every purchase bill that has been scanned via the **Add Purchase** page, along with its processing status. Use this page to check whether a scanned bill has finished processing, and to delete drafts you no longer need.

---

## Filtering By Status
Five tabs at the top let you filter drafts by their processing status:

| Tab | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| **All** | Every draft, regardless of status |
| **Awaiting** | Drafts waiting to be processed |
| **Scanning** | Drafts currently being scanned |
| **Completed** | Drafts that have finished scanning successfully |
| **Failed** | Drafts that failed to process |

A **Found X Drafts** count above the tabs shows how many drafts match the currently selected filter.

![Draft Status Tabs](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/c1100309-7afa-4412-b4ae-f39c93ac7ead-purchase-drafts.png)
*Caption: Filter drafts by All, Awaiting, Scanning, Completed, or Failed status.*

---

## The Drafts Table
Each row in the table represents one scanned purchase bill:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Draft ID** | Unique identifier for the draft |
| **Status** | Current processing status (e.g. **Completed**) |
| **Type** | The module the draft belongs to (**Purchase**) |
| **Source** | How the draft was created (e.g. **Scan**) |
| **Files** | Number of files attached to the draft |
| **Date** | Date the draft was created |
| **Actions** | Quick action menu for that draft row |

![Drafts Table](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/6ddcfbf6-e7d3-4af8-8798-d71bde73ce06-drafts-columns.png)
*Caption: List of scanned purchase drafts with ID, status, source, files, and date.*

---

## Row Actions
Clicking the **three-dot menu (⋮)** on any draft row opens a single option:

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Delete Draft** | Permanently removes the draft from the list |

![Draft Actions](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/3a7aa729-b206-4653-94e5-8fd735b569e4-row-actions.png)
*Caption: Delete a draft permanently from the actions menu.*

---

## Where Drafts Come From
Drafts are created automatically when you use **Scan** on the **Add Purchase** page. To act on a draft, inserting or appending it into a purchase bill,  go to **Add Purchase** and open the **Drafts** panel from there. See [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) for details.

---

## Clear The Queue
Checked your scanned bills? Here's where to go from here.


  * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Insert or append completed drafts into a full purchase bill.
  * [Purchase List](/docs/purchases/purchase-list) - Review all finalised purchases once drafts are converted.
  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Verify inventory updated correctly after converting drafts.
  * [Trash](/docs/purchases/trash) - Recover deleted purchases if you removed the wrong draft.

docs/purchases/overview.title: Purchases
docs/purchases/overview.description: Manage pharmacy purchases in MediFlux. Record purchase bills, track purchase orders, restock inventory, and scan supplier invoices from one central hub.
docs/purchases/overview.body:
# Purchases

The **Purchases** section is where every **pharmacy purchase** your store makes from suppliers is recorded and managed in **MediFlux**. From regular purchase bills to purchase orders, restocks, and scanned drafts, MediFlux handles the full purchase lifecycle, with each purchase automatically updating your inventory and supplier ledger.

---

## What You Can Do In Purchases
- **Record purchases:** Log new stock coming in from a supplier, item by item.
- **Raise purchase orders:** Create and track orders sent to suppliers before stock arrives.
- **Track order status:** See which purchase orders are pending, synced, or completed.
- **Restock inventory:** Manage restock orders for existing drugs.
- **Scan and auto-fill bills:** Use the built-in scanner to read supplier invoices and pre-fill purchase details.
- **Recover deleted purchases:** View and restore purchases from Trash.
- **Access saved drafts:** Resume purchase bills that were scanned or saved but not yet finalised.

---

## Navigating the Purchases Section
The **Purchases** section in the left sidebar expands into six main pages:

| Page | What it's for |
| --- | --- |
| **Purchase List** | View, search, and manage all your recorded purchases |
| **Purchase Orders** | Create and track purchase orders sent to suppliers |
| **Add Purchase** | Record a new purchase bill from a supplier |
| **Restocks** | View and manage restock orders for existing drugs |
| **Trash** | View and restore deleted purchases |
| **Drafts** | Access saved or scanned purchase drafts that haven't been finalised yet |

![MediFlux Pharmacy Purchases Sidebar Navigation](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/32126322-8121-4ff5-8980-93aa82b78a43-purchases-navbar.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux left sidebar showing Purchase List, Purchase Orders, Add Purchase, Restocks, Trash, and Drafts.*

---

## Quick Actions From Anywhere
You don't have to navigate to the Purchases section to add a purchase. The **`+`** button in the top-right corner of any screen gives you instant access:

- **Add Purchase:** Start a new purchase bill from anywhere in MediFlux.

The **`+`** quick-add menu is available on every screen. Use it whenever you need to quickly start a new purchase without interrupting your current workflow.

![MediFlux Quick Add Pharmacy Purchase](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/32fd2594-7e82-4fa0-8db9-2b0ac1d3f83d-quick-add-purchase.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux dashboard quick-add menu showing the Add Purchase option for fast workflow.*

---

## Purchase List
The **Purchase List** is your complete purchase record. Each entry shows the purchase number, date and time, the supplier it was billed from, the total item count and amount, and a status tag where applicable, such as **Partial** (partially received) or **Returned**. Some entries also display a challan number alongside the purchase number. You can search by supplier, drug, or challan/invoice number, and filter the list to narrow results. Each purchase can be expanded for more detail or actioned from the row.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Purchase List Record](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/2103c87b-e762-451d-8c62-932dcd1b4d0b-purchase-list.png)
*Caption: Complete MediFlux purchase record with purchase number, supplier, item count, amount, and status tags.*

---

## Purchase Orders
The **Purchase Orders** page tracks orders raised with suppliers before stock physically arrives. Each order shows the order number, an **Unpaid** tag where relevant, the supplier, item count and amount, and a status such as **Pending** or **Synced**. Pending orders show quick approve/reject actions directly in the row, while synced orders use a standard actions menu. A counter at the top highlights how many orders are currently pending. You can search by supplier or drug name.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Purchase Orders Tracking](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/33be1fd6-c614-4323-bcae-cb13daf73968-purchase-orders.png)
*Caption: Track pharmacy purchase orders with suppliers in MediFlux, showing status, approve/reject actions, and pending count.*

---

## Add Purchase
The **Add Purchase** page is where you record a new purchase bill. Select the supplier, enter the invoice number and date, then add drugs to the bill either manually or via **Scan** (to auto-read a supplier invoice) or **Import CSV**. Each line item captures details such as type (e.g., Rx), units, HSN code, batch, expiry, quantity, packs, deal, free quantity, cost, trade price, and MRP. Clicking on a drug shows its purchase history and price comparison. The bill auto-calculates the subtotal, discount, tax, final bill amount, and margin. You can save the purchase as a draft or add it directly.

![MediFlux Add Pharmacy Purchase Bill](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/3eff5dac-b207-4860-b65e-5d26a1311836-add-purchase.png)
*Caption: Record a new pharmacy purchase bill in MediFlux with manual entry, scan, or CSV import options.*

---

## Restocks
The **Restocks** page manages restock orders for drugs already in your inventory. You can search by brand, salt, drug class, or manufacturer, and filter by order status using the **Filter by** dropdown. When no restock orders exist, the page shows an empty state.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Inventory Restocks](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/456cb3bb-fbc4-4b95-802a-da5671ed9ca5-restocks.png)
*Caption: Manage pharmacy restock orders for existing inventory in MediFlux, with search and filter options.*

---

## Trash
The **Trash** page holds purchases that have been deleted. You can search by supplier, drug, or challan number, and reset filters if needed. When no deleted purchases match your search, the page displays an empty state.

![MediFlux Deleted Pharmacy Purchase Recovery](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/b3865aa8-94ed-4925-8fd2-fb3be8164552-purchase-trash.png)
*Caption: View and restore deleted pharmacy purchases in MediFlux, with search by supplier, drug, or challan number.*

---

## Drafts
The **Drafts** page holds saved or scanned purchase bills that haven't been finalised yet. Drafts can be filtered by status: **All**, **Awaiting**, **Scanning**, **Completed**, or **Failed**. Each entry shows the draft ID, status, type, source (e.g., **Scan**), number of attached files, and date. This is where purchase bills scanned via the **Add Purchase** page land before they're reviewed and converted into a full purchase entry.

![MediFlux Scanned Pharmacy Purchase Drafts](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/94d02af7-842a-420e-a969-6e37a57ffdb4-draft.png)
*Caption: Review and finalise scanned or saved pharmacy purchase bills in MediFlux before converting to full entries.*

---

## Quick Tip
Use the **Scan** option on the Add Purchase page whenever you receive a physical supplier invoice. It saves you from manually typing out every drug, batch, and expiry, and the scanned bill lands in **Drafts** for you to review before finalising.

---

## FAQs

  ### What's the difference between Purchase Orders and Add Purchase?

A Purchase Order is raised before stock arrives; it's a request sent to the supplier. Add Purchase is used to record stock that has actually been received, whether or not a purchase order was raised for it first.
  ### Where do scanned invoices go before I can review them?

Scanned purchase bills go to Drafts first, tagged with a status like Awaiting, Scanning, Completed, or Failed. Once processed, you can review and convert them into a full purchase entry.
  ### Can I recover a purchase I deleted by mistake?

Yes, deleted purchases move to Trash, where you can search for them and restore them.
  ### Does adding a purchase automatically update my supplier ledger?

Yes, every recorded purchase updates both your inventory and the relevant supplier's ledger.


---

## Start Purchasing
Get stock into your pharmacy and keep your inventory up to date.


  * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Record a new purchase bill, scan supplier invoices, or import via CSV.
  * [Purchase List](/docs/purchases/purchase-list) - Review all recorded purchases, check status, and search by supplier or drug.
  * [Supplier List](/docs/supplier/supplier-list) - Manage your suppliers before recording purchases against them.
  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Check current stock levels before placing restock orders.

docs/purchases/purchase-details.title: Purchase Details
docs/purchases/purchase-details.description: View the complete breakdown of a single purchase, including its summary, line items, and invoice.
docs/purchases/purchase-details.body:
# Purchase Details

Clicking any purchase from the **Purchase List** or selecting **View Details** from its row actions menu opens the **Purchase Details** page. This gives you the full picture of that purchase: who it was made from, what was bought, how the bill was calculated, and access to the invoice and related actions.

---

## Purchase Info
At the top of the page:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Created by** | Who created the purchase (e.g. "Created by You") |
| **Purchase From** | Name of the supplier |
| **Purchase** | Date the purchase was made |
| **Added** | Date and time the purchase was added to MediFlux |

---

## Actions
A set of action buttons sits alongside the purchase info:

| Button | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Invoice** | Opens a preview of the purchase invoice |
| **Download** | Downloads the purchase invoice |
| **Print Labels** | Prints drug labels for the items in this purchase |
| **More** | Opens additional actions for this purchase |

![Purchase detail page](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/8cae055a-5751-493f-b61d-d85593bd0d90-detailed-purchase-view.png)
*Caption: Purchase header with supplier name, invoice number, and action buttons, plus summary cards showing subtotal, discount, tax, and grand total*
---
The **More** menu contains:

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Print** | Prints the purchase |
| **Add Payment** | Records a payment made against this purchase |
| **View Supplier** | Opens the supplier's profile |
| **View Ledger** | Opens the supplier's ledger |
| **Return Purchase** | Initiates a return for this purchase |
| **Edit** | Edit this purchase entry |
| **Delete** | Deletes the purchase and moves it to Trash |

![Purchase Actions](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/65e753c1-bda9-4a63-bd90-08e933dba38b-more-menu.png)
*Caption: Invoice, Download, Print Labels, and More actions for a purchase.*

---

## Summary
Four cards give an at-a-glance breakdown of the purchase:

| Card | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Subtotal** | Total value of all line items before discount and tax |
| **Total Discount** | Total discount applied on the purchase |
| **Total Tax** | Total tax charged on the purchase |
| **Grand Total** | Final purchase amount |

Below the cards, a **Calculation Breakdown** shows how the grand total was arrived at, the base amount, the discount deducted, the resulting subtotal, tax applied (with the GST split, e.g. CGST + SGST), the total tax, and the final grand total.

![Purchase Summary](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/beb928ef-65ef-4cd1-a71d-a903f0f2df82-summary-purchase.png)
*Caption: Subtotal, discount, tax, and grand total cards with full calculation breakdown.*

---

## Drugs
The **Drugs** section lists every line item in the purchase:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Drug** | Name of the drug |
| **Batch** | Batch number |
| **QTY** | Quantity purchased |
| **Rate** | Purchase rate per unit |
| **MRP** | Maximum Retail Price |
| **Subtotal** | Line item value before tax |
| **Dis.** | Discount percentage applied |
| **Tax** | Tax amount and percentage applied |
| **Ret.** | Returned quantity, if any |
| **Total** | Final line item value |

A **Grand Total** row at the bottom of the table sums up the quantity, subtotal, discount, tax, and total across all line items.

![Drugs Section](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/011c51e8-686c-4cb9-99ef-989d70ec5060-drugs.png)
*Caption: Line item breakdown with batch, quantity, rate, MRP, discount, tax, and total.*

---

## Invoice
Clicking **Invoice** opens a preview of the purchase bill, showing:

- Store details and the supplier's details, including DL number and GSTIN
- Invoice number and date
- An itemised drug table (HSN, batch, expiry, quantity, free quantity, rate, MRP, discount, subtotal, tax, and total)
- A GST breakdown by tax slab (CGST and SGST)
- The grand total and balance
- Standard terms & conditions

From this preview, you can **Download** the invoice, **Print** it, or **Change Template** to switch the invoice layout.

![Invoice Preview](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/e87c9e75-3969-4c35-8776-65a59c8b13f0-invoice.png)
*Caption: Full purchase invoice with store and supplier details, itemised drugs, and GST breakdown.*

---

## FAQs

  ### Can I edit a purchase after it's been added?

Yes, use **Edit** from the **More** menu on the Purchase Details page.
  ### How do I record a partial payment against a purchase?

Use **Add Payment** from the **More** menu. This is also reflected in the supplier's ledger.
  ### Where do I go to return this purchase to the supplier?

Use **Return Purchase** from the **More** menu.


---

## Follow Up On This Purchase
Reviewed the details? Here's what to do next.


  * [Supplier Ledger](/docs/supplier/supplier-ledger) - Check outstanding payments and credit history for this supplier.
  * [Add Payment](/docs/supplier/supplier-ledger) - Record a payment against this purchase from the More menu.
  * [Purchase List](/docs/purchases/purchase-list) - Return to the full list to review other purchases.
  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Verify the new stock from this purchase is reflected in inventory.

docs/purchases/purchase-list.title: Purchase List
docs/purchases/purchase-list.description: View, search, filter, and manage all your recorded purchases in one place.
docs/purchases/purchase-list.body:
# Purchase List

The **Purchase List** is your complete record of every purchase made in your pharmacy. You can search across suppliers, drugs, and challan or invoice numbers, and filter by date range, amount, and sort order to quickly find what you're looking for.

---

## Searching Purchases
The search bar at the top lets you search across **suppliers, drugs, and challan/invoice numbers**. Just start typing and the list filters instantly.

To the left of the search bar is an **All** dropdown, which lets you narrow the search scope to a specific field:

| Option | Searches by |
| --- | --- |
| **All** | Every field below, combined |
| **Invoice Number** | Invoice number only |
| **Challan Number** | Challan number only |
| **Supplier** | Supplier name only |
| **Drugs** | Drug name only |

![Search Purchases](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/58561f14-8fc9-4cb0-8877-303188c5f843-purchase-searchbar.png)
*Caption: Search across suppliers, drugs, and challan or invoice numbers with scoped filtering.*

---

## The Purchase Table
The main table lists all your purchases with the following columns:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Purchase Details** | Purchase number, and challan number where applicable |
| **Supplier** | Supplier name and date/time of the purchase |
| **Items** | Total value of the purchase and number of items |
| **Actions** | Quick action menu for that purchase row |

The page shows a **Found X** count above the table indicating how many purchases match the current filters.

Some purchases carry a status tag next to the purchase number:

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **Partial** | Purchase partially received |
| **Returned** | Purchase returned to the supplier |

![Purchase Table](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/7a2b1edf-f4f6-4b32-960a-c4e48f45ae41-purchase-list-details.png)
*Caption: List of purchases with status tags, supplier details, and item counts.*

---

## Expanding A Purchase Row
Click the **chevron (˅)** on the left of any purchase row to expand it and see the full line item breakdown:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **SR.** | Serial number of the line item |
| **HSN** | HSN code of the drug |
| **Product** | Name of the drug |
| **Batch** | Batch number |
| **Expiry** | Expiry date of the batch |
| **QTY** | Quantity purchased |
| **Rate** | Purchase rate per unit |
| **MRP** | Maximum Retail Price |
| **Total** | Total amount for that line item |

The **Grand Total** is shown at the bottom right of the expanded row.

![Expanded Purchase Row](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/b08c5762-55ec-4e79-a256-a2e49478c78c-expanded-purchase-row.png)
*Caption: Line item breakdown with HSN, batch, expiry, quantity, rate, MRP, and total.*

---

## Row Actions
Clicking the **three-dot menu (⋮)** on any purchase row opens a quick-actions menu with three options:

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **View Details** | Opens the full details for this purchase |
| **View Invoice** | Opens the invoice for this purchase |
| **Update** | Edit this purchase entry |

Note: Clicking any purchase row, or selecting **View Details** from its actions menu, opens the full **Purchase Details** page, with a complete breakdown of the summary, line items, and invoice. See [Purchase Details](/docs/purchases/purchase-details) for more.

![Row Actions](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/0cf2315a-e3dd-4588-82cc-9a28613463e3-actions.png)
*Caption: Quick actions menu for viewing details, viewing invoice, or updating a purchase.*

---

## Filters Panel
Click the **Filter** button at the top-right to open the **Purchases Filters** panel:

| Filter | Options |
| --- | --- |
| **Date Range** | Custom From Date and To Date |
| **Amount Range** | Min Amount (₹) and Max Amount (₹) |
| **Sort By** | Sort Field: Purchase Date. Order: Ascending or Descending |

Click **Apply** to apply the selected filters, or **Clear** to reset them.

![Filters Panel](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/0ebe659d-de1f-4cce-a751-e21b924f23b8-filter-panel.png)
*Caption: Filter by date range, amount range, and sort order.*

---

## Adding A Purchase From Anywhere
You don't have to navigate to the Purchases section to add a purchase. Click the **`+` button** in the top-right corner of any screen and select **Add Purchase** to start a new purchase bill from anywhere in MediFlux.

---

## Keep Track Of Stock
Reviewed your purchases? Here's what to do next.
