   Optionally enter a receipt or transaction reference.

5. **Confirm**

   Click **Confirm & Complete Sale** to complete the adjustment.

![MediFlux Refund Excess Wholesale Return to Customer](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/c11f4114-3522-4d3b-bc72-bc484e865ad3-wholesale-refund.png)
*Caption: Choose the refund amount and payment method before completing the wholesale pharmacy sale in MediFlux.*

> **[Note]** When the return amount exceeds the sale amount, MediFlux requires you to choose whether to keep the excess as customer credit or refund it.

---

### Method 2: Return Individual Medicines Using Rtn

Instead of entering a return amount directly, you can select individual medicines for return.

The **Rtn** column in the wholesale drug table contains a checkbox for each medicine row.

#### How to Return Individual Medicines

1. **Select a customer**

   Open **Add Sale** or **Edit Sale** in Wholesale mode and select the customer.

2. **Locate the medicines**

   Find the medicines being returned in the drug table.

3. **Select Rtn**

   Tick the **Rtn** checkbox beside each medicine you want to return.

4. **Review the adjustment**

   Check the return adjustment and updated sale totals.

5. **Save the sale**

   Click **+ Add** or **Update** to complete the sale.

> **[Note]** Use **Direct Return** when you want to enter a return amount manually. Use **Rtn** when the return applies to specific medicines.

---

### Viewing Adjusted Returns in the Sale Summary

After applying a return, the sale summary shows the original bill amount, return adjustment, and remaining net bill.

For example:

| Summary Field | Amount |
| --- | ---: |
| **Gross Total** | ₹2,435 |
| **Direct Return Amount** | ₹2,700 |
| **Return Adjustment** | -₹2,435 |
| **Net Payable** | ₹0.00 |

![MediFlux Wholesale Adjusted Return Summary Breakdown](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/8e788d57-2741-4e22-9de7-66d2a2c35a5b-wholesale-returned-sale.png)
*Caption: Review the gross total, return adjustment, and remaining net payable amount for wholesale pharmacy sales.*

When the sale is recorded, the confirmation dialog also shows that a return adjustment was applied.

---

### Adjusted Returns While Editing a Sale

Adjusted Returns can also be applied while editing an existing wholesale sale.

1. **Open Edit Sale**

   Open the wholesale sale you want to edit.

2. **Update the return**

   Enter or modify the **Direct Return (₹)** amount, or select **Rtn** for individual medicines.

3. **Review the payment details**

   Check the adjusted net bill and select the appropriate payment status.

4. **Save changes**

   Click **Update** to save the edited sale.

---

### Adjusted Returns in Challan Mode

Adjusted Returns are also available in **Challan Mode**.

When preparing a challan, you can enter a **Direct Return** amount or use **Rtn** to mark individual medicines for return.

1. **Switch to Challan Mode**

   Open **Sales → Add Sale → Wholesale**.

   Enable **Challan Mode** using the **Sale Mode** toggle.

2. **Select the customer**

   Choose the customer associated with the challan.

3. **Add medicines and returns**

   Enter the medicines being dispatched.

   Use **Direct Return (₹)** to adjust a return amount or select **Rtn** beside medicines being returned.

4. **Review and save**

   Review the adjusted totals and save the challan.

> **[Note]** A challan remains a delivery note until it is converted into a sale. The payment tracking described in the preceding examples applies to sale billing.

---

## Drug Table

The wholesale drug table contains additional columns for pricing, GST, and free quantities.

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **S.No** | Serial number |
| **Rtn** | Select the checkbox to mark an individual medicine for return |
| **Type** | Drug type: Rx, NRx, H1 |
| **Drug** | Drug name |
| **Batch** | Batch number |
| **Expiry** | Expiry date |
| **HSN** | HSN code of the drug |
| **Units** | Number of units per pack |
| **QTY** | Quantity sold |
| **FREE** | Free or bonus units given with this sale |
| **Rate** | Negotiated sale rate per unit |
| **MRP** | Maximum Retail Price |
| **DIS(%)** | Discount percentage |
| **CGST%** | Central GST percentage (for local sales) |
| **SGST%** | State GST percentage (for local sales) |
| **Subtotal** | Line item subtotal before tax |
| **Total** | Final line item total after tax |

Click the **grid icon (⊞)** at the bottom of the table to add more drug rows.

![MediFlux Wholesale Pharmacy Drug Table](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783938260260-548234085-drug-table.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux wholesale drug table with columns for HSN, free units, rate, MRP, discount, and split GST.*

---

## Quick Add Drug (Alt + D)

If a medicine is not available in your Drug List while creating a wholesale sale, you can add it directly without leaving the **Add Sale** page.

Press `Alt + D` to open the **Quick Add Drug** dialog. The medicine name you were searching for is automatically filled in, so you do not need to type it again.

![MediFlux Quick Add Drug from Wholesale Billing Screen](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/ce975837-6f34-4679-93c9-c9ad6d9cad50-wholesale-add-drug.png)
*Caption: Add a new medicine directly from the MediFlux Add Sale page using Alt + D without interrupting wholesale pharmacy billing.*

### How To Quickly Add A Drug

1. **Search for a medicine**

   On the **Add Sale** page in **Wholesale** mode, start typing the medicine name in the **Drug** field.

   If the medicine is not available in your inventory, press `Alt + D`.

   The **Quick Add Drug** dialog opens with the searched medicine name already filled in.

2. **Enter medicine details**

   Complete the required medicine information.

   | Field | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | **Name** | Medicine name, prefilled from your search |
   | **Cost Price (₹)** | Purchase cost of the medicine |
   | **Unit Cost (₹)** | Cost per individual unit |
   | **MRP (₹)** | Maximum Retail Price |
   | **HSN Code** | HSN code for the medicine |
   | **Batch Number** | Medicine batch number, optional |
   | **Opening Stock** | Initial stock quantity |
   | **Expiry Date** | Expiry in `MM YY` format |
   | **Units Per Pack** | Number of units in each pack |
   | **Rack Number** | Storage rack or shelf location, optional |
   | **CGST (%)** | Central GST rate |
   | **SGST (%)** | State GST rate |
   | **IGST (%)** | Integrated GST rate |
   | **Dosage Form** | Medicine form, such as Tablet |
   | **Classification** | Medicine category, such as Rx |

   Fields marked with `*` are required.

3. **Save the medicine**

   Review the entered details and click **Save Drug**.

   The medicine is added to your inventory and becomes available for the current wholesale sale without requiring you to leave the billing page.

   Continue entering the remaining sale details as usual.

> **[Note]** The `Alt + D` shortcut lets you add a medicine that is missing from your Drug List while preparing a wholesale bill. You can create its inventory entry and continue billing without navigating to another page.

---

## Price Comparison

Once you select a drug and a customer, a hint appears below the drug table:

> Click on a drug and select a customer to view sale history and price comparison

![MediFlux Wholesale Drug Price Comparison History](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783938260255-28942719-previous-sale.png)
*Caption: View past wholesale transactions and negotiated rates for a specific drug and customer in MediFlux.*

If previous sale data exists for that drug and customer, clicking the hint opens a panel showing past transactions with date, batch, rate, and discount. This helps you maintain consistent pricing and quickly reference past negotiations.

If no previous data exists, the message shows: *[Drug name]: No previous sale data available for this customer*.

---

## Additional Notes

The **Additional Notes** field at the bottom is for entering specific instructions, delivery remarks, or terms of sale relevant to the wholesale transaction.

![MediFlux Additional Notes for Wholesale Pharmacy Sales](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783938260255-347513752-additional-notes.png)
*Caption: Enter delivery remarks, terms of sale, or specific instructions for wholesale pharmacy transactions in MediFlux.*

---

## Bill Summary Bar

At the bottom of the page, a fixed summary bar shows a live breakdown of the bill:

**Sub Total − Disc + Tax = Bill**

When an adjusted return is applied, the summary also shows the return adjustment and remaining net bill.

---

## Saving and Submitting

| Button | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Save Draft** | Saves the bill as a draft so you can resume it later from Drafts |
| **+ Add** | Finalises and saves the sale bill (or challan, if in Challan mode) |
| **Update** | Saves changes when editing an existing sale |

---

## Next Actions

After creating a wholesale bill, here's what most users do next:


  * [View Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - Review and manage all your created wholesale and retail bills.
  * [Check Customer Ledger](/docs/customers/customer-ledger) - Track payments and outstanding dues for this wholesale customer.
  * [Scan & OCR](/docs/sales/scan-and-ocr) - Use barcode scanning or prescription OCR to add drugs faster.
  * [Returned Sales](/docs/sales/returned-sales) - Track returned sales and view their ledger entries.


> **[Info: Switch to Retail]** You can switch to **Retail** mode anytime using the toggle at the top-right for individual customer billing.

docs/sales/drafts.title: Drafts
docs/sales/drafts.description: Access and manage all your saved sale drafts, including bills saved mid-way and prescriptions being scanned.
docs/sales/drafts.body:
# Drafts

The **Drafts** page stores every sale bill that has been saved before being finalised. This includes bills you manually saved mid-way through entering drug details, as well as prescriptions that were uploaded for scanning and are still being processed.

Navigate here from the sidebar: **Sales → Drafts**, or click **Drafts** from the top-right of the Add Sale page.

---

## How Drafts Are Created
A draft is created in two ways:

- **Manually:** while creating a sale, click **Save Draft** at any point to save your progress and come back to it later. This is useful if you need to step away mid-billing or need more time to complete the bill.
- **Prescription upload:** when you upload a prescription in the Add Sale form, MediFlux scans it automatically. While scanning is in progress, the bill is saved as a draft so you can continue other work and return once scanning is complete.

---

## The Drafts Table
| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Draft ID** | Unique identifier for the draft. Shows **Sale Draft** below it |
| **Status** | Current status of the draft: Awaiting, Scanning, Completed, or Failed |
| **Type** | Type of draft: Sale |
| **Source** | How the draft was created, e.g. Sync |
| **Files** | Number of files attached (e.g. uploaded prescription). Shows `—` if none |
| **Date** | Date the draft was saved |
| **Actions** | Delete the draft |

![Drafts page](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/ef97f439-e174-4dfd-b9bd-df156755e043-sales-drafts-overview.png)
*Caption: Drafts table showing a draft entry with status, type, source, and actions.*

---

## Draft Statuses
| Status | What it means |
| --- | --- |
| **Awaiting** | The draft is waiting to be processed or scanned |
| **Scanning** | A prescription has been uploaded and is currently being scanned by MediFlux |
| **Completed** | Scanning is done and the draft is ready to be opened and finalised |
| **Failed** | Scanning failed. The prescription could not be read |

---

## Filter By Status
Use the status tabs at the top to filter drafts:

**All · Awaiting · Scanning · Completed · Failed**

![Status filter tabs](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/9526cfbf-75aa-4b16-89c8-748fc3fb24f2-drafts-filter.png)
*Caption: Filter drafts by All, Awaiting, Scanning, Completed, or Failed.*

---

## Resuming A Draft
Click on any draft row to open it and resume the bill from where you left off. If the prescription scan is completed, the drug details will already be filled in for you.

---

## Deleting A Draft
Click the **three-dot menu (⋮)** on any draft row and select **Delete Draft** to permanently remove it.

![Delete draft](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/da921f18-2e78-4fb9-a00e-9430b9935d29-action-button.png)
*Caption: Three-dot menu showing the Delete Draft option.*

---

## Continue Where You Left Off

  * [Add Retail Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Resume a draft and finalise it into a retail bill.
  * [Add Wholesale Sale](/docs/sales/add-wholesale) - Resume a draft and finalise it into a wholesale bill.
  * [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - View all finalised sales once drafts are completed.
  * [Scan & OCR](/docs/sales/scan-and-ocr) - Troubleshoot failed prescription scans or learn best practices.

docs/sales/overview.title: Sales
docs/sales/overview.description: Manage all your pharmacy sales, credit notes, returns, reorders and drafts, all from one place.
docs/sales/overview.body:
# Sales

The **Sales** section is where every sale your pharmacy makes is recorded and managed. From walk-in cash sales to wholesale billing, challans, and estimates, MediFlux handles every sale type your pharmacy needs, with each sale automatically updating your inventory and customer ledger.

---

## What You Can Do In Sales
- **Record sales:** for individual customers or walk-in patients
- **Handle different sale types:** retail, wholesale, stock issue, challan, and estimates
- **Manage prescription-based sales:** Rx, NRx, H1
- **Issue credit notes:** for billing corrections
- **Track and process returned items**
- **Manage reorders and draft bills**
- **Export your sales list:** as PDF or Excel

---

## Navigating The Sales Section
The **Sales** section in the left sidebar expands into six pages:

| Page | What it's for |
| --- | --- |
| **Sales List** | View, search, and manage all your recorded sales |
| **Add Sale** | Create a new sale bill |
| **Add Credit Note** | Issue a credit note against an existing sale |
| **Returned** | View and manage items returned by customers |
| **Reorders** | Manage reorder requests |
| **Drafts** | Access saved draft bills that haven't been finalised yet |

![Sales sidebar navigation](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783593916573-458990938-sales-sidebar.png)
*Caption: Sidebar showing Sales List, Add Sale, Add Credit Note, Returned, Reorders, and Drafts.*

---

## Quick Actions From Anywhere
You don't have to navigate to the Sales section to add a sale. The **`+` button** in the top-right corner of any screen gives you instant access:

- **Add Sale:** start a new sale bill from anywhere in MediFlux

> **[Note]** The `+` quick-add menu is available on every screen. Use it whenever you need to quickly start a new sale without interrupting your current workflow.

![Dashboard + menu](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783593997149-864673037-sale-quickAdd.png)
*Caption: Quick-add menu showing the Add Sale option.*

---

## Sale Types
MediFlux supports multiple sale types to cover every billing scenario in your pharmacy:

| Sale Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Cash** | Standard retail sale paid in cash |
| **NRx** | Sale of non-prescription medicines |
| **H1** | Sale of Schedule H1 controlled medicines |
| **Wholesale** | Bulk sale to another pharmacy or business |
| **Stock Issue** | Internal stock movement recorded as a sale |
| **Challan** | Delivery challan issued without immediate payment |
| **Estimates** | Estimated bill created before finalising a sale |

---

## Payment Methods
MediFlux supports the following payment methods when recording a sale:

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Cash** | Physical currency payment with automatic change calculation |
| **Card** | Credit or debit card payment via swipe or payment gateway |
| **UPI** | Unified Payments Interface, e.g. Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm |
| **Net Banking** | Direct bank transfer or online banking payment |

> **[Note]** The **Payment Method** field defaults to **None** when creating a new sale. Select one of the above methods before finalising the bill. If the sale is unpaid or pending, you can leave it as **None** and update it later.

![Payment Method dropdown](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783594174831-118923284-payment-methods.png)
*Caption: Select from Cash, Card, UPI, or Net Banking when recording a sale.*

---

## Sales List
The **Sales List** is your complete sales record. View all your recorded sales at a glance with customer details, sale type, amount, and payment status. Search by customer name, bill number, or date. Filter by sale type, payment method, or date range. Click any sale to view full details, print the bill, or issue a credit note.

![Sales List](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783594343008-235351158-salesList-overview.png)
*Caption: Complete sales record with search, filters, and detailed sale information.*

---

## Add Sale
The **Add Sale** page is where you create new sale bills. Select the sale type (retail, wholesale, stock issue, challan, or estimate), add customer details, scan or search for drugs, apply discounts, and choose the payment method. The bill auto-calculates taxes, totals, and change due. Once finalised, inventory is updated automatically and the sale appears in the customer's ledger.

![Add Sale](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783594480190-908824246-addSale-overview.png)
*Caption: Create new sale bills with drug scanning, tax auto-calculation, and multiple payment options.*

---

## Add Credit Note
The **Add Credit Note** page lets you issue credit notes against existing sales for billing corrections, returns, or adjustments. Select the original sale, specify the reason, adjust quantities or amounts, and generate the credit note. This automatically updates the customer's outstanding balance and inventory where applicable.

![Add Credit Note](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783594672384-754899979-AddCreditNote-overview.png)
*Caption: Issue credit notes against existing sales for corrections and adjustments.*

---

## Returned
The **Returned** page tracks all items returned by customers. View return details including original sale reference, returned drugs, quantities, and refund status. Process new returns, verify returned items, and update inventory automatically. Filter by date, customer, or return status to stay on top of all return activity.

![Returned](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783594805278-491206898-retured-overview.png)
*Caption: Track and manage customer returns with automatic inventory updates.*

---

## Reorders
The **Reorders** page helps you manage reorder requests from customers or linked stores. View pending reorders, check drug availability, convert reorders into sales, or send purchase orders to suppliers for out-of-stock items. Track reorder status from request to fulfilment.

![Reorders](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783594924791-173963958-re-order-overview.png)
*Caption: Manage customer reorder requests and convert them into sales or purchase orders.*

---

## Drafts
The **Drafts** page holds all saved but unfinalised sale bills. Access draft estimates, incomplete sales, or bills saved for later. Edit draft details, add or remove drugs, and finalise them into proper sales when ready. Drafts are perfect for creating estimates or handling interrupted billing sessions.

![Drafts](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783595033276-706315416-drafts-overview.png)
*Caption: Access, edit, and finalise saved draft bills.*

---
## Start Selling

  * [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - Review all recorded sales and check payment status.
  * [Add Retail Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Create a bill for a walk-in or regular customer.
  * [Add Wholesale Sale](/docs/sales/add-wholesale) - Issue a bulk sale invoice or delivery challan.
  * [Add Credit Note](/docs/sales/add-credit-note) - Correct a bill or process a return with a credit note.
  * [Returned](/docs/sales/returned-sales) - Handle items returned by customers.
  * [Drafts](/docs/sales/drafts) - Resume or finalise saved draft bills.

docs/sales/re-orders.title: Re-orders
docs/sales/re-orders.description: Manage repeat orders and recurring sales for your regular customers.
docs/sales/re-orders.body:
# Re-orders

The **Re-orders** feature in MediFlux helps you handle repeat purchases from your regular customers quickly and efficiently. Instead of creating a new sale from scratch every time, you can re-order based on previous transactions.

---

## Coming Soon
This section is currently under development and will be updated with full documentation shortly.

Planned features include:

- **Quick re-order from history**: Re-create a sale based on a customer's previous purchase with one click
- **Recurring order setup**: Set up automatic re-orders for patients on long-term medication
- **Re-order reminders**: Get notified when a regular customer is due for their next purchase
- **Bulk re-ordering**: Process multiple re-orders at once for wholesale or institutional customers

---

## Next Steps

  * [Create Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Learn how to create a new sale transaction.
  * [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - View and manage all your sales.

docs/sales/returned-sales.title: Returned
docs/sales/returned-sales.description: View all returned sales and process returns directly from the Sales List.
docs/sales/returned-sales.body:
# Returned

The **Returned** page shows a complete record of every sale that has been returned in your pharmacy. Each entry is linked to the original sale and customer, making it easy to track what was returned, when, and how much was credited.

Navigate here from the sidebar: **Sales → Returned**.

![Returned Sales](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783674201991-896236346-returned-sidebar.png)
*Caption: Navigate to returned sales from sidebar.*

---

## How To Return A Sale
You can initiate a return directly from the **Sales List** without navigating away. Click the **three-dot menu (⋮)** on any sale row and select **Return Sale**.

A confirmation dialog appears showing:

- The customer name and sale number
- Current outstanding balance for this sale
- A warning that **this action cannot be undone**. All drugs in the sale will be returned to inventory

You'll also need to confirm whether a refund was initiated:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Refund Initiated?** | Select **Yes** if you are refunding money to the customer, or **No** if no refund is being given |
| **Refund Amount (₹)** | The amount being refunded to the customer |
| **Receipt Number** | Optional receipt or reference number for this return |

Click **Return Sale** to confirm, or **Cancel** to go back.

Once confirmed, a **"Sale returned successfully!"** message appears and the returned sale is recorded in the Returned page. All drugs from the sale are automatically added back to your inventory.

![Return Sale confirmation dialog](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783674321947-610601324-return-dialog.png)
*Caption: Customer name, sale number, outstanding balance, and refund details.*

![Sale returned successfully](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783674383467-370234699-returned-sale-selected.png)
*Caption: Toast message confirming the return has been processed.*

> **[Note]** Returning a sale cannot be undone. All drugs in the sale are returned to inventory immediately. Make sure the details are correct before confirming.

---

## Viewing Returned Sales
Each return is displayed as a card showing:

| Detail | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Invoice number** | The original sale invoice number |
| **Returned badge** | A purple **Returned** tag confirming this sale has been returned |
| **Customer name** | The customer the original sale was made to |
| **Payment method** | Payment method used in the original sale |
| **Date and time** | When the return was processed |
| **Items count** | Number of items in the return |

The page shows a **Found X** count above the list indicating how many returns are recorded.

---

## Expanding A Return
Click the **chevron (▾)** on the right of any return card to expand it and see the full line item breakdown:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **SR.** | Serial number |
| **HSN** | HSN code of the drug |
| **Product** | Name of the returned drug |
| **Batch** | Batch number |
| **Expiry** | Expiry date of the batch |
| **QTY** | Quantity returned |
| **MRP** | Maximum Retail Price |
| **Discount (%)** | Discount that was applied |
| **Total** | Total value of the returned item |

The **Grand Total** is shown at the bottom right of the expanded row.

> **[IMAGE PENDING]** Expanded return card showing sample line item breakdown with HSN, batch, expiry, MRP, discount, and Grand Total. Source this image or expand this section with the specific data.

---

## Row Action, Print
Clicking the **three-dot menu (⋮)** on any return card gives you one action:

- **Print:** print the return record

---
## Common Follow Ups

  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Verify returned stock was added back to inventory.
  * [Customer Ledger](/docs/customers/customer-ledger) - Check if the refund affected the customer's outstanding balance.
  * [Add Credit Note](/docs/sales/add-credit-note) - Formalize the return with a proper credit note for records.
  * [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - View the original sale and check its return status.

docs/sales/sale-list.title: Sales List
docs/sales/sale-list.description: View, search, filter, and manage all your recorded sales in one place.
docs/sales/sale-list.body:
# Sales List

The **Sales List** is your complete record of every sale made in your pharmacy. You can search across sales, filter by sale type, payment method, payment status, and date range, and export your sales data as PDF or Excel.

---

## Searching Sales

The search bar at the top lets you search across **customers, drugs, and invoice numbers**. Just start typing and the list filters instantly.

To the left of the search bar is an **All** dropdown. Use it to narrow the search scope if needed.

![Sales list](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/0c085041-1c62-4efc-ad14-2f2a3a132a26-sidebar-saleslist.png)
*Caption: Navigate to Sales List from the sidebar.*

---

## Filter Chips

Below the search bar, eight quick-filter chips let you filter the sales list by sale type or category.

| Filter | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **NRx** | Non-prescription medicine sales |
| **H1** | Schedule H1 controlled medicine sales |
| **Cash** | Cash sales |
| **Wholesale** | Wholesale sales to pharmacies or businesses |
| **Retail** | Retail sales made to individual customers |
| **Stock Issue** | Internal stock movement recorded as a sale |
| **Challan** | Delivery challans |
| **Estimates** | Estimated bills not yet finalised |

Click a chip to apply it, and click again to remove it.

![Filter chips](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/789b8f72-0824-4177-afd3-706372f1bdbe-sales-filterchips.png)
*Caption: Quick-filter chips for NRx, H1, Cash, Wholesale, Retail, Stock Issue, Challan, and Estimates.*

---

## The Sales Table

The main table lists all your sales with the following columns:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Sale Details** | Invoice number and payment method used for the sale |
| **Customer** | Customer name and date/time of the sale |
| **Items** | Total value of the sale and number of items |
| **Actions** | Quick action menu for that sale row |

The page shows a **Found X** count above the table indicating how many sales match the current filters.

![Sales List table](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/67ee03da-9787-4e8a-93ce-c8320a4c349a-sale-columns.png)
*Caption: Main table listing all sales with details, customer, items, and actions.*

---

## Expanding A Sale Row

Click the **chevron (▾)** on the left of any sale row to expand it and see the full line item breakdown:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **SR.** | Serial number of the line item |
| **HSN** | HSN code of the drug |
| **Product** | Name of the drug |
| **Batch** | Batch number |
| **Expiry** | Expiry date of the batch |
| **QTY** | Quantity sold |
| **MRP** | Maximum Retail Price |
| **DIS** | Discount percentage applied |
| **Total** | Total amount for that line item |

The **Grand Total** is shown at the bottom right of the expanded row.

![Expanded sale row](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/d179244c-50cb-410b-ba5a-4535d5307c20-sale-dropdown.png)
*Caption: Line item breakdown with HSN, product, batch, expiry, quantity, MRP, discount, and total.*

---

## Row Actions

Clicking the **three-dot menu (⋮)** on any sale row opens a quick-actions menu with three options:

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **View Invoice** | Opens the full invoice for this sale |
| **Update** | Edit this sale entry |
| **Return Sale** | Initiate a return for this sale |

These options are the same for all sale types.

![Row actions](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/1665ff16-0590-40ac-a3a1-a2c911c8a799-sale-actions.png)
*Caption: Three-dot menu showing View Invoice, Update, and Return Sale options.*

---

## Filters Panel

Click the **Filter** button at the top-right to open the **Sales Filters** panel:

| Filter | Options |
| --- | --- |
| **Drug Type** | All, Rx, NRx, H1 |
| **Payment Method** | All Methods, Cash, Card, UPI, Bank Transfer, Cheque, Stock Issue |
| **Payment Status** | All Statuses, Paid, Unpaid, Partial |
| **Sale Type** | Wholesale sales only, Stock Issue |
| **Date Range** | Custom From and To date |
| **Amount Range** | Min (₹) and Max (₹) |
| **Sort By** | Field: Sale Date, Total Amount, Customer Name, Invoice Number, Created At. Order: Ascending or Descending |

Click **Apply** to apply filters. The filter button highlights when active filters are applied.

![Filter Button](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/660c7583-6a73-4ff1-a37d-72413d53d911-filter-panel.png)
*Caption: Filter by drug type, payment method, payment status, sale type, date, amount, and sort order.*

---

## Exporting Sales

Click the **export icon** at the top-right to choose your export format:

- **Export as PDF**
- **Export as Excel**

![Export options](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783667031316-551076294-sales-export-options.png)
*Caption: Choose between PDF and Excel export formats.*

---

## Adding A Sale From Anywhere

You don't have to navigate to the Sales section to add a sale. Click the **`+` button** in the top-right corner of any screen and select **Add Sale** to start a new sale bill from anywhere in MediFlux.

![Quick Add Sale](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783667143930-70609404-addsale-quickbutton.png)
*Caption: Click the + button in the top-right corner and select Add Sale.*

---

## Act On A Sale


  * [Add Retail Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Create a new bill for a customer.
  * [Add Credit Note](/docs/sales/add-credit-note) - Issue a credit note against an existing sale.
  * [Returned](/docs/sales/returned-sales) - Process items returned by customers.
  * [Customer Ledger](/docs/customers/customer-ledger) - Check outstanding payments for customers with unpaid sales.

docs/sales/scan-and-ocr.title: Scan & Image OCR
docs/sales/scan-and-ocr.description: Use your device camera to scan barcodes or capture drug labels, adding drugs to your bill instantly without manual entry.
docs/sales/scan-and-ocr.body:
# Scan & Image OCR

The **Scan & Add Drugs** panel lets you add drugs to a bill using your phone or tablet's camera, instead of searching and selecting them manually. It's available from the **Scan** button on the **Add Sale** page, and is designed specifically for use on phones and tablets.

---

## Opening The Panel
Click **Scan** at the top-right of the Add Sale page to open the **Scan & Add Drugs** panel. It offers two modes, switchable via the tabs at the top:

| Mode | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Barcode Scanner** | Scan a drug's barcode using your camera to instantly add it to the bill |
| **Image (OCR)** | Photograph a drug label or batch details: MediFlux reads the text and adds the matching drug automatically |

Camera permissions are required for both modes on phone and tablet.

![Scan & Add Drugs Panel](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/09/4ae4ab31-84cf-4e67-864e-54bf97b84fc3-scan-option.png)
*Caption: Barcode Scanner and Image (OCR) tabs at the top of the panel.*

---

## Barcode Scanner
In **Barcode Scanner** mode, point your camera at a drug's barcode and align it within the on-screen frame, guided by the prompt **"Align barcode within the frame."** A torch/flash icon in the top-right corner lets you toggle your camera's flash for scanning in low light.

![Barcode Scanner](/images/scan-bar-code)
*Caption: Align the barcode within the frame and use the torch icon for low-light scanning.*

---

## Image (OCR)
In **Image (OCR)** mode, position the drug's name or batch number within the frame, guided by the prompt **"Position drug name / batch number inside the frame."** Tap the **capture button** to take the photo, MediFlux then reads the text and matches it to a drug in your inventory.

![Image (OCR)](/images/scan-ocr-mode.png)
*Caption: Position the drug name or batch number inside the frame, then tap the capture button.*

---

## Using A Physical Barcode Scanner
If you have a physical barcode scanner device connected to your computer, you don't need to open the Scan & Add Drugs panel at all, you can scan barcodes directly into the bill. The drug is added instantly, with its name, batch, expiry, MRP, and available stock auto-populated.

---

## Speed Up Your Billing
Scanning makes billing faster. Here's where it fits in your workflow.


  * [Add Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Use Scan & Add Drugs while creating a sale bill.
  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Verify scanned drugs are correctly matched in your inventory.
  * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Record stock coming in, uses a separate bill-upload scan feature.
  * [Settings](/docs/settings/account-info) - Configure your store details that appear on every scanned bill.

docs/settings/account-info.title: Account
docs/settings/account-info.description: View and update your store's business details, contact information, bank details, sales settings, and store assets like logo, signature, and stamp.
docs/settings/account-info.body:
# Account

The **Account** tab holds your store's core business information, used across invoices, bills, and other documents generated by MediFlux. This is also where you manage your sales settings, store logo, signature, and stamp.

---

## Account Info

At the top, you'll see your store's name, plan status (e.g., **Pro Active**, with expiry date), and:

| Section | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| **Contact** | Phone, Email |
| **Location** | Address |
| **Bank Details** | Bank, Account Name, Account Number, IFSC |

Click **Edit** to open the **Edit Store Details** form.

![Account Info](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/a3e8ab17-7867-4320-a411-909349f2cd8c-acc-info-1.png)
*Caption: Store name, plan status, contact details, location, and bank details at a glance.*

---

## Editing Store Details

The **Edit Store Details** form contains Store Information, Address, Bank Details, and Sales Settings.

![Edit Store Details](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/a1929b18-1504-49f5-b30b-af3529ffade3-acc-info-2.png)
*Caption: Update your store's business information, address, and bank details.*

### Store Information

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Store Name** | Your pharmacy's registered name |
| **Owner Name** | Name of the store owner |
| **Phone** | Contact number, with a separate **Edit** option |
| **Email** | Contact email, with a separate **Edit** option |

### Address

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Address Line 1** | Street address |
| **Locality** | Locality or area |
| **State** | State |
| **Pincode** | Postal code |

### Bank Details

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Bank Name** | Name of the bank |
| **Branch Name** | Branch name |
| **IFSC** | Bank's IFSC code |
| **Account Number** | Bank account number |
| **Account Name** | Name on the account |
| **UPI ID** | UPI ID used for payments |

![Edit Store Details Form](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/648085bf-d0ea-4955-8743-6d76a41ed633-acc-info-3.png)
*Caption: Update your store information, address, and bank details.*

> **[Note]** Phone and Email have their own **Edit** option within the form, separate from the rest of the store details, since changing these may require additional verification.

---

## Sales Settings

The **Sales Settings** section is available at the bottom of the **Edit Store Details** form. It allows you to display profit margins during billing and receive warnings when medicines are sold at a loss.

### Available Settings

| Setting | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Show Sales Margin** | Displays a real-time profit margin column in Retail and Wholesale billing tables |
| **Warn on Negative Margin (Loss Warning)** | Shows a warning popup before saving a sale if a medicine's selling price is lower than its cost |

### Configuring Sales Settings

1. **Open Account Settings**

   Navigate to **Settings → Account**.

2. **Edit Store Details**

   Click **Edit** in the Account Info section.

3. **Find Sales Settings**

   Scroll down to the **Sales Settings** section.

4. **Choose Your Settings**

   Enable **Show Sales Margin**, **Warn on Negative Margin (Loss Warning)**, or both, depending on your requirements.

5. **Save Changes**

   Click **Save** to apply your settings.

![Sales Settings in Edit Store Details](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/e1a57c35-3f4f-45b0-ae8e-287f5fea3e54-show-sales-margin-accounts.png)
*Caption: Enable Show Sales Margin to display profit margins during billing, and Warn on Negative Margin to receive a warning before saving a loss-making sale.*

### Show Sales Margin in Add Sale

Once **Show Sales Margin** is enabled, a **MARGIN** column appears in the medicine table on the **Add Sale** page for both Retail and Wholesale billing.

This column displays the calculated profit margin for each medicine, allowing you to view profitability while preparing a sale.

![Sales Margin in Add Sale](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/96e6727c-aacd-4fea-a606-5e3e58daed06-add-sale-with-margin.png)
*Caption: The MARGIN column appears in the Add Sale medicine table when Show Sales Margin is enabled in Account Settings.*

### Warn on Negative Margin

When **Warn on Negative Margin (Loss Warning)** is enabled, MediFlux displays a warning popup if any medicine is being sold below its cost price.

The warning appears before saving the sale, helping you identify a potential loss.

> **[Note]** Both settings work independently. You can display profit margins without enabling loss warnings, enable loss warnings without displaying margins, or use both together.

---

## Store Assets

Below Account Info, three collapsible sections let you manage documents used on your invoices and bills:

| Asset | What it's for |
| --- | --- |
| **Logo** | Your store's logo, shown on invoices and bills |
| **Signature** | A signature image, used on documents that require sign-off |
| **Stamp** | Your store's official stamp, used on documents that require it |

Click on any asset to expand it and view the current file. Click the asset again to open the **Change Asset** dialog, where you can drag and drop a file or browse to upload a new one (up to 2MB).

![Store Assets](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/eae80bc4-627e-4fed-b7d8-176569aa70a9-acc-info-4.png)
*Caption: Logo, Signature, and Stamp sections with upload and change options.*

---

## FAQs


  ### How do I show profit margins while creating a sale?

Go to **Settings → Account → Edit**, scroll to **Sales Settings**, enable **Show Sales Margin**, and click **Save**.

    A **MARGIN** column will appear in the medicine table when creating Retail and Wholesale sales.

  ### Can MediFlux warn me if I sell a medicine at a loss?

Yes. Enable **Warn on Negative Margin (Loss Warning)** under **Sales Settings**. MediFlux will display a warning popup before saving a sale if a medicine's selling price is lower than its cost.

  ### Can I enable loss warnings without showing sales margins?

Yes. **Show Sales Margin** and **Warn on Negative Margin (Loss Warning)** are separate settings and can be enabled independently.

  ### Is there a file size limit for Logo, Signature, or Stamp uploads?

Yes, uploads are limited to 2MB per file.

  ### Can I change my store's phone number or email directly from the Edit form?

Yes, both fields have a separate **Edit** option next to them within the Edit Store Details form.


---

## What's Next

Your store details are set. Here's where to go from here.


  * [Bill Templates](/docs/settings/bill-templates) - Customize how your invoices look with the logo, signature, and stamp you just uploaded.
  * [Invoice Counter](/docs/settings/invoice-counter) - Configure invoice numbering before you start billing.
  * [User Management](/docs/settings/user-management) - Add staff accounts and set their access levels.
  * [Add Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Start billing with your newly configured store details and sales settings.

docs/settings/accounting-settings.title: Accounting Settings
docs/settings/accounting-settings.description: Manage your accounting module's financial year status, including temporary locking.
docs/settings/accounting-settings.body:
# Accounting Settings

The **Accounting Settings** tab lets you control the status of your current financial year, whether it's open for edits or temporarily locked to prevent further changes.

---

## Financial Year Settings
This section shows your **Current Status**:

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **Open** | The financial year is currently active, and accounting entries can be edited freely |

### Important Precautions
- You can still edit accounting entries while the year is open
- Locking will prevent any further changes
- Closing will permanently finalize the year

![Financial Year Settings](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/a1acad5e-d069-49d1-bff6-f2a7884b44bc-accounting-1.png)
*Caption: View and manage your current financial year status.*

> **[Note]** Permanently closing a financial year is managed separately within the **Accounting** module, not here. This tab only covers temporary locking.

---

## Temporarily Locking The Financial Year
1. **Open the confirmation dialog**

   Click **Temporary Lock Financial Year** to open a confirmation dialog.

2. **Review the details**

   > **Temporarily Lock Financial Year**
       > Temporary locking prevents further edits but allows manual entries. This can be unlocked by an administrator.

       **Temporary locking will:**
       - Prevent editing existing entries
       - Allow manual entries only
       - Still allow permanent locking or closing

3. **Confirm or cancel**

   Click **Temporary Lock Year** to confirm, or **Cancel** to back out.

![Temporarily Lock Financial Year dialog](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/dfbe7b59-9a57-4b32-a4a9-1fd5c3a16140-accounting-2.png)
*Caption: Confirm temporary lock to restrict editing on existing entries.*

> **[Note]** Temporary locking can be reversed by an administrator, unlike permanently closing a financial year, which is final.

---

## FAQs

  ### What's the difference between temporarily locking and permanently closing a financial year?

Temporary locking prevents edits to existing entries but still allows manual entries, and can be undone by an administrator. Permanently closing the year finalizes it completely and is managed within the Accounting module.
  ### Can I still make entries after temporarily locking the financial year?

Yes, manual entries are still allowed, but existing entries can no longer be edited.
  ### Who can unlock a temporarily locked financial year?

An administrator can unlock it.


---

## Manage Your Books
Your financial year is configured. Dive into day-to-day accounting or review your ledgers.


  * [Accounting Module](/docs/settings/accounting-settings) - Access journal entries, ledgers, and financial reports for your store.
  * [Customer Ledger](/docs/customers/customer-ledger) - Track outstanding payments and customer credit history.
  * [Supplier Ledger](/docs/supplier/supplier-ledger) - Monitor what you owe suppliers and manage payment schedules.
  * [Reports](/docs/reports) - Generate GST reports, profit summaries, and other financial statements.

docs/settings/bill-templates.title: Bill Templates
docs/settings/bill-templates.description: Customize your invoice template, theme color, columns, tax display, and terms and conditions.
docs/settings/bill-templates.body:
# Bill Templates

The **Bill Templates** tab controls how your invoices look, the layout, which columns appear, tax display format, theme color, and the terms and conditions printed at the bottom. Changes here apply automatically to all future invoices.

---

## Select Template
Choose from four invoice layouts:

| Template | Style |
| --- | --- |
| **Classic Professional** | Clean and professional design with clear sections |
| **Modern Minimalist** | Clean lines with emphasis on whitespace |
| **Bold & Colorful** | Eye-catching design with a colored header |
| **Compact Professional** | Space-efficient design for detailed invoices |

![Select Template](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/68ad9ebc-f7de-4fef-a49b-80cab45cc94a-bill-template-1.png)
*Caption: Choose from four invoice layouts: Classic Professional, Modern Minimalist, Bold & Colorful, or Compact Professional.*

---

## Invoice Columns
Choose which columns appear on your invoice, up to a maximum of **13 columns**. Some fields are mandatory and locked, shown as **Required**; the rest can be toggled on or off:

| Column | Required? |
| --- | --- |
| **Sr** | Optional |
| **Item** | Required |
| **Batch** | Optional |
| **Exp** | Optional |
| **Qty** | Required |
| **Units** | Optional |
| **MRP** | Required |
| **Dis** | Required |
| **cgst** | Optional |
| **sgst** | Optional |
| **igst** | Optional |
| **Subtotal** | Optional |
| **Tax** | Optional |
| **Total** | Required |

### Tax Display Mode
Choose how tax is shown on your invoice:

| Mode | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Percentage (%)** | Shows tax as a percentage |
| **Value (₹)** | Shows tax as a fixed amount |

![Invoice Columns](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/0a0293e7-27f3-4627-be7e-c77daf245c9f-bill-template-2.png)
*Caption: Toggle columns on or off, with mandatory fields locked as Required.*

---

## Terms & Conditions
Add up to 3 terms and conditions to be displayed at the bottom of your invoices, for example, payment terms or return policies.

![Terms & Conditions](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/3bb812bb-5e3e-45c6-9e4a-12d7f11c308d-bill-template-3.png)
*Caption: Add up to 3 custom terms to appear at the bottom of every invoice.*

---

## Colors
Choose a theme color for your invoice from a preset palette, or enter a custom hex code directly.

![Colors](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/c2164194-bbcd-45e7-96ab-08c1fbaa0db6-bill-template-4.png)
*Caption: Pick a preset theme color or enter a custom hex code.*

---

## Preview
The **Preview** panel on the right shows a live preview of your invoice as you make changes. Toggle **Preview as** between **Retail Sale** and **Wholesale** to see how the template looks for each. Click **Show Full Preview** to see the complete invoice layout.

![Preview Panel](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/d434f427-03ea-4977-abeb-ec3913dd73bb-bill-template-5.png)
*Caption: Live preview of your invoice with Retail Sale and Wholesale toggle.*

![Full Invoice Preview](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/f10e4c51-6b5f-46ae-b892-6109695fa0fd-bill-template-6.png)
*Caption: Complete invoice layout before saving.*

---

## Saving Your Template
Click **Save Settings** to apply your changes.

> **[Note]** Changes apply to all future invoices automatically. Settings are saved to your store profile, and only admins can update invoice settings.

---

## FAQs

  ### Will changing my Bill Template affect invoices I've already generated?

No, changes only apply to future invoices. Past invoices keep the layout and settings they were created with.
  ### Can I preview how my invoice looks before saving?

Yes, use the **Preview** panel or click **Show Full Preview** to see the complete invoice layout before saving.
  ### Is there a limit to how many columns I can show on an invoice?

Yes, a maximum of 13 columns can be shown, and some fields are mandatory and cannot be turned off.


---

## Common Mistakes To Avoid
- Removing too many optional columns: while allowed, leaving out useful fields like Batch or Expiry can make your invoices harder to reference later
- Forgetting to click **Save Settings**: changes aren't applied until saved
- Not checking the full preview before saving: always use **Show Full Preview** to confirm your invoice looks correct for both Retail Sale and Wholesale

---

## See It In Action
Your invoice layout is ready. Create a bill and preview how it looks with real data.


  * [Add Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Create a retail or wholesale sale and see your customized invoice template live.
  * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Record a purchase and check how your template handles supplier invoices.
  * [Invoice Counter](/docs/settings/invoice-counter) - Review or adjust your invoice numbering format to match your new template style.
  * [Account](/docs/settings/account-info) - Make sure your store logo, signature, and stamp are uploaded, they appear on every invoice.

docs/settings/data-management.title: Data Management
docs/settings/data-management.description: Permanently delete all transactional data from your store to start fresh.
docs/settings/data-management.body:
# Data Management

The **Data Management** tab gives you a single, irreversible action: permanently deleting all transactional data from your store. This is meant for stores that want a completely fresh start, or that have finished a testing phase and want to clear out test data before going live.

> **[Note]** This is a destructive, permanent action. Read this page carefully before using it.

---

## Danger Zone
Clearing your data performs a **permanent deletion** of all transactional records.

### What Will Be Deleted
|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| All Sales & Invoices | All Purchase Records |
| Inventory & Stock History | Customer & Supplier Ledgers |
| AI Assistant Conversations | Prescription History |
| Order Management Data | Financial Reports |

### What Is NOT Deleted
Your **login credentials** and **store settings** are not affected, only transactional data is deleted.

![Danger Zone](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/117826cd-1755-46db-9287-d46a51d80f35-data-management-1.png)
*Caption: Overview of what will be deleted and what remains untouched.*
---
![What Will Be Deleted](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/d16ae230-77cb-46b8-8368-3b69a7f897a9-data-management-2.png)
*Caption: Complete list of transactional data types that will be permanently removed.*

---

## Deleting All Data
Click **Delete All Data** to begin. A confirmation dialog asks you to type the phrase **delete my data** exactly to proceed.

> To confirm you want to delete all data, including all inventory, sales, purchases, customers, suppliers, and ledgers, type the following phrase:
> **delete my data**

Once typed correctly, click **Delete Data** to confirm.

![Delete All Data Confirmation](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/89e47349-f568-4c69-a525-41055537f814-data-management-3.png)
*Caption: Type 'delete my data' to confirm permanent deletion of all transactional records.*

> **[Note]** This action is irreversible and cannot be undone. Once confirmed, all your transactional records are permanently deleted, there is no way to recover them afterward.

---

## FAQs

  ### Will deleting all data affect my login or store settings?

No, only transactional data is deleted. Your login credentials, store profile, and settings configured elsewhere remain untouched.
  ### Can I undo Delete All Data after confirming it?

No, this action is permanent and cannot be reversed once confirmed.
  ### Why would I use this feature?

It's designed for stores that have been using MediFlux for testing and want to clear out test data before going live, or for stores that want to start completely fresh.


---

## Start Fresh
Your data is cleared. Rebuild your pharmacy records from the ground up.


  * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Restock your inventory first, you'll need drugs before you can sell.
  * [Add a Supplier](/docs/supplier/add-supplier) - Add your suppliers back so you can record purchases against them.
  * [Add a Customer](/docs/customers/add-customer) - Rebuild your customer base before creating sales.
  * [Add Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Start billing once your inventory and customers are back in place.

docs/settings/integrations.title: Integrations
docs/settings/integrations.description: Manage external connections and automated workflows, including WhatsApp reports and AI-powered features.
docs/settings/integrations.body:
# Integrations

The **Integrations** tab lets you connect MediFlux with external services and automate certain workflows, like sending reports and invoices over WhatsApp, or enabling AI-powered features using your own API key.

---

## WhatsApp Automations
| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Daily WhatsApp Reports** | Sends automated daily business reports and summaries via WhatsApp |
| **Auto Sale Invoice Sending** | Automatically sends sale invoices to customers via WhatsApp when a sale is created |
| **Auto Payment Message Sending** | Automatically sends payment messages to customers via WhatsApp when a payment is received |

Each option can be toggled on or off independently.

![WhatsApp Automations](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/4006aacc-435b-46f0-8b01-55e2cf19dcf7-integration-1.png)
*Caption: Toggle Daily WhatsApp Reports, Auto Sale Invoice Sending, and Auto Payment Message Sending on or off.*

---

## Gemini API Key
To enable AI-powered features in MediFlux, add your own **Gemini API key**. You can get one from **Google AI Studio**.

Enter your key in the field provided, then click **Save**. Use the eye icon to show or hide the key as you type.

![Gemini API Key](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/f8d5dfe3-6b84-4c70-b60f-190f178fb64f-intregration-2.png)
*Caption: Enter your Gemini API key from Google AI Studio to enable AI-powered features.*

> **[Note]** The Gemini API key powers MediFlux's AI-driven features. You'll need your own key from Google AI Studio to use these features.

---

## FAQs

  ### Do I need a Gemini API key to use MediFlux?

No, it's only needed if you want to use AI-powered features. Core MediFlux functionality works without one.
  ### Will customers be notified automatically if I enable Auto Sale Invoice Sending?

Yes, once enabled, sale invoices are sent to customers via WhatsApp automatically whenever a sale is created.


---

## Automate Your Workflow
Your integrations are configured. Let them run while you focus on the business.


  * [Add Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Create a sale and watch your invoice send automatically via WhatsApp.
  * [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - Review sent invoices and track which customers received them.
  * [Notifications](/docs/settings/notifications) - Fine-tune what your team gets notified about alongside WhatsApp automations.
  * [Account](/docs/settings/account-info) - Make sure your store's WhatsApp number and contact details are up to date.

docs/settings/invoice-counter.title: Invoice Counter
docs/settings/invoice-counter.description: Configure invoice numbering format, counters, and auto-reset behavior for sales and purchases.
docs/settings/invoice-counter.body:
# Invoice Counter

The **Invoice Counter** tab controls how invoice numbers are generated across MediFlux, the prefix, numbering format, date components, and whether the counter resets periodically. Sales and Purchases have their own independent settings, so you can configure each separately.

![Invoice Counter](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/ca7e27fa-b017-4ad0-9fb4-bdda7f51719a-invoice-counter-1.png)
*Caption: Configure invoice numbering format, counters, and auto-reset behavior for sales and purchases.*

---

## Sale Settings And Purchase Settings
At the top of the page, two tabs let you configure invoice numbering separately for **Sale Settings** and **Purchase Settings**. Both have the same fields, but changes to one don't affect the other.

![Sale Settings and Purchase Settings](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/92988f8b-1da2-498d-ad45-500b1848bcc7-invoice-counter-2.png)
*Caption: Toggle between Sale Settings and Purchase Settings tabs to configure each independently.*

---

## Basic Settings
| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Prefix** | Optional starting text for invoice numbers (e.g., INV, PUR, SAL) |
| **Counter Start** | The number the counter begins at. Cannot be changed once invoices have been generated |
| **Current Counter** | The current counter value, updated automatically as invoices are created (read-only) |
| **Counter Padding** | Number of digits used in the counter, from 1–10 (e.g., padding of 5 shows as 00001) |

---

## Date Settings
| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Include Date in Invoice Number** | Adds a date component to your invoice numbering |
| **Date Format** | DDMMYYYY, MMYYYY, YYYY, or None |
| **Separator** | Character used to separate parts of the invoice number (e.g., -, /, _) |

![Date Format Dropdown](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/f8bd771b-d341-451b-9a9d-4a6826ecb328-invoice-counter-3.png)
*Caption: Choose from DDMMYYYY, MMYYYY, YYYY, or None for your invoice numbering.*

---

## Auto-Reset Counter
| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Enable Auto-Reset** | Automatically resets the counter back to its start value on a schedule |
| **Reset Period** | Daily, Monthly, Yearly, or Never |

![Reset Period Dropdown](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/fe9d8bf8-eb38-424f-bfa0-252c04ad4e8e-invoice-counter-4.png)
*Caption: Set the counter to reset Daily, Monthly, Yearly, or Never.*

> **[Note]** Auto-reset is useful if you want your invoice numbers to restart each year or month (e.g., starting fresh at 001 every January), rather than counting up indefinitely.

---

## Live Preview And Configuration Summary
As you adjust these settings, a **Live Preview** on the right shows what your next invoice number will look like. Below it, a **Configuration Summary** shows your current **Format**, **Next Invoice** number, and **Auto-Reset** status at a glance.

Click **Save Settings** to apply your changes. The button shows how many fields have been modified, and displays **No Changes** when nothing's been edited.

![Live Preview and Configuration Summary](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/e9217b41-636b-4e39-8b84-fac1ecc497fd-invoice-counter-5.png)
*Caption: See your next invoice number and current configuration at a glance.*

---

## FAQs

  ### Can I change the Counter Start after invoices have already been generated?

No, Counter Start becomes read-only once invoices exist, to prevent numbering conflicts with invoices already issued.
  ### Do Sales and Purchases share the same invoice counter?

No, each has its own independent settings under the Sale Settings and Purchase Settings tabs.
  ### What happens if I enable Auto-Reset with a Yearly period?

Your counter will automatically reset back to the Counter Start value at the beginning of each year.


---
## What'S Next
Your invoice numbering is configured. Start creating bills with your new format.


  * [Add Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Create a sale and see your configured invoice number in action.
  * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Record a purchase with your purchase invoice numbering format.
  * [Bill Templates](/docs/settings/bill-templates) - Customize how your invoices look alongside the numbering.
  * [Account](/docs/settings/account-info) - Review your store details that appear on every invoice.

docs/settings/modules.title: Modules
docs/settings/modules.description: Enable or disable optional MediFlux modules and manage subscriptions for additional features like Warehouse Management.
docs/settings/modules.body:
# Modules

The **Modules** tab lets you manage optional features for your store. You can enable or disable modules based on your pharmacy's requirements.

Some modules can be enabled directly, while others, such as the **Warehouse Module**, require an active subscription.

---

## Available Modules

| Module | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Clinic Module** | Enables medical features like patient records and prescriptions |
| **Warehouse Module** | Enables inventory tracking and management across multiple warehouses. Requires a subscription |
| **Accounting Module** | Enables accounting features like journal entries, ledgers, and reports |
| **Estimate Bills** | Enables the estimate bill feature for creating quotations and estimates |

Each module displays its current status, **Enabled** or **Disabled**, along with an option to manage it.

![Modules Page](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/73ceb65e-70e6-4b08-865a-e4ff95cfda9a-modules-page.png)
*Caption: Available MediFlux modules, including Clinic, Warehouse, Accounting, and Estimate Bills, with their current status and enable or disable options.*

---

## Enabling or Disabling a Module

For modules that do not require a subscription, you can enable or disable them directly.

1. **Open Modules**

   Go to **Settings → Modules**.

   You will see the available modules and their current status.

2. **Select a module**

   Find the module you want to enable or disable.

   Click **Enable** or **Disable** beside it.

3. **Confirm the change**

   A confirmation prompt appears before the change is applied.

   Click **Confirm** to proceed or **Cancel** to go back.

   ![Module Confirmation](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/f7242746-cf3b-4906-9e5c-e31b202b64f1-module2.png)
*Caption: Confirm whether you want to enable or disable the selected module.*

> **[Note]** Disabling a module hides its related features across MediFlux but does not delete existing data associated with it.
>
> For example, disabling the **Clinic Module** hides the Clinic section from the sidebar, but existing doctor and appointment records remain available when the module is enabled again.

---

## Warehouse Module

The **Warehouse Module** allows you to manage inventory across multiple warehouses instead of maintaining all stock in a single location.

With this module, you can:

- Track stock separately across warehouses.
- Transfer stock between warehouse locations.
- View stock movements and audit logs.
- Monitor inventory quantities across different locations.

Unlike the other modules, the **Warehouse Module requires a subscription** before you can use its features.

> **[Note]** The **Main Store** is available by default. You only need the Warehouse Module subscription if you want to manage stock in additional warehouses.

### How to Subscribe to the Warehouse Module

1. **Open the Warehouse Module**

   Go to **Settings → Modules**.

   Find **Warehouse Module** in the list.

   If it is not enabled, its status appears as **Disabled**.

   Click the module or the arrow beside it to open its details.

2. **View subscription plans**

   The **Warehouse Module** details page displays the module's activation status and available subscription plans.

   Under **Module Subscriptions**, you will find the **Warehouse Subscription Plans** section.

   ![Warehouse Module Subscription Plans](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/122844d3-e142-4ec5-bc21-2f7c5a86d5ca-module-subscription.png)
*Caption: Warehouse Module details showing its inactive status and available subscription plans.*

3. **Choose a subscription plan**

   Select the plan that suits your requirements.

   The available plans shown are:

   | Plan | Price | Duration |
   | --- | --- | --- |
   | **Annual Plan** | `₹500` | `365` days |
   | **Two-Year Plan** | `₹849` | `730` days |

   Both plans include:

   - **Dedicated Warehouse Storage**
   - **Stock Transfers & Audit Logs**
   - **Real-time Inventory Tracking**

   Click **Subscribe Now** on your preferred plan to proceed with the subscription.

4. **Enable the Warehouse Module**

   After completing the subscription, return to the **Warehouse Module** details page.

   Click **Enable Module** to activate the module.

   Once enabled, you can start using the warehouse features available in MediFlux.

> **[Note]** A subscription is required to use the **Warehouse Module**. Simply clicking **Enable** does not replace the subscription requirement.
>
> The subscription prices shown here are based on the available plans displayed in MediFlux and may change.

---

## FAQs



  ### What happens to my data if I disable a module?

Your existing data is not deleted. Disabling a module hides its related features until you enable it again.

  ### Is the Clinic Module required to use MediFlux?

No. The Clinic Module is optional. If your pharmacy does not manage a clinic, you can leave it disabled.

  ### Does the Warehouse Module require a subscription?

Yes. Unlike the other modules, the Warehouse Module requires a subscription to access its features.

  ### Do I need the Warehouse Module to manage stock in my Main Store?

No. Your Main Store is available by default. The Warehouse Module is intended for pharmacies that need to manage inventory across additional warehouses.

  ### What features are included in the Warehouse subscription?

The subscription includes dedicated warehouse storage, stock transfers and audit logs, and real-time inventory tracking.

  ### Can I enable the Warehouse Module without subscribing?

The Warehouse Module requires an active subscription to use its warehouse features. You can view the available plans under Settings → Modules.



---

## What's Next

After enabling the modules your pharmacy needs, you can start using their related features.


  * [Doctors](/docs/clinics/doctors) - Set up your clinic's doctor directory after enabling the Clinic Module.
  * [Accounting Settings](/docs/settings/account-info) - Configure your accounting preferences after enabling the Accounting Module.
  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - View and manage inventory, including warehouse stock when the Warehouse Module is enabled.
  * [Add Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Create an estimate bill after enabling the Estimate Bills module.

docs/settings/notifications.title: Notifications
docs/settings/notifications.description: Manage how you receive notifications from MediFlux.
docs/settings/notifications.body:
# Notifications

The **Notifications** tab controls how you receive alerts from MediFlux, such as updates on stock, orders, and other store activity.

---

## Push Notifications
Toggle **Push Notifications** on or off to control whether you receive browser or device notifications from MediFlux.

The page shows your **Current Status**:

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **Active** | Notifications are enabled and working |
| **Inactive** | Notifications are not enabled |

![Push Notifications, Inactive](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/046454f1-5f2e-4bf2-89ea-561b6e2e07b0-notification-2.png)
*Caption: Push notifications are currently turned off.*

![Push Notifications, Active](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/c0b36c67-7675-4d0d-b097-97d35c0abd8e-notification.png)
*Caption: Push notifications are enabled and working.*

---

## FAQs

  ### Why would I turn Push Notifications off?

If you don't want browser or device alerts from MediFlux and prefer to check updates manually within the app, you can turn this off.


---

## Start Billing
Your invoice numbering is configured. Here's where to go from here.


  * [Add Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Create a sale and see your configured invoice number in action.
  * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Record a purchase with your purchase invoice numbering format.
  * [Bill Templates](/docs/settings/bill-templates) - Customize how your invoices look alongside the numbering.
  * [Account](/docs/settings/account-info) - Review your store details that appear on every invoice.

docs/settings/overview.title: Settings
docs/settings/overview.description: Manage your store's account details, modules, billing preferences, notifications, integrations, users, and subscriptions, all from one place.
docs/settings/overview.body:
# Settings

The **Settings** section is where you configure how MediFlux works for your pharmacy, from your store's business details and bank information to invoice numbering, notifications, integrations, and who on your team has access. It's not part of the main sidebar; instead, you'll find it under your **profile icon** in the top-right corner of any screen.

---

## Accessing Settings
Click the **profile icon** in the top-right corner to open a dropdown with:

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Profile** | Your personal user profile |
| **Settings** | Opens the Settings section |
| **Changelog** | Recent product updates |
| **Logout** | Signs you out of MediFlux |

Click **Settings** to get started.

![Profile Dropdown](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/96429191-bebb-418e-a82e-c15d7e121c62-setting.png)
*Caption: Click the profile icon to access Settings, Changelog, and Logout.*

---

## Navigating The Settings Section
Once inside Settings, eleven tabs run across the top of the page:

| Tab | What it's for |
| --- | --- |
| **Account** | Your store's business details, contact information, bank details, and store assets like logo, signature, and stamp |
| **Modules** | Enable or disable MediFlux modules for your store |
| **Invoice Counter** | Configure invoice numbering for your bills |
| **Notifications** | Manage notification preferences |
| **Bill Templates** | Customize how your bills and invoices look |
| **Integrations** | Connect MediFlux with other tools and services |
| **User Management** | Manage staff accounts and their access |
| **Data Management** | Manage your store's data |
| **Subscriptions** | View and manage your MediFlux subscription plan |
| **Accounting Settings** | Configure accounting-related preferences |
| **Referrals** | Manage referral links and rewards |

![Settings Tabs](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/b1ba2cb5-3779-4f0e-9335-d108fd4aba79-setting-navigation.png)
*Caption: Eleven tabs across the top for Account, Modules, Invoice Counter, Notifications, Bill Templates, Integrations, User Management, Data Management, Subscriptions, Accounting Settings, and Referrals.*

---

## Configure Your Store
Set up your pharmacy exactly how you need it. These settings control how MediFlux looks, bills, notifies, and integrates with your daily workflow.


  * [Account](/docs/settings/account-info) - Business details, contact info, bank details, and store assets like logo, signature, and stamp.
  * [Modules](/docs/settings/modules) - Enable or disable MediFlux modules for your store.
  * [Invoice Counter](/docs/settings/invoice-counter) - Configure invoice numbering for your bills.
  * [Notifications](/docs/settings/notifications) - Manage notification preferences.
  * [Bill Templates](/docs/settings/bill-templates) - Customize how your bills and invoices look.
  * [Integrations](/docs/settings/integrations) - Connect MediFlux with other tools and services.

docs/settings/referrals.title: Referrals
docs/settings/referrals.description: Invite other store owners to MediFlux and earn rewards through the referral program.
docs/settings/referrals.body:
# Referrals

The **Referrals** tab lets you invite other pharmacy owners to MediFlux using your unique referral code or link, and earn rewards when they register.
---

## Referral Program Details
You'll find your **Referral Code** and a corresponding **Referral Link**, which can be shared directly with other store owners.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Copy Code** | Copies your referral code |
| **Copy** | Copies your referral link |
| **Share** | Opens sharing options for your referral link |

![Referral Program Details](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/8107b1d3-ad77-4855-b076-b3ce698c55c6-referrals-1.png)
*Caption: Your unique referral code and sharing options.*

---

## How It Works
1. **Share Your Code**

   Send your referral code or link to fellow pharmacy and healthcare store owners.

2. **They Register**

   When registering their store, they enter your referral code in the sign-up form.

3. **Earn Rewards**

   Get premium features, subscription discounts, or account credits upon verification.

---

## Your Referrals
This section shows a running total of referrals reached, along with a list of everyone who's registered using your code. If no one has registered yet, it shows **No referrals yet**.

![Your Referrals](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/62fe5e8e-3c74-48d0-a208-39048d2514b6-referral-2.png)
*Caption: Track your referral count and registered invitees.*

---

## FAQs

  ### When do I receive my referral reward?

Rewards are processed once the referred store's registration is verified.
  ### Can I check the status of someone I've referred?

Yes, you can check the registration status of your invitees from the Referrals page.


---
## Spread The Word
Your referral code is ready. Share it with fellow pharmacy owners and grow the MediFlux network.


  * [Subscriptions](/docs/settings/subscriptions) - Check your current plan and see how referral credits can reduce your costs.
  * [Account](/docs/settings/account-info) - Review your store details, they're what show up when someone registers with your code.
  * [User Management](/docs/settings/user-management) - Add team members who can also share your referral code with their network.
  * Help & Support - Need help with referrals? Reach out to the MediFlux support team.

docs/settings/subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
docs/settings/subscriptions.description: View your current plan status and upgrade or renew your MediFlux subscription.
docs/settings/subscriptions.body:
# Subscriptions

The **Subscriptions** tab shows your store's current plan status and lets you upgrade or renew to a longer-term plan for better savings.

---

## Current Subscription Status
At the top, you'll see whether you have an active subscription, along with:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Status** | Active or otherwise |
| **Activated** | Date your current plan was activated |
| **Payment** | Payment method used (e.g., Online) |
| **Expires On** | Date your current plan expires |

![Active Subscription Status](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/87586177-a12d-48a7-a7c6-b41c50c83c53-subscription-1.png)
*Caption: Current plan status, activation date, payment method, and expiry date.*

---

## Subscription Plans
Below your current status, MediFlux offers multiple subscription plans to upgrade or renew into. Each plan shows its price, effective monthly cost, and included features, such as multi-user access, unlimited transactions, priority support, and live customer support.

> **[Note]** Plan durations, pricing, and features shown here are subject to change. Always refer to the in-app Subscriptions page for the most current plans and pricing.

Click **Upgrade Now** on any plan to proceed.

![Subscription Plans](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/8a2d64bd-efb3-4c27-9458-a3e8a36e1a7d-subscription-2.png)
*Caption: Available plans with pricing, features, and Upgrade Now options.*

---

## FAQs

  ### What happens if my subscription expires?

Refer to the Subscriptions page for details on what features may be affected, since this can change depending on your plan and current MediFlux policies.
  ### Do longer-term plans offer better savings?

Yes, generally, longer commitments (e.g., 3-year or 5-year plans) come at a lower effective monthly cost compared to shorter plans.


---

## Unlock More Features
Upgrade your plan to access advanced capabilities across your pharmacy.


  * [User Management](/docs/settings/user-management) - Add more staff members, multi-user access unlocks with higher plans.
  * [Integrations](/docs/settings/integrations) - Connect WhatsApp automations and AI features available on upgraded plans.
  * [Modules](/docs/settings/modules) - Enable Clinic, Accounting, and Estimate Bills if your plan supports them.
  * [Accounting Settings](/docs/settings/account-info) - Unlock advanced accounting and reporting features with your upgraded plan.

docs/settings/user-management.title: User Management
docs/settings/user-management.description: Manage users, roles, and permissions across your platform, including sessions and activity logs.
docs/settings/user-management.body:
# User Management

The **User Management** tab is where you manage everyone who has access to your MediFlux store, adding new users, setting their permissions, reviewing active sessions, and tracking activity. It's organized into four sub-tabs: **Users**, **Sessions**, **Create user**, and **Activity logs**.
