![User Management Tabs](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/94f81b86-ff0e-4e0f-988d-1603e12af96e-user-management-1.png)
*Caption: Users, Sessions, Create user, and Activity logs sub-tabs.*

---

## Users
The **Users** tab lists everyone with access to your store, showing their name, status (e.g., Active), role (e.g., Staff, Doctor), and email.

Click **Edit** on any user to open the **Edit User** form:

![Edit User Form](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/6abce209-06af-4da5-a9cb-80991aa54839-user-management-2.png)
*Caption: Update role, name, email, password, and permissions for an existing user.*

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Role** | The user's role (e.g., Admin, Staff, Sales Person, Accountant) |
| **Name** | The user's name |
| **Email** | The user's email (read-only) |
| **New Password / Confirm Password** | Set a new password for the user, if needed |

### Permissions
Below this, a permissions grid lets you control what the user can **Write**, **Read**, or **Delete** across: Sale, Purchase, Customer, Supplier, Reports, and Customer Ledger.

![Permissions Grid](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/940b6b7c-a0aa-450d-b831-a8581b2bddd1-user-management-3.png)
*Caption: Set Write, Read, and Delete access for each module.*

### Clinic Permissions
An expandable **Clinic Permissions** section lets you set Write, Read, and Delete access specifically for Doctors, Schedules, and Appointments.

### Other Options
| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Deactivate User** | Prevents the user from logging in, without deleting their account |
| **Privacy Mode Enabled** | Hides sensitive information from this user |

Click **Save** to apply changes, or **Cancel** to discard.


![Other options](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/ae7c9b2b-4fc0-4917-9872-d15f70b7f72e-user-management-4.png)
*Caption: Deactivate User and Privacy Mode Enabled toggles below Clinic Permissions*

---

## Sessions
The **Sessions** tab shows every active login session across your store's users.

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | User's name and role |
| **Device / Browser** | The device and browser used for that session |
| **Last Updated** | When the session was last active |
| **Actions** | **Logout** to end that specific session |

You can filter by a specific user using the **All users** dropdown, and use **Logout All** to end every active session at once.

![Device Sessions](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/6ae42b5a-6b42-49a7-8d67-4ed6d31bdc66-user-management-5.png)
*Caption: View and manage active login sessions across all users.*

> **[Note]** Logging out a session immediately signs that user out on that device, useful if a staff member's device is lost or a session looks unfamiliar.

---

## Create User
Click **Create user** to add a new user to your store:

![Create New User](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/45abc20f-969a-477d-af83-bb267ef3ad3c-user-management-6.png)
*Caption: Form to add a new user with role, contact details, password, and permissions.*

### Basic Information
| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Role** | Admin, Staff, Sales Person, or Accountant, required |
| **Name** | Full name, required |
| **Email Address** | Required |
| **Phone** | Optional |

### Security
| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Password** | Required |
| **Confirm Password** | Required |

### Permissions
Set Write, Read, and Delete access across: Sale, Purchase, Customer, Supplier, Reports, Customer Ledger, Supplier Ledger, and Drug Management. An expandable **Clinic Permissions** section lets you set the same for Doctors, Schedules, and Appointments.

![Create User Permissions](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/c44f03d1-227d-4bca-91e6-271d20646cc0-user-management-7.png)
*Caption: Set module and clinic permissions for the new user.*

![Role Dropdown](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/5678f8a4-3ecd-40a0-a646-ea5be439fc5a-user-management-8.png)
*Caption: Select from Admin, Staff, Sales Person, or Accountant.*

> **[Note]** Permissions aren't tied to a fixed role, you can customize exactly what each user can access, regardless of the role you assign them.

---

## Activity Logs
The **Activity logs** tab is locked by default and requires a password to access.

![Activity Logs](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/07/753b12e4-1914-40e6-bdec-b2acaec4255d-user-management-9.png)
*Caption: Locked by default, contact MediFlux support to request access.*

> **[Note]** If you need to review activity logs, reach out to MediFlux support with your request, and the support team will assist accordingly.

---

## FAQs

  ### Can I set custom permissions for a user instead of relying on their role?

Yes, permissions are fully customizable per user, the Role field doesn't automatically lock in a fixed set of permissions.
  ### What happens if I deactivate a user?

The user can no longer log in, but their account and historical records aren't deleted.
  ### How do I access Activity Logs?

Activity Logs are locked by default. Reach out to MediFlux support to request access.
  ### Can I log out a specific device without logging out all users?

Yes, use the **Logout** action on that specific session in the Sessions tab.


---

## Build Your Team
Your users are set up. Now put them to work across your pharmacy.


  * [Add Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Let your sales staff start billing with their assigned permissions.
  * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Have your purchasing team record stock inward with controlled access.
  * [Doctors](/docs/clinics/doctors) - Set up clinic doctors if you've assigned Clinic Permissions to any user.
  * [Modules](/docs/settings/modules) - Enable or disable features so your users only see what they need.

docs/supplier/add-supplier.title: Add Supplier
docs/supplier/add-supplier.description: Learn how to add a new pharmacy drug supplier in MediFlux. Manually enter details or link a verified platform supplier, set opening balances, and track GST-ready ledgers.
docs/supplier/add-supplier.body:
# Add Supplier

> **Video:** [How to Add a Supplier in MediFlux](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=)

There are two ways to **add a new supplier** in MediFlux. You can create a **local supplier** manually by filling in their details, or you can **link a platform supplier** who is already registered on the MediFlux network. Both options are available from the Supplier List page and from the **`+` quick-add menu** available on every screen.

---

## Option 1: Add a Local Supplier Manually
You can open the Add New Supplier form in three ways:

- From the Supplier List page, click **+ Add Supplier**
- Click the **`+` menu** in the top-right corner of any screen and select **Add Supplier**
- Press `Ctrl + K`, type **Add Supplier**, and hit `Enter`

![MediFlux Add New Pharmacy Supplier Form](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1782796347940-517416265-ss8.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux form for adding a new local pharmacy supplier, showing required fields like Store Name, GSTIN, and Phone Number.*

### Basic Details
| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Store Name** | Yes | The name of the supplier's store or business, e.g., ABC Pharmaceuticals |
| **License Number** | No | The supplier's drug license number, e.g., `LIC-12345678` |
| **GSTIN** | No | The supplier's GST Identification Number, e.g., `29ABCDE1234F1Z5` |
| **Contact Person** | No | Name of the primary contact at the supplier, e.g., John Smith |
| **Phone Number** | Yes | Supplier's primary contact number |
| **Email Address** | No | Supplier's email address |
| **Website** | No | Supplier's website URL |
| **Address** | Yes | Full address of the supplier |

### Additional Information
| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Opening Balance** | Any existing outstanding amount you already owe this supplier before starting to record purchases in MediFlux. Defaults to `0`. |
| **Notes** | Any internal notes about this supplier. |
| **Reliability Score** | A manual 1–5 star rating you assign to reflect how reliable this supplier is. |

![MediFlux Supplier Opening Balance and Reliability Score](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1782796347948-643887021-ss9.png)
*Caption: Additional supplier information fields in MediFlux, including Opening Balance, Notes, and Reliability Score.*

> **[Note]** If you are migrating from an older system or manual registers, enter the amount you already owe this supplier in **Opening Balance** before saving. For example, if you owe a supplier ₹25,000 before starting MediFlux, enter that here. All future purchases and payments will automatically adjust from this starting figure.

Once all required fields are filled, click **+ Add Supplier** to save the profile. Click **Cancel** to discard and close the form.

Once saved, MediFlux automatically maintains this supplier's ledger for every new purchase. No manual tracking needed.

---

## Option 2: Link a Platform Supplier
If your supplier is already registered on the MediFlux platform, you can link them directly instead of entering their details manually.

Click **+ Link Supplier** from the Supplier List page. This opens the **Link to Platform Supplier** dialog.

Search for your supplier by **name, email, or license number**, select them from the results, and click **Link Supplier**. Their verified business details are pulled in automatically.

![MediFlux Link Verified Platform Supplier](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783582218643-270436663-link-supplier.png)
*Caption: Search and select a registered platform supplier to link directly to your MediFlux pharmacy account.*

> **[Note]** If your supplier is not on the MediFlux platform, use **+ Add Supplier** to add them manually instead.

---

## Adding a Supplier From The Dashboard
You can also add a supplier without navigating to the Suppliers section at all. Click the **`+` button** in the top-right corner of any screen and select **Add Supplier** from the dropdown. This opens the same Add New Supplier form.

![MediFlux Dashboard Quick Add Supplier Menu](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783582261867-280108023-add-from-dashboard.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux dashboard quick-add menu showing the Add Supplier option for fast workflow.*

> **[Info]** **Tip:** Press `Ctrl + K` anywhere in MediFlux, type "Add Supplier", and hit `Enter` to open the form without touching the mouse.

---

## Common Mistakes To Avoid
> **[Warning: Forgetting to add the Opening Balance]** If you owe a supplier money before starting MediFlux, make sure to enter it in the **Opening Balance** field when creating the supplier. If you forget, you cannot edit it directly later. Instead, go to the supplier's ledger and create an **Adjustment entry** to add it manually.

> **[Warning: Skipping GSTIN and License Number]** These fields are optional but highly recommended. Without a GSTIN, your purchase entries will not be GST-ready, which can cause issues when generating GSTR reports during tax season.

---

## After Adding a Supplier

  * [Record a Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Add inward stock from this supplier to your inventory.
  * [Supplier Ledger](/docs/supplier/supplier-ledger) - Check outstanding balance and record payments.
  * [Supplier List](/docs/supplier/supplier-list) - Browse all suppliers and add more if needed.
  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Check current stock levels before placing orders.

docs/supplier/overview.title: Suppliers
docs/supplier/overview.description: Manage your pharmacy drug suppliers in MediFlux. Track outstanding payments, record purchases, and maintain a complete, GST-ready ledger from one place.
docs/supplier/overview.body:
# Suppliers

The **Suppliers** section is your central hub for managing every distributor and wholesaler your pharmacy works with in **MediFlux**. From adding a new supplier profile to tracking outstanding dues and recording payments, everything you need to maintain clean, audit-ready supplier accounts is here.

---

## Overview
Supplier profiles connect directly to your purchase workflow so you can quickly record inward stock, track outstanding dues, and maintain a complete ledger for every distributor, all without leaving the MediFlux platform.

---

## What You Can Do In Suppliers
- **Maintain a supplier directory:** Store contact details, GSTIN, license numbers, and reliability scores for every distributor.
- **Track outstanding payments:** See at a glance how much you owe each supplier and across all suppliers combined.
- **View purchase history:** Every inward stock entry is linked to the supplier it came from.
- **Record payments and credit notes:** Mark dues as paid and log credit notes from suppliers directly into the ledger.
- **Analyse supplier performance:** Monitor gross margin percentage and units supplied per supplier.
- **Export ledger data:** Download supplier-wise or consolidated ledger entries as PDF or Excel for accounting and audits.

---

## Navigating the Suppliers Section
The **Suppliers** section in the left sidebar expands into three main pages:

| Page | What it's for |
| --- | --- |
| **Supplier List** | View, search, and manage all your supplier profiles |
| **Ledger** | See a consolidated ledger of all entries across every supplier |
| **Trash** | Recover or permanently delete removed supplier profiles |

![MediFlux Pharmacy Supplier Management Sidebar](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783577950238-405401162-supplier-overview.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux left sidebar showing Supplier List, Ledger, and Trash navigation options.*

---

## Quick Actions From The Dashboard
You don't have to navigate to the Suppliers section to add a supplier or record a payment. The **`+` button** in the top-right corner of any screen gives you instant access to the most common actions from anywhere in MediFlux:

- **Add Supplier:** Create a new supplier profile without leaving the dashboard.
- **Add Supplier Payment:** Record a payment directly without navigating away.

![MediFlux Quick Add Supplier Menu](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783578058040-116562081-supplier-add.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux dashboard quick-add menu showing Add Supplier and Add Supplier Payment options.*

> **[Note]** The `+` quick-add menu is available on every screen, not just the dashboard. Use it whenever you need to add a supplier or record a payment without breaking your current workflow.

---

## Supplier Types
MediFlux distinguishes between two types of suppliers:

**Platform Suppliers** are distributors already registered on the MediFlux platform. Linking a platform supplier gives you access to verified business details and streamlined purchase workflows.

**Local Suppliers** are distributors you add manually. These are your neighbourhood wholesalers and local pharma distributors that aren't on the platform yet.

You can filter your supplier list by type at any time using the **Platform Suppliers** and **Local Suppliers** quick-filter chips.

---

## Supplier List
The **Supplier List** is your complete supplier directory. View all your distributors at a glance with contact details, outstanding balances, gross margin percentages, and reliability scores. Search by name, phone, or GSTIN. Filter by platform or local suppliers. Click any supplier to view their full profile, purchase history, and ledger.

![MediFlux Pharmacy Supplier List Directory](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783592161219-87006719-supplier-listOverview.png)
*Caption: The MediFlux supplier directory with search, filters, and performance metrics for pharmacy distributors.*

---

## Ledger
The **Ledger** page gives you a complete financial record of all your supplier transactions. View a consolidated ledger across all suppliers at once, or click into any individual supplier to see their dedicated ledger with a running balance. Track purchases, payments, credit notes, and manual adjustments. Filter by date range, entry type, and payment method. Export entries as PDF or Excel.

![MediFlux Supplier Ledger and Payment Tracking](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783592272385-190919388-supplier-ledger-overview.png)
*Caption: Consolidated and individual supplier ledgers in MediFlux with balance tracking and export options.*

---

## Trash
Deleted suppliers aren't gone forever. The **Trash** page holds all supplier profiles that have been removed from your system, so you can restore them if needed. View deletion history, check outstanding balances at the time of deletion, and restore suppliers back to your active directory with one click. All linked purchase records and ledger entries are preserved even after deletion.

![MediFlux Deleted Supplier Recovery](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783592373975-785072380-supplierTrash-overview.png)
*Caption: Recover deleted pharmacy suppliers in MediFlux and view their preserved purchase history.*

---

## Common Mistakes To Avoid
> **[Warning: Forgetting to add the Opening Balance]** If you owe a supplier money before starting MediFlux, make sure to enter it in the **Opening Balance** field when creating the supplier. If you forget, you cannot edit it directly later. Instead, go to the supplier's ledger and create an **Adjustment entry** to add it manually.

> **[Warning: Leaving required fields empty]** **Store Name**, **Phone Number**, and **Address** are required. If any of these are missing, the supplier cannot be saved. Make sure all three are filled before clicking **+ Add Supplier**.

> **[Warning: Skipping GSTIN and License Number]** These fields are optional but highly recommended. Without a GSTIN, your purchase entries will not be GST-ready, which can cause issues when generating GSTR reports during tax season.

---

## FAQs

  ### What is the difference between a Platform Supplier and a Local Supplier?

A Platform Supplier is a distributor already registered on MediFlux. You link them and their verified details are pulled in automatically. A Local Supplier is any distributor you add manually by entering their details yourself. Both types work the same way once added.
  ### What happens to my purchase history if I delete a supplier?

All purchase records and ledger entries are preserved even after a supplier is deleted. You can still view them from the Trash page via **View Purchases**. If you need the supplier back, simply restore them from Trash.
  ### Can I track how much I owe all my suppliers at once?

Yes. The Supplier List page shows a summary card with the total outstanding amount across all suppliers. The Ledger page also shows a running total of all outstanding at the bottom of the supplier panel.
  ### Is GSTIN mandatory when adding a supplier?

No. GSTIN is optional. However, entering it ensures your purchase entries are GST-ready and makes it easier to generate accurate GSTR reports during tax season.


---

## Start Managing Your Suppliers

  * [Supplier List](/docs/supplier/supplier-list) - Browse, search, and manage all your distributor profiles.
  * [Ledger](/docs/supplier/supplier-ledger) - Check outstanding payments across all suppliers.
  * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Record new stock received from a supplier.
  * [Purchase List](/docs/purchases/purchase-list) - View all past purchases and filter by supplier.

docs/supplier/supplier-ledger.title: Supplier Ledger
docs/supplier/supplier-ledger.description: Track pharmacy supplier ledgers in MediFlux. Monitor outstanding balances, record payments, credit notes, and purchase adjustments easily.
docs/supplier/supplier-ledger.body: # Supplier Ledger The **Supplier Ledger** page gives you a complete financial record of all your **pharmacy supplier transactions** in **MediFlux**. You can view a consolidated ledger across all suppliers at once, or click into any individual supplier to see their dedicated ledger with a running outstanding balance. Navigate here from the sidebar: **Suppliers → Ledger**. You can also jump directly using the keyboard shortcut `F6` from anywhere in the app. --- ## Page Layout The Ledger page is split into two panels: **Left panel: Supplier list** Shows all your suppliers with their name, address, and individual outstanding balance in red. The total outstanding across all suppliers is shown at the bottom. Use the search bar to find a specific supplier instantly. Click **View All Suppliers** to go back to the full Supplier List page. **Right panel: Ledger entries** Shows the transactions for the selected supplier, or all entries across every supplier if no supplier is selected. ![MediFlux Pharmacy Supplier Ledger Page Layout](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783578949917-346657989-ledger-sidebar.png) *Caption: The MediFlux supplier ledger showing the left panel with the supplier list and the right panel with outstanding ledger entries.* --- ## Consolidated View vs. Individual Supplier View The two views share the same entry type tabs and almost the same columns. What changes is the **action buttons available** and whether a **Supplier** or **Balance** column is shown. | | Consolidated (no supplier selected) | Individual supplier | | --- | --- | --- | | **Buttons** | Export, Filter | Export, Add Payment, Adjust, Import, Filter | | **Extra column** | Supplier (name and contact number) | Balance (running outstanding total) | ![MediFlux Consolidated Supplier Ledger View](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783580548214-520368422-consolidated-view.png) *Caption: Export and Filter buttons available in the consolidated pharmacy supplier ledger view in MediFlux.* ![MediFlux Individual Supplier Ledger View](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783580620097-18271720-individual-view.png) *Caption: Export, Add Payment, Adjust, Import, and Filter buttons available for individual pharmacy supplier ledgers in MediFlux.* > **[Note]** **Add Payment** and **Adjust** only appear once you've selected an individual supplier, since payments and adjustments are always tied to a specific supplier. **Import** is currently unavailable (greyed out). --- ### Entry Type Tabs Both views use the same tabs to filter what you see: | Tab | What it shows | | --- | --- | | **All** | Every transaction | | **Payment** | Payments you made to suppliers | | **Purchase** | Purchase bills recorded against suppliers | | **Credit Note** | Credit notes confirmed after a medicine return | | **Adjustment** | Manual balance corrections | ![MediFlux Supplier Ledger Entry Type Tabs](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783580720293-720495856-filter-buttons.png) *Caption: Filter pharmacy supplier ledger transactions by All, Payment, Purchase, Credit Note, or Adjustment in MediFlux.* --- ### Ledger Table Columns | Column | Description | | --- | --- | | **Supplier** *(consolidated view only)* | Name and contact number of the supplier | | **Date** | Date and time of the transaction, with the entry type shown as a label | | **Debit** | Amount reducing what you owe: payments and credit notes | | **Credit** | Amount increasing what you owe: purchases and opening balance | | **Balance** *(individual view only)* | Running outstanding balance after every entry: updates automatically with each transaction | | **Receipt** | Receipt or reference number if recorded | | **Notes** | Any notes added at the time of entry | | **Actions** | Delete the entry | ![MediFlux Consolidated Supplier Ledger Table](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783580928418-894092389-all-columns.png) *Caption: Combined view showing all transactions, debits, and credits across all pharmacy suppliers in MediFlux.* --- ### Individual Supplier Ledger Table With Balance Column ![MediFlux Individual Supplier Ledger with Running Balance](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783580817831-15005426-balance-column.png) *Caption: Dedicated pharmacy supplier ledger showing the running outstanding balance for a single distributor in MediFlux.* > **[Note]** The **Balance** column updates after every single entry, so you can trace exactly how the outstanding amount changed step by step from day one. The consolidated view doesn't show this since it mixes entries across multiple suppliers. --- ## How The Outstanding Balance Works MediFlux calculates your supplier outstanding automatically, you never need to update it manually: - When you record a **Purchase** → the amount is added to Credit, increasing what you owe - When you make a **Payment** → the amount is added to Debit, reducing what you owe - When a **Credit Note** is confirmed → the return amount reduces your outstanding - **Opening Balance** → any amount you owed before starting MediFlux is the starting point --- ## Adding An Adjustment Entry If you need to manually correct a supplier's ledger balance, for example a price correction, rounding adjustment, or write-off, click **Adjust** on the individual supplier ledger. ![MediFlux Add Supplier Ledger Adjustment](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783581158367-820452459-adjust-button.png) *Caption: Button to open the dialog for manually correcting a pharmacy supplier's ledger balance in MediFlux.* --- ### Adjustment Fields | Field | Description | | --- | --- | | **Adjustment Amount** | Enter a positive number (e.g. `500`) to increase what you owe, or a negative number (e.g. `-500`) to reduce what you owe | | **Entry Date** | Defaults to today's date. Can be changed | | **Receipt / Reference Number** | Optional reference number for this adjustment | | **Notes** | Reason for the adjustment: e.g. price correction, rounding adjustment, write-off | Click **Add** to save. Click **Reset** to clear all fields. ![MediFlux Supplier Ledger Adjustment Entry Dialog](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783581008356-451368148-adjustment-entry.png) *Caption: Dialog for manually correcting a pharmacy supplier's outstanding ledger balance with notes and reference numbers in MediFlux.* --- ## Filtering The Ledger Click **Filter** on the individual supplier ledger to open the Ledger Filters panel. ![MediFlux Supplier Ledger Filter Icon](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783581518414-293402188-click-filter.png) *Caption: Click the filter icon to open the pharmacy supplier ledger filtering options in MediFlux.* --- ### You can filter by: | Filter | Options | | --- | --- | | **Date Range** | Today, This Month, Last Month, This Quarter, Last Quarter, This Year, Last Year: or set a custom Start and End date | | **Entry Type** | All Types, Payment, Purchase, Credit Note, Adjustment | | **Payment Method** | All Methods, Cash, Card, UPI, Net Banking | | **Sort By** | Sort field and order: ascending or descending | Click **Apply** to apply the filters. Click **Clear** to reset them all. ![MediFlux Supplier Ledger Filters Panel](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783581578241-728856781-filter-panel.png) *Caption: Filter pharmacy supplier ledger entries by date range, entry type, payment method, and sort order in MediFlux.* --- ## Exporting Ledger Entries Click **Export** on the individual supplier ledger to open the Export Options dialog. ![MediFlux Export Supplier Ledger Button](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783581970226-813998766-export-button.png) *Caption: Click Export to download pharmacy supplier ledger entries in MediFlux.* --- ### Choose A **Date Range** And An **Export Format**: - **PDF Document** - **Excel Spreadsheet** Click **Export** to download. ![MediFlux Export Pharmacy Supplier Ledger Options](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783581764686-363945475-export.png) *Caption: Choose a date range and export format (PDF or Excel) for pharmacy supplier ledgers in MediFlux.* --- ## Keyboard Shortcuts | Shortcut | Action | | --- | --- | | `F6` | Jump to Supplier Ledger from anywhere in the app | | `F2` | Jump to Supplier List | | `Esc` | Close the current panel or dialog | --- ## FAQs ### Can I delete a ledger entry? Yes, click the three-dot menu on any entry row and select Delete Entry. Note that deleting a purchase or payment entry will affect your outstanding balance immediately. ### What is the difference between Debit and Credit in the ledger? Debit entries reduce what you owe a supplier (these are payments and credit notes). Credit entries increase what you owe (these are purchase bills and opening balance). Your outstanding balance is always Credit minus Debit. ### Can I edit a payment or purchase entry after saving? Purchase entries can be edited from the Purchases section. Payment and credit note entries cannot be edited; if you made an error, delete the entry and record it again with the correct details. ### Why does my Balance column not start from zero? If you set an Opening Balance when adding the supplier, the Balance column starts from that amount. This represents the amount you already owed that supplier before starting MediFlux. --- ## Just Finished Reviewing The Ledger? Here's What Most Users Do: * [Supplier List](/docs/supplier/supplier-list) - Select another supplier to review their ledger. * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Record new stock that will appear in this supplier's ledger. * [Supplier Profile](/docs/supplier/supplier-profile) - View full supplier details, performance stats, and recent purchases. * [Purchase List](/docs/purchases/purchase-list) - See all purchases that feed into supplier ledgers. > **[Note]** Press `F6` anytime to return to the Ledger from anywhere in the app.

docs/supplier/supplier-list.title: Supplier List
docs/supplier/supplier-list.description: View and manage suppliers, track outstanding balances, record bulk payments, and perform bulk edit and delete actions.
docs/supplier/supplier-list.body:
# Supplier List

The **Supplier List** is your main directory for managing all suppliers added to your pharmacy. From this page, you can search suppliers, check outstanding balances, view supplier details, record payments, and perform bulk actions on multiple suppliers.

Navigate to **Suppliers → Supplier List** from the sidebar.

---

## Summary Cards

At the top of the page, four summary cards provide an overview of your suppliers.

| Card | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Total Suppliers** | Total number of suppliers added to your system |
| **Outstanding** | Click to view outstanding supplier balances |
| **Platform Suppliers** | Number of suppliers linked through the MediFlux platform |
| **Local Suppliers** | Number of local suppliers |

![Supplier summary cards](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/e1e7ff2b-d997-45fb-bcc1-ce2d1108710b-supplier-summary-cards.png)
*Caption: Overview of total suppliers, outstanding balances, platform suppliers, and local suppliers.*

---

## Searching Suppliers

Use the search bar at the top of the page to find suppliers by:

- Name
- Phone number
- Email address
- Address

Start typing to filter the supplier list.

The **All** dropdown beside the search bar allows you to change the search scope.

![Search suppliers](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/2741923e-2a33-49a2-9684-228ab770f1a7-supplier-search.png)
*Caption: Search suppliers by name, phone number, email address, or address.*

---

## Filter Chips

Below the search bar, you can use quick filters to narrow the supplier list.

| Filter | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Outstanding Only** | Suppliers with pending outstanding balances |
| **No Outstanding** | Suppliers with no outstanding balance |
| **Platform Suppliers** | Suppliers linked through the MediFlux platform |
| **Local Suppliers** | Local suppliers |

Click a filter to apply it. Click it again to remove the filter.

![Supplier filters](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/3563b8f1-9228-4439-8cb6-488a1848ae19-supplier-filter-chips.png)
*Caption: Filter suppliers by outstanding balance or supplier type.*

---

## Supplier Table

The supplier table displays the following information:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Checkbox** | Select one or more suppliers for bulk actions |
| **Name** | Supplier name, with address displayed underneath |
| **Phone** | Supplier contact number |
| **Margin** | Click **Click to view** to check the supplier's margin details |
| **Outstanding** | Click **Click to view** to check the supplier's outstanding balance |
| **Last Payment** | Displays the last payment information, when available |
| **Actions** | Opens the three-dot menu for supplier-specific actions |

![Supplier table](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/bccbdc34-f8c1-4e1e-9de4-24b285c3505e-supplier-table.png)
*Caption: View supplier details, margins, outstanding balances, last payment, and actions.*

### Sorting the Table

Click the sorting arrows beside supported column headings to arrange suppliers in ascending or descending order.

You can use sorting to review suppliers by margin, outstanding balance, or last payment.

---

## Supplier Actions

At the top-right of the Supplier List, you will find:

- **+ Add Supplier**
- **Add Payment**
- **Actions**

The **Actions** dropdown contains the following options:

| Action | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Bulk Payment** | Record payments for multiple suppliers |
| **Link** | Access the supplier linking option |
| **Import** | Import supplier data |
| **Export** | Export supplier data |

![Supplier actions dropdown](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/422aa0f2-1a62-46ce-8ca3-5f085af2553b-actions-supplier.png)
*Caption: Access Bulk Payment, Link, Import, and Export from the Actions menu.*

---

## Bulk Supplier Payment

The **Bulk Payment** feature allows you to record payments for multiple suppliers in a single workflow.

Instead of opening each supplier's ledger and recording payments individually, you can select the suppliers, enter their payment details, and submit them together.

### How to Record Bulk Supplier Payments

1. **Open Bulk Payment**

   Go to **Suppliers → Supplier List**.

   Click **Actions → Bulk Payment**.

   The **Bulk Supplier Payment** dialog opens.

2. **Select suppliers**

   The dialog displays a list of suppliers along with their outstanding balances.

   Use the checkboxes to select the suppliers you want to pay.

   You can also search for suppliers by name or address.

   ![Select suppliers for bulk payment](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/3f15b854-813d-4c32-9c56-ed4637c05fe5-select-supplier.png)
*Caption: Choose multiple suppliers and review their outstanding balances before recording payments.*

   Click **Next** to continue.

3. **Enter payment details**

   The next screen displays the selected suppliers and their current balances.

   At the top, you can set the payment date, payment method, and percentage of the amount.

   Each supplier has a separate payment section.

   | Field | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | **Amount (₹)** | Amount to pay the supplier |
   | **Full Pay** | Quickly fill the amount required to clear the supplier's current balance |
   | **Payment Date** | Date of the payment |
   | **Method** | Payment method for that supplier |
   | **Receipt No.** | Optional payment receipt number |
   | **Notes** | Optional notes about the payment |

   ![Bulk Supplier Payment details](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/24ec5dde-6c0e-4aeb-a849-3a8272363528-bulk-payment.png)
*Caption: Enter individual payment amounts, dates, methods, receipt numbers, and notes for selected suppliers.*

4. **Review the total payment**

   At the bottom of the dialog, **Total Payment** shows the combined amount entered for the selected suppliers.

   Review the amounts and payment details before proceeding.

5. **Submit payments**

   Click **Submit** to record the bulk supplier payments.

> **[Note]** Each supplier has an individual payment amount and payment method. You can use **Full Pay** for suppliers whose outstanding balance you want to clear completely.

---

## Bulk Actions

The Supplier List also supports selecting multiple suppliers to perform bulk actions.

Available bulk actions include:

- **Bulk Edit**
- **Bulk Delete**

### Selecting Suppliers

1. **Select supplier records**

   Go to **Suppliers → Supplier List**.

   Tick the checkbox beside each supplier you want to include.

   You can also use the checkbox in the table header to select all suppliers currently displayed.

2. **Choose a bulk action**

   Once suppliers are selected, a selection bar appears above the table.

   It displays the number of selected suppliers and the available actions:

   - **Bulk Edit**
   - **Bulk Delete**
   - **Clear Selection**

   ![Bulk supplier selection](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/6db8628a-d393-43a6-a299-8805f4fa99fc-bulk-delete.png)
*Caption: Select multiple suppliers to access Bulk Edit, Bulk Delete, and Clear Selection.*

---

### Bulk Edit Suppliers

**Bulk Edit** allows you to update the **State** of multiple selected suppliers at once.

> **[Warning: Bulk Edit limitation]** Currently, Bulk Edit supports changing only the supplier's **State**. Other supplier details cannot be modified through this bulk action.

#### How to Bulk Edit Suppliers

1. **Select suppliers**

   Tick the checkboxes beside the suppliers you want to update.

2. **Open Bulk Edit**

   Click **Bulk Edit** in the selection bar.

   The **Bulk Edit Suppliers** dialog opens and displays the number of selected suppliers.

   ![Bulk Edit Suppliers](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/4bbc809f-6cc9-45a1-892f-93ef4ffbff84-bulk-edit.png)
*Caption: Update the State field for multiple selected suppliers.*

3. **Choose a state**

   Open the **State** dropdown and select the state you want to assign to the selected suppliers.

   The default option is **Select State (Unchanged)**.

4. **Apply the update**

   Click **Apply Updates** to save the state change for the selected suppliers.

> **[Note]** The selected state is applied to all suppliers included in the bulk edit operation.

---

### Bulk Delete Suppliers

**Bulk Delete** allows you to delete multiple selected supplier records in one operation.

1. **Select suppliers**

   Tick the checkboxes beside the suppliers you want to delete.

2. **Choose Bulk Delete**

   Click **Bulk Delete** in the selection bar.

3. **Review the deletion**

   Review the selected suppliers and any confirmation shown by MediFlux before proceeding.

> **[Warning: Check before deleting]** Make sure you have selected the correct suppliers before using Bulk Delete. The screenshots provided do not establish whether deleted suppliers can be restored, so do not assume this action is reversible.

### Clear Selection

Click **Clear Selection** to deselect all currently selected suppliers and close the bulk action bar.

---

## Row Actions and Supplier Details

Click the **three-dot menu (⋮)** in a supplier's row to access the available actions for that supplier.

To open the supplier's full profile, click the **supplier name**.

![Supplier row actions](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/b3400f3e-fea8-430c-9feb-989dda4c1ddb-individual-supplier-actions.png)
*Caption: Access supplier-specific actions from the three-dot menu.*

---

## Adding a Supplier

Click **+ Add Supplier** at the top-right to create a new supplier profile.

For detailed instructions, see [Add a Supplier](/docs/supplier/add-supplier).

---

## Common Follow-Ups


  * [Supplier Ledger](/docs/supplier/supplier-ledger) - Review supplier transactions, outstanding dues, and payment history.
  * [Add a Supplier](/docs/supplier/add-supplier) - Create a new supplier profile.
  * [Customer List](/docs/customers/customer-list) - View and manage customer records.
  * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Review medicine inventory and stock details.

docs/supplier/supplier-profile.title: Supplier Profile
docs/supplier/supplier-profile.description: View a supplier's complete purchase history, outstanding balance, performance stats, and manage their details from one page.
docs/supplier/supplier-profile.body: # Supplier Profile Clicking on any supplier's name in the Supplier List opens their **Supplier Profile**, a dedicated page showing everything about that supplier in one place. From here you can view their purchase history, track outstanding dues, check margin performance, and take actions like editing details or recording a new purchase. --- ## Profile Header At the top of the page you'll see: - The supplier's name in large text under the **SUPPLIER** label - A small **avatar icon** with a dropdown arrow. Click this to switch to a different supplier without going back to the list - **Last edited** timestamp showing when the supplier profile was last updated - The supplier's **phone number, address, license number, and GSTIN** displayed on the right side of the header ![Profile header](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783578243086-355950905-supplier-profile.png) *Caption: Supplier name, avatar dropdown, contact details, and last edited timestamp.* --- ## Summary Cards Five stat cards sit below the header giving you a quick performance snapshot of this supplier: | Card | What it shows | | --- | --- | | **Total Purchases** | The all-time total amount of purchases made from this supplier | | **Outstanding** | The current amount pending payment. Shows **Pending payment** in red if there is a balance due, or `₹0.00` if fully paid | | **Total Orders** | Total number of purchase orders placed with this supplier. Shows **Successful deliveries** below | | **Units Supplied** | Total units received from this supplier across all purchases. Shows the number of unique drugs below | | **Gross Margin %** | The gross margin percentage calculated across all purchases from this supplier | ![Summary cards](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783578355162-272902606-supplier-profile-summaryCards.png ) *Caption: Five stat cards showing purchase history, outstanding, orders, units, and margin.* --- ## Page-Level Actions Three buttons and a menu sit at the top-right of the supplier profile: | Button | What it does | | --- | --- | | **Add Purchase** | Create a new purchase entry directly linked to this supplier | | **Ledger** | Jump to this supplier's individual ledger | | **More** | Opens a dropdown with additional actions | ### Add Purchase Click **Add Purchase** to create a new purchase entry directly linked to this supplier, without having to search for or select the supplier again in the purchase form. ![Add Purchase](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783578533914-740803091-add-purchase-fromSupplier.png) *Caption: Purchase form opened directly from the supplier profile.* ### Ledger Click **Ledger** to jump straight to this supplier's individual ledger, showing their full transaction history, running balance, and options to add payments, credit notes, or adjustments. ![Ledger button](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783578611268-296048612-supplier-ledger.png) *Caption: Quick access to the supplier's transaction ledger.* ### More Menu Options | Option | What it does | | --- | --- | | **Purchases** | View all purchases linked to this supplier | | **Edit** | Opens the Update Supplier form to edit the supplier's profile details | | **Export Purchases** | Export this supplier's purchase history | | **Delete** | Delete this supplier profile | ![More menu](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783578675755-493142887-menu-options.png) *Caption: Additional actions available from the dropdown menu.* --- ## Editing A Supplier Click **Edit** from the **More** menu to open the **Update Supplier** form. You can edit Store Name, License Number, GSTIN, Contact Person, Phone Number, Email Address, Website, Address, Notes, and Reliability Score. > **[Note]** The **Opening Balance** field cannot be edited from here. It is locked once the supplier is created. If you need to correct it, create an **Adjustment entry** from the supplier's Ledger instead. Click **Update Supplier** to save your changes, or **Cancel** to discard them. ![Update Supplier form](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783578739607-566474584-supplier-form.png) *Caption: Edit supplier details. Opening Balance is disabled and cannot be changed.* --- ## Recent Purchases Below the summary cards, the **Recent Purchases** table shows the latest purchase entries recorded against this supplier: | Column | Description | | --- | --- | | **Date** | Date and time the purchase was recorded | | **Invoice** | Invoice number of the purchase | | **Drugs** | Number of drug line items in the purchase | | **Amount** | Total value of the purchase | | **Actions** | Options to View, open Invoice, or Edit the purchase entry | Click **View More** at the bottom of the table to load older purchase entries. ![Recent Purchases table](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783578810805-572972557-recent-purchases.png) *Caption: Latest purchases with actions menu showing View, Invoice, and Edit options.* --- ## Notes At the bottom of the profile, the **Notes** section displays any internal remarks entered when the supplier was first created. If no notes were added, it shows **No remarks provided**. To update the notes, use the **Edit** option from the **More** menu. --- ## Common Mistakes To Avoid > **[Warning: Trying to edit the Opening Balance from the supplier profile]** The Opening Balance field is locked in the Edit form and cannot be changed here. If the original amount was wrong, add an **Adjustment entry** from the supplier's Ledger instead. > **[Warning: Deleting a supplier instead of editing them]** If you only need to update a supplier's details, use **Edit**, not **Delete**. Deleting moves the supplier to Trash. Although purchase history is preserved, it removes them from your active Supplier List until restored. --- ## FAQs ### Can I edit a supplier's Opening Balance from their profile? No. The Opening Balance field is locked once the supplier is saved. To correct it, go to the supplier's Ledger and add an Adjustment entry. ### What happens if I delete a supplier from their profile? The supplier moves to Trash. All purchase history and ledger entries are preserved and can be viewed from there. You can restore the supplier at any time. ### Why is my Outstanding showing ₹0.00 even though I have purchases? This means all purchases from this supplier have been fully paid off through payments or credit notes recorded in the Ledger. ### Can I export a single supplier's purchase history? Yes. Click Export Purchases from the More menu to export just this supplier's purchase records. --- ## From This Supplier * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Record new stock received from this supplier. * [Supplier Ledger](/docs/supplier/supplier-ledger) - Check outstanding balance and record payments. * [Purchase List](/docs/purchases/purchase-list) - View all past purchases from this and other suppliers. * [Drug List](/docs/inventory/drug-list) - Check stock levels before placing a new order.

docs/supplier/supplier-trash.title: Supplier Trash
docs/supplier/supplier-trash.description: View and restore deleted supplier profiles, or permanently remove them from your system.
docs/supplier/supplier-trash.body: # Supplier Trash The **Trash** page holds all supplier profiles that have been deleted from your system. Deleted suppliers are not permanently removed immediately. They stay in Trash so you can restore them if needed. Navigate here from the sidebar: **Suppliers → Trash**. --- ## The Trash Table The Trash page shows the same table structure as the Supplier List, with the same columns: | Column | Description | | --- | --- | | **Name** | Supplier store name | | **Phone** | Primary contact number | | **License Number** | Drug license number if added. Shows `—` if not provided | | **Margin %** | Gross margin percentage from all purchases. Shows `—` if no purchases were recorded | | **Outstanding** | Amount still owed to this supplier at the time of deletion | | **Actions** | Options to manage the deleted supplier | The page also shows a **Found X** count at the top indicating how many deleted suppliers are currently in Trash. ![Supplier Trash page](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783585149648-5985651-trash.png) *Caption: Trash table showing a deleted supplier with all details and actions.* --- ## Searching In Trash The search bar at the top works the same as the Supplier List. Search across **names, phone numbers, emails, and addresses** to find a specific deleted supplier quickly. --- ## Restoring Or Viewing A Deleted Supplier Click the **three-dot menu (⋮)** on any row to see two options: | Option | What it does | | --- | --- | | **View Purchases** | View all purchase history linked to this supplier even after deletion | | **Restore** | Restores the supplier profile back to your active Supplier List | ![Row actions](https://waibusiness.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/media/1783585156758-593191751-actions.png) *Caption: Three-dot menu showing View Purchases and Restore options.* > **[Note]** Restoring a supplier brings back their full profile and all linked purchase history. Their outstanding balance is also restored as it was at the time of deletion. --- ## FAQs ### Can I permanently delete a supplier from Trash? Currently deleted suppliers remain in Trash and can be restored at any time. Contact MediFlux support if you need a supplier permanently removed. ### Will deleting a supplier affect my purchase history? No. All purchase records and ledger entries linked to a deleted supplier are preserved. You can still view them via View Purchases from the Trash page. ### Can I still see a deleted supplier's outstanding balance? Yes. The outstanding balance at the time of deletion is still visible in the Trash table. ### What happens to my outstanding balance if I restore a supplier? The supplier is restored with their full profile and outstanding balance exactly as it was when they were deleted. ## Common Follow-Ups * [Supplier List](/docs/supplier/supplier-list) - Find restored suppliers back in your active directory. * [Supplier Profile](/docs/supplier/supplier-profile) - View full details of a supplier after restoring them. * [Purchase List](/docs/purchases/purchase-list) - See all preserved purchases from restored suppliers. * [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase) - Record new stock from a restored supplier.

docs/wallet/overview.title: Store Wallet
docs/wallet/overview.description: Manage your MediFlux wallet balance, add credits for paid services, and track wallet transactions, deductions, and rewards.
docs/wallet/overview.body:
# Store Wallet

The **Store Wallet** allows you to manage credits used for MediFlux services that carry additional charges.

Some features, such as sending **WhatsApp sale invoices**, **payment reminders**, and other chargeable services, require wallet credits. If you are using **MediFlux Mini**, wallet credits can also be used for **scanning features**.

MediFlux notifies you when a feature involves an additional charge, so you can decide whether to use it.

To use these services, you must have sufficient balance in your Store Wallet. You can add credits whenever needed and review how they are used through the transaction statement.

The Wallet also keeps a record of credits, deductions, subscription-related transactions, and referral rewards.

## Accessing the Store Wallet

You can open your Store Wallet from the profile menu.

1. **Open the profile menu**

   Click the **Profile** icon at the top-right corner of MediFlux.

2. **Select Wallet**

   From the dropdown menu, click **Wallet**.

   ![Accessing Store Wallet](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/9c681e1c-9b52-411c-bc22-b7bea1ff3ade-wallet-a.png)
*Caption: Open the profile menu at the top-right corner and select Wallet.*

3. **View your wallet**

   The **Store Wallet** page opens, showing your current balance, a quick guide, and your transaction history.

   ![Store Wallet overview](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/be14f92c-3b9b-429d-836a-5f48e3413139-wallet-panel.png)
*Caption: View your current wallet balance, add credits, and access wallet statements and transactions.*

---

## Understanding the Store Wallet

The Store Wallet page contains three main sections:

| Section | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Current Balance** | Shows the wallet credits currently available for use |
| **Quick Guide** | Explains how wallet credits, deductions, and rewards work |
| **Statement & Transactions** | Displays the history of wallet credits, deductions, and other transactions |

A **Refresh** button is available at the top-right of the page to reload the latest wallet information.

---

## Current Wallet Balance

The **Current Balance** section displays the credits available in your wallet.

For example:

**Current Balance: 0.00 Points**

This means there are currently no wallet credits available.

Wallet credits can be used for eligible chargeable services within MediFlux.

The balance changes when:

- You add credits through a wallet top-up.
- A chargeable service deducts credits.
- A referral reward is credited.
- An eligible subscription-related transaction is recorded.

> **[Note]** Wallet credits are separate from customer payments, pharmacy sales, and the cash or bank balances recorded in Accounting.

### Wallet Points and Conversion Rate

MediFlux displays wallet credits as **Points**.

The top-up dialog shows the following conversion rate:

**1 Point = ₹1.00**

For example:

| Points | Amount |
| --- | ---: |
| 100 Points | ₹100 |
| 200 Points | ₹200 |
| 500 Points | ₹500 |
| 1,000 Points | ₹1,000 |

The amount payable is calculated based on the number of points you choose to purchase.

---

## Adding Balance to Your Wallet

You can add credits using the **Top Up Balance** option.

### How to Top Up Your Wallet

1. **Open Store Wallet**

   Go to the **Profile** menu and select **Wallet**.

2. **Click Top Up Balance**

   In the **Current Balance** section, click **+ Top Up Balance**.

   The **Top Up Wallet** dialog opens.

   ![Top Up Wallet](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/dc21ca15-2f60-4ca5-b94f-a72986a673a5-top-up-wallet.png)
*Caption: Enter the number of points to purchase or select a preset amount. The dialog displays the conversion rate and total payable.*

3. **Choose the number of points**

   In **Points to Purchase**, enter the number of wallet points you want to buy.

   You can also select one of the available **Quick Presets**:

   | Quick Preset | Amount |
   | --- | ---: |
   | **100** | ₹100 |
   | **200** | ₹200 |
   | **500** | ₹500 |
   | **1000** | ₹1,000 |

   Selecting a preset fills the points field automatically.

   You can also enter a custom number of points.

4. **Review the total amount**

   The dialog displays:

   - **Conversion rate:** 1 Point = ₹1.00
   - **Total Amount:** The amount payable for your selected points

   For example, purchasing `100` points gives a total of **₹100.00**.

5. **Proceed to payment**

   Click **Pay ₹100.00**, or the corresponding amount shown for your selection.

   MediFlux opens the payment gateway to complete your purchase.

6. **Choose a payment method**

   The payment gateway provides several payment options, including:

   - **UPI:** Pay using a QR code or supported UPI app.
   - **Card:** Pay using a supported debit or credit card.
   - **Wallets:** Use a supported payment wallet.
   - **Net Banking:** Pay through your bank.
   - **RTGS / NEFT / IMPS:** Use the available bank transfer options.

   ![Wallet top-up payment options](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/a7b7cac6-d020-45cb-8e9b-2e3af6b37221-payment-method.png)
*Caption: Complete the wallet top-up through the Cashfree payment gateway using an available payment method.*

7. **Complete the payment**

   Follow the payment gateway instructions to complete the transaction.

   After a successful top-up, return to **Store Wallet** and check your updated balance.

   You can click **Refresh** to reload the latest wallet information.

> **[Note]** If your payment is completed but the wallet balance does not update, refresh the Wallet page. If the issue continues, contact MediFlux support with the relevant payment details.

---

## Using Wallet Credits

Wallet credits are used when you choose to access MediFlux services that involve additional charges.

Examples include:

| Service | How Wallet Is Used |
| --- | --- |
| **WhatsApp Sale Invoices** | Wallet credits are used for chargeable invoice-sharing services |
| **Payment Reminders** | Credits are used when sending chargeable payment reminders |
| **Scan-Based Features** | Charges for eligible document scanning features are deducted from the wallet |
| **Plan Renewals** | Wallet credits may be used for supported subscription or plan renewals |
| **Other Chargeable Services** | Credits may be required for additional paid features introduced in MediFlux |

MediFlux notifies you when a service carries an additional charge.

This allows you to understand the charge before choosing to use the service.

> **[Warning: Wallet balance required]** To use a service that requires wallet credits, make sure your Store Wallet has sufficient balance. If the balance is insufficient, add credits using **Top Up Balance**.

---

## Quick Guide

The **Quick Guide** section provides a brief explanation of how the Wallet works.

| Item | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Referrals** | Successful referral rewards are credited directly to your wallet |
| **Scan Deduction** | Charges for document scan features are deducted from the wallet |
| **Billing** | Wallet transactions are updated in real time. Contact support if you notice any ledger discrepancies |

This section is intended as a quick reference for understanding wallet activity.

---

## Statement & Transactions

The **Statement & Transactions** section provides a record of wallet activity.

It helps you track:

- When credits were added to your wallet.
- When credits were deducted.
- Which service or activity caused a deduction.
- Referral rewards credited to the wallet.
- Subscription-related wallet transactions.
- Scan-related deductions.

You can use this section to review how your wallet balance has changed over time.

### Searching Wallet Transactions

The transaction section includes a search field labeled **Search transactions by note...**.

To search for a transaction:

1. **Open Statement & Transactions**

   Scroll to the **Statement & Transactions** section on the Wallet page.

2. **Enter a search term**

   Type a keyword or transaction note in the search field.

3. **Click Search**

   Click **Search** to view transactions matching your search term.

This is useful when you want to find a transaction related to a particular service or activity.

---

### Filtering Wallet Transactions

You can filter transactions by type using the tabs provided in **Statement & Transactions**.

| Filter | What It Shows |
| --- | --- |
| **All** | All wallet transactions |
| **Top-Ups** | Credits purchased and added to the wallet |
| **Referrals** | Wallet credits received through referral rewards |
| **Subscriptions** | Transactions related to subscriptions and plan renewals |
| **Scan Deductions** | Credits deducted for scan-based features |

Select a tab to view transactions belonging to that category.

For example, to review deductions for scanning services, select **Scan Deductions**.

![Wallet transaction filters](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/0ade5836-8a29-4213-a591-aa9929c5095a-transactions-filters.png)
*Caption: Filter wallet activity by All, Top-Ups, Referrals, Subscriptions, or Scan Deductions.*

### When No Transactions Are Found

If there are no transactions matching the selected filter or search term, MediFlux displays:

**No transactions found**

This may happen when:

- Your wallet has no transaction history yet.
- There are no transactions in the selected category.
- The search keyword does not match any transaction notes.

Click **Clear all filters** to reset the filters and return to the unfiltered transaction view.

> **[Note]** If you have just completed a wallet transaction and it does not appear immediately, click **Refresh** to reload the latest information.

---

## Understanding Wallet Credits and Deductions

Wallet transactions can be broadly understood as two types of balance changes.

### Wallet Credits

A wallet credit increases your available balance.

Examples include:

- Adding points through **Top Up Balance**.
- Receiving an eligible referral reward.

### Wallet Deductions

A wallet deduction reduces your available balance.

Examples include:

- Using a chargeable WhatsApp service.
- Sending a chargeable payment reminder.
- Using an eligible scan-based feature.
- Paying for a supported subscription-related service.

The **Statement & Transactions** section allows you to review the wallet activity associated with these changes.

---

## Checking Wallet Activity

If you want to understand why your wallet balance has changed, follow these steps:

1. **Open Wallet**

   Click **Profile → Wallet**.

2. **Review Current Balance**

   Check the number of points currently available.

3. **Open Statement & Transactions**

   Scroll to the transaction section.

4. **Select a transaction category**

   Choose **All**, **Top-Ups**, **Referrals**, **Subscriptions**, or **Scan Deductions**, depending on what you want to review.

5. **Search if necessary**

   Use the search field to locate a particular transaction by its note.

If a transaction or deduction does not match your records, contact MediFlux support for assistance.

---

## Important Points About Store Wallet

- Store Wallet is used for MediFlux services that carry additional charges.
- You are notified when a feature involves an additional charge.
- Wallet balance is displayed in **Points**.
- The top-up dialog shows a conversion rate of **1 Point = ₹1.00**.
- You can purchase points using preset amounts or a custom amount.
- Payments are processed through the available payment gateway options.
- Successful referral rewards can be credited to your wallet.
- Chargeable services deduct credits from the available balance.
- **Statement & Transactions** records wallet activity, including credits and deductions.
- You can search and filter transactions to review specific wallet activity.
- Wallet credits are separate from regular pharmacy sales and customer payment records.

---

## Related Guides


  * [Add Retail Sale](/docs/sales/add-sale-retail) - Learn how to create retail bills and manage sale details.
  * [Sales List](/docs/sales/sale-list) - View and manage previously recorded sales and invoices.
  * [AI Bill Scan](/docs/purchases/ai-bill-scan) - Learn how to scan supplier invoices and import purchase items.
  * [Customer Ledger](/docs/customers/customer-ledger) - Review customer payments, outstanding balances, and credit activity.

help/account/add-user.title: How do I add another user?
help/account/add-user.description: Add a new user to your MediFlux account and assign their permissions.
help/account/add-user.body:
# How do I add another user?

Go to **Settings → User Management** and select **Create user**.

1. **Enter user details**

   Enter the user's **Role**, **Name**, **Email Address**, and **Phone**.

   Under **Security**, enter a **Password** and **Confirm Password**.

2. **Set permissions**

   Under **Permissions**, select the required **Read**, **Write**, and **Delete** permissions for each module.

3. **Create the user**

   Review the details and select **Create User**.

Selecting **Create User** saves the account, adds the user to the **Store Users** list under **Settings → User Management**, and activates their assigned module permissions immediately.

> **[Note]** The permissions assigned to a user determine what they can view, add, or delete in MediFlux.

## Related

* [User Management](/docs/settings/user-management.md)

help/account/change-store-details.body:
# How do I change my store details?

Go to **Settings → Account** to view and update your store details.

You can update details such as the **Owner Name**, **Phone**, **Email**, and **Address** directly from the account settings.

The **Store Name** and **License Number** cannot be changed directly. To update either of these details, contact the **MediFlux Support Team**.

help/account/login-troubleshoot.title: What do I do if I cannot log in?
help/account/login-troubleshoot.description: Troubleshoot common login issues and regain access to your MediFlux account.
help/account/login-troubleshoot.body:
# What do I do if I cannot log in?

If you cannot log in to MediFlux, first check that the **Email** and **Password** you entered are correct. Make sure there are no extra spaces in the password, as even a small difference can prevent you from logging in.

If you are still unable to log in with your password, try logging in using **OTP** instead.

If you still cannot access your account, contact the **MediFlux Support Team** for assistance.

help/account/remove-user.title: How do I remove a user?
help/account/remove-user.description: Deactivate a user to prevent them from accessing your MediFlux account.
help/account/remove-user.body:
# How do I remove a user?

To remove a user's access to your MediFlux account, **deactivate the user**.

1. **Open User Management**

   Go to **Settings → User Management** and find the user you want to remove.

2. **Edit the user**

   Select **Edit** next to the user's name.

3. **Deactivate the user**

   Enable **Deactivate User** and select **Save**.

The **Deactivate User** toggle is located under **Other Options** below the permissions grid; toggle it on and select **Save** (or **Cancel** to discard).

> **[Note]** Deactivating a user logs them out of any active session and prevents them from logging in to MediFlux. The user's account is not permanently deleted.

## Related

* [User Management](/docs/settings/user-management.md)

help/account/reset-password.title: How do I change or update my password?
help/account/reset-password.description: Update the password for the main account from Profile, or change passwords for other users from User Management.
help/account/reset-password.body:
# How do I change or update my password?

Update the password for the **main account** from **Profile**, or change passwords for other users from **User Management**.

---

## Update password for the main account

1. Click your profile avatar (top-right) and select **Profile**.
2. On the Profile page, click **Edit Profile**.
3. Enter the new password in **Password** and again in **Confirm Password**.
4. Click **Update**.

> **[IMAGE PENDING]** Edit Profile dialog showing Password and Confirm Password input fields with Update button. Source this image or expand this section with the specific data.

---

## Update password for another user

This action is available to **Admin** users only.

1. Go to **Settings → User Management**.
2. Find the user in the **Store Users** list.
3. Click **Edit**.
4. Update the password and save.

In the **Store Users** table, locate the user row and click **Edit** under **Actions** to open their profile dialog and enter new credentials.

---

> **[Note]** If you forgot your password and cannot sign in, use How do I reset my password?.

## Related

* [Getting Started](/docs/introduction/getting-started)

help/account/user-permission.title: How do I change a user's permissions?
help/account/user-permission.description: Update the permissions assigned to a user in MediFlux.
help/account/user-permission.body:
# How do I change a user's permissions?

Go to **Settings → User Management** and find the user whose permissions you want to change.

1. **Open the user's details**

   Select **Edit** next to the user.

2. **Update permissions**

   Under **Permissions**, select or clear the required **Write**, **Read**, and **Delete** permissions for each module.

3. **Save the changes**

   After updating the permissions, select **Save**.

Permissions are configured across individual functional modules — including **Sale**, **Purchase**, **Customer**, **Supplier**, and **Reports** — using dedicated checkboxes for **Read**, **Write**, and **Delete** access.

> **[Note]** Changing a user's permissions controls which features and actions they can access in MediFlux.

## Related

* [User Management](/docs/settings/user-management.md)

help/getting-started/forget-password.title: How do I invite my team?
help/getting-started/forget-password.description: Add pharmacists, cashiers, and other staff so they can sign in with their own accounts.
help/getting-started/forget-password.body:
# How do I invite my team?

Invite staff from **Settings → User Management**. Each person gets their own login so you can control what they can see and do.

1. Open **Settings**, then **User Management**.

2. Select **Add user** and enter their name, email, and role.

3. Save. They will receive an invite to set a password and sign in.

## Related

* [User Management](/docs/settings/user-management)

help/getting-started/how-do-i-sign-in.title: How do I sign in to MediFlux?
help/getting-started/how-do-i-sign-in.description: Steps to log in if you already have an active subscription, or what to do if you need to create a store first.
help/getting-started/how-do-i-sign-in.body:
# How do I sign in to MediFlux?

If you already have an **active subscription** and a store, you can sign in directly. If you do not have a store yet, create one first.

---

## Already have an active subscription?

1. Go to the MediFlux login page: [app.mediflux.in](https://app.mediflux.in).
2. Enter your registered email address and password.
3. Select **Sign in**. You will land on the dashboard for your store.

---

## Do not have a store yet?

1. Go to [mediflux.in](https://mediflux.in) or the registration page and create your store.
2. Enter your pharmacy details and complete signup.
3. After your store is created (and subscription is active), sign in at [app.mediflux.in](https://app.mediflux.in) using the same email and password.

For full setup steps, see [Installation & Setup](/docs/introduction/installation) and [Getting Started](/docs/introduction/getting-started).

---

> **[Note]** If you cannot remember your password, use [How do I reset my password?](/help/account/reset-password.md).

## Related

* [Getting Started](/docs/introduction/getting-started)
* [Installation](/docs/introduction/installation)

help/ledgers/customer-adjust-entry.title: How do I adjust the amount in a customer ledger?
help/ledgers/customer-adjust-entry.description: Use an Adjustment entry on the customer ledger to correct the outstanding balance.
help/ledgers/customer-adjust-entry.body:
# How do I adjust the amount in a customer ledger?

To correct a customer’s outstanding balance (for example a missed opening balance, price correction, or write-off), add an **Adjustment** entry from the customer ledger.

---

## Steps

1. Go to **Customers → Ledger**.
2. Select the customer from the left panel.
3. Click **Actions** (top right) and select **Adjust**.
4. Enter the **Adjustment Amount**:
   - Positive number (e.g. `500`) if the customer owes you more
   - Negative number (e.g. `-500`) if the customer owes you less
5. Set the **Entry Date** if needed.
6. Add a **Receipt / Reference Number** and **Notes** (recommended).
7. Click **Add**.

![Actions → Adjust](/images/faqs/customer-ledger-adjust.png)
*Caption: Select a customer, then open Actions and choose Adjust to correct the ledger balance.*

---

> **[Note]** Opening Outstanding on a customer profile cannot be edited after saving. Use an Adjustment entry on the ledger to correct it.

## Related

* [Customer Ledger](/docs/customers/customer-ledger)
* [Customers](/docs/customers)

help/ledgers/supplier-adjust-entry.title: How do I adjust the amount in a supplier ledger?
help/ledgers/supplier-adjust-entry.description: Use an Adjustment entry on the supplier ledger to correct the outstanding balance.
help/ledgers/supplier-adjust-entry.body:
# How do I adjust the amount in a supplier ledger?

To correct a supplier’s outstanding balance (for example a missed opening balance, price correction, or write-off), add an **Adjustment** entry from the supplier ledger.

## Steps

2. Select the supplier from the left panel.
3. Click **Actions** (top right) and select **Adjust**.

   - Negative number if you owe the supplier less
5. Set the **Entry Date** if needed.
6. Add a **Receipt / Reference Number** and **Notes** (recommended).
7. Click **Add**.

![Actions → Adjust](/images/faqs/supplier-ledger-adjust.png)
*Caption: Select a supplier, then open Actions and choose Adjust to correct the ledger balance.*

---

help/purchases/add-purchase-from-photo.title: How do I add a purchase from a photo?
help/purchases/add-purchase-from-photo.description: Upload a photo of the supplier bill on Add Purchase. MediFlux scans it and pre-fills the drug rows for you to review.
help/purchases/add-purchase-from-photo.body:
# How do I add a purchase from a photo?

You can add a purchase by uploading a photo of the supplier’s invoice. MediFlux reads the bill and pre-fills the drugs so you only need to review and finalise.

---

## Steps

1. Go to **Purchases → Add Purchase** (or use the **+** button and select **Add Purchase**).
2. Select the **supplier**, enter the **invoice number**, and set the **date** if needed.
3. Click **Scan**.
4. Upload a clear photo of the supplier invoice.
5. MediFlux scans the image and creates a draft with pre-filled drug rows.
6. Open the draft from **Drafts**, review the drugs, quantities, batch, expiry, and prices.
7. Make any corrections, then click **Add** to finalise the purchase.

![Scan supplier invoice](/images/faqs/add-purchase-scan.png)
*Caption: Use the Scan option on Add Purchase to upload a photo of the supplier bill.*

---

## After scanning

- The scanned bill appears under **Purchases → Drafts**.
- Status can show as **Scanning**, **Completed**, or **Failed**.
- From Drafts you can **Rescan**, **Append**, **Insert**, or delete the draft.

---

> **[Note]** Use a clear, well-lit photo of the full invoice for better scan accuracy. Always review the draft before finalising.

## Related

* [Add Purchase](/docs/purchases/add-purchase)
* [Purchases](/docs/purchases)

help/sales/create-credit-note.title: How do I create a credit note?
help/sales/create-credit-note.description: Issue a credit note against previously sold drugs from Sales → Add Credit Note.
help/sales/create-credit-note.body:
# How do I create a credit note?

A **Credit Note** is used when a customer returns medicines that were previously sold. It updates the customer ledger and adds the stock back to inventory.

---

## Steps

1. Go to **Sales → Add Credit Note**.
2. Select the **date** and search for the **customer**.
3. From the list of previously sold drugs, tick the items being returned.
4. Enter the **CN Qty** (quantity to return) for each selected drug.
5. Review the summary at the bottom.
6. Click **+ Create Credit Note**.

![Add Credit Note](/images/faqs/add-credit-note.png)
*Caption: Select customer, choose sold drugs, enter CN Qty, and create the credit note.*

---

Once created, the credit note appears in the customer’s **Billing Notes** and reduces their outstanding balance.

## Related

* [Add Credit Note](/docs/sales/add-credit-note)
* [Billing Notes](/docs/customers/billing-notes)

help/sales/create-debit-note.title: How do I create a debit note?
help/sales/create-debit-note.description: Raise a debit note to a supplier to remove stock from inventory. Two methods are available.
help/sales/create-debit-note.body:
# How do I create a debit note?

A **Debit Note** records that you are returning medications to a supplier (damaged, excess, or expired stock). The selected quantity is permanently removed from inventory.

There are two ways to create a debit note.

---

## Method 1: From Drug List (Separated View)

1. Go to **Drugs → Drug List**.
2. Switch to **Separated View**.
3. Select one or more drugs.
4. Click **Generate Debit Note** from the bulk actions toolbar.
5. Enter the **Quantity to Remove** for each drug.
6. Click **Create Debit Note**, then **Confirm**.

![Generate Debit Note from Drug List](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/3bd1c372-b6e5-428c-bad0-4cb263e0b93a-generate-debit-note.png)
*Caption: Select drugs in Separated View and use Generate Debit Note from the bulk actions toolbar.*

---

## Method 2: From Drugs → Create Debit Note

1. Go to **Drugs → Create Debit Note**.
2. Select the **date** and the **supplier**.
3. Add drugs one by one in the table (Drug Name, Qty, Batch, Expiry, Cost, MRP, tax rates).
4. Click **Create Debit Note**.

![Create Debit Note page](https://pub-edab995818924e31a696b8a8c0fd961b.r2.dev/mediflux-docs/2026/10/15f39cdf-e230-4f2e-af8e-1eda1ea75627-create-debit-note.png)
*Caption: Build a debit note from scratch by selecting supplier and adding drugs.*

---

Once created, the stock is deducted immediately and the debit note appears under **Billing Notes → Debit Notes**.

---

> **[Warning: Cannot be reversed]** After confirmation, the stock is removed permanently. To get the stock back you must add it again through a purchase.
